papers.title: ConnectionMind: Leveraging Social Networks and Large Language Models for Personalized Recommendation at Meta
papers.abstract: Modern recommendation systems on social media platforms such as Meta must model complex social relationships, including friendships, group memberships, and creator interactions, alongside massive and heterogeneous content such as text and video. Traditional recommendation models, however, often omit these signals or treat them independently, lacking the reasoning capability to integrate multi-relational context for fine-grained personalization. We present ConnectionMind, a production-ready recommendation framework that tightly integrates the social network structure with large language models (LLMs) to enable scalable, interpretable, and reasoning-aware personalization in Meta. ConnectionMind constructs a heterogeneous graph connecting users, items, friends, groups, and creator pages, and formulates recommendation as a graph reasoning problem: discovering personalized paths from users to candidate items. An LLM-based policy is employed to reason over these graph structures and guide recommendation decisions. To train the system at scale, ConnectionMind adopts a two-stage learning strategy. We first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on large-scale user-item interaction trajectories to initialize the reasoning policy, followed by end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) to refine the model's ability to reason over social graphs for personalized recommendation. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ConnectionMind compared to representative baselines. More importantly, ConnectionMind has been deployed in Meta's large-scale recommendation pipeline and has been evaluated through online A/B tests, achieving a 0.43% improvement in video watch time. These results demonstrate measurable real-world impact in a production recommendation system.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: ConnectionMind 是 Meta 提出的生产级推荐框架，旨在解决传统推荐模型忽略或独立处理社交关系信号、缺乏多关系上下文推理能力的问题。该工作构建连接用户、物品、好友、群组和创作者页面的异构图，将推荐形式化为图推理问题：从用户到候选物品发现个性化路径，并用基于 LLM 的策略对图结构进行推理以指导推荐决策。为支撑规模化训练，采用两阶段学习策略：先在大规模用户-物品交互轨迹上做监督微调以初始化推理策略，再通过端到端强化学习提升模型在社交图上进行个性化推荐推理的能力。多个真实数据集实验表明其优于代表性基线；系统已部署于 Meta 大规模推荐流水线，线上 A/B 测试取得视频观看时长 0.43% 的提升，体现了可度量的线上价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ConnectionMind 将社交异构图路径发现与 LLM 推理策略结合，经 SFT+RL 两阶段训练后在 Meta 线上 A/B 测试中提升视频观看时长 0.43%。
papers.core_method: 构建覆盖用户、物品、好友、群组与创作者页面的异构图，把推荐转化为从用户到候选物品的个性化路径发现这一图推理问题；使用基于 LLM 的策略对图结构进行推理并指导推荐决策；训练上先在大规模用户-物品交互轨迹上做监督微调初始化推理策略，再以端到端强化学习优化社交图上的推荐推理能力。
innovation_points: 将社交网络多关系结构（好友、群组、创作者页面）统一为异构图，并以用户到候选物品的个性化路径发现形式化推荐任务
用 LLM 策略对图结构进行推理，弥补传统模型对多关系上下文缺乏推理能力的问题
提出 SFT 初始化加端到端 RL 精调的两阶段规模化训练策略，面向生产推荐流水线落地
experiment_results: 多个真实世界数据集上相比代表性基线取得更优效果（摘要未给出具体指标数值）
已在 Meta 大规模推荐流水线部署，线上 A/B 测试视频观看时长提升 0.43%
limitations: 摘要未披露离线实验的具体数据集、基线配置与量化指标，复现与横向比较信息有限
线上收益为 0.43% 的视频观看时长提升，绝对幅度较小，需结合长期与多目标影响评估
方法依赖社交图与 LLM 推理，训练与推理的工程成本及延迟约束在摘要中未展开
papers.practical_value: 提供了社交关系信号与 LLM 推理结合的可落地范式：以异构图路径发现组织多关系上下文，用 SFT+RL 两阶段训练适配大规模流水线，并已在 Meta 生产环境通过 A/B 测试验证，对社交平台个性化推荐系统的工程实现具有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了 LLM 推理能力在真实工业推荐系统中的落地路径，而非仅停留在离线实验：从图结构建模、两阶段训练到线上 A/B 验证形成闭环，为生成式/推理式推荐与社交信号融合提供了可借鉴的生产级案例。

papers.title: HiGR: Industrial-Scale Hierarchical Generative Slate Recommendation Framework in Tencent
papers.abstract: Slate recommendation, which presents users with a ranked item list in a single display, is ubiquitous across mainstream online platforms. While recent generative recommendation methods have shown strong potential in modeling item sequences with semantic IDs, directly applying them to industrial-scale slate recommendation faces a fundamental disconnect: entangled SID spaces confound high-level list planning, fine-grained autoregressive decoding over long sequences limits semantic planning efficiency, and token-level objectives misalign with holistic slate quality. In this paper, we propose HiGR, an industrial-scale hierarchical generative framework for slate recommendation that bridges this disconnect through a co-designed pipeline. First, HiGR learns structured SIDs via a Prefix-Contrastive Residual Quantized VAE (PCRQ-VAE). By enforcing high-level prefixes to capture shared semantics, PCRQ-VAE creates a controllable discrete space that acts as a prerequisite for efficient planning. Leveraging this structured space, our Hierarchical Slate Decoder (HSD) shifts autoregressive modeling from entangled token-level decoding to coarse-grained preference embeddings. This design significantly reduces inference latency while allowing explicit global slate structure planning. Finally, this stable planning space enables an ORPO-based listwise alignment mechanism to optimize triple-objective implicit feedback-ranking fidelity, genuine user interest, and diversity. Extensive offline experiments show that HiGR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by over 10% in offline recommendation quality while achieving a $5\times$ inference speedup. Online A/B tests on Tencent platforms further improve watch time by 1.22% and video plays by 1.73%. HiGR has been deployed on multiple Tencent platform surfaces, serving hundreds of millions of users and proving its industrial-scale applicability.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: HiGR针对工业级列表推荐中生成式方法的三处脱节：语义ID空间纠缠导致高层列表规划困难、长序列细粒度自回归解码效率低、token级目标与整体列表质量不一致。为此提出协同设计的分层生成框架：先用前缀对比残差量化VAE（PCRQ-VAE）学习结构化SID，使高层前缀捕获共享语义，形成可控离散规划空间；再用分层列表解码器（HSD）将自回归建模从token级解码转为粗粒度偏好嵌入，降低推理延迟并显式规划全局列表结构；最后在该稳定规划空间上引入ORPO式listwise对齐，兼顾排序保真、真实兴趣与多样性三重目标。离线实验显示推荐质量较SOTA提升超10%，推理加速5倍；腾讯线上A/B测试观看时长提升1.22%、视频播放提升1.73%，并已部署于多平台场景服务数亿用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: HiGR通过结构化语义ID、分层列表解码与listwise对齐的协同设计，把生成式推荐落到腾讯工业级列表场景，实现质量与效率双赢。
papers.core_method: 提出PCRQ-VAE，通过前缀对比约束残差量化，使高层SID前缀承载共享语义，构建可控离散空间；在此基础上设计分层列表解码器HSD，将自回归从纠缠的token级解码转为粗粒度偏好嵌入的列表级规划，降低推理延迟并显式建模全局列表结构；最后利用该稳定规划空间进行ORPO式listwise对齐，联合优化隐式反馈排序保真、真实用户兴趣与多样性三重目标。
innovation_points: PCRQ-VAE以前缀对比约束结构化语义ID，缓解SID空间纠缠，为高层列表规划提供可控离散空间
HSD将自回归建模从token级解码迁移到粗粒度偏好嵌入，兼顾全局列表结构规划与推理效率
在稳定规划空间上引入ORPO式listwise对齐，统一排序保真、真实兴趣与多样性三重目标
面向工业级列表推荐完成端到端协同设计，并在腾讯多平台场景规模化部署
experiment_results: 离线实验中推荐质量较SOTA基线提升超过10%，推理实现5倍加速
腾讯平台线上A/B测试观看时长提升1.22%，视频播放提升1.73%
已部署于腾讯多个平台场景，服务数亿用户，验证工业级可扩展性
limitations: 材料未披露PCRQ-VAE码本规模、前缀层级数等关键超参及其敏感性分析
线上收益幅度相对有限（1%量级），长期生态与多样性影响未在材料中说明
方法依赖腾讯自有平台数据与场景，跨域迁移与冷启动表现缺乏证据
papers.practical_value: 为工业级列表推荐提供可落地的生成式框架：结构化SID使高层规划可控，分层解码显著降低线上推理成本，listwise对齐直接优化业务关注的观看时长与播放量；已在腾讯多场景服务数亿用户，证明其工程可行性与规模化价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式推荐从学术到工业列表场景的核心断点——语义ID结构、解码效率与列表级目标错配，并给出可部署的协同方案；对研究语义ID设计与生成式推荐落地、以及关注推理成本与线上收益的工程团队均有直接参考价值。

papers.title: TransRetrieval: Scaling Up Transformer-Based Retrieval for Industrial Recommendation
papers.abstract: Applying scaling laws to recommendation retrieval is hindered by feature heterogeneity: naively stacking Transformer layers yields diminishing returns because heterogeneous fields produce severe token-norm divergence. We present TransRetrieval, a Transformer-based retrieval framework that scales with both computational budget and cross-domain data. The key enabler is (1) weighted average aggregation, which restores the homogeneous-token assumption Transformers rely on. Building on this, we introduce (2) target token compression that cuts per-candidate FLOPs by 85% while preserving cross-attention expressiveness, and (3) position-style domain embeddings that unify multiple domains at negligible additional cost, turning cross-domain data into a scaling asset. On a 40-billion-interaction industrial dataset and the public KuaiRand benchmark, scaling compute from 0.1 to 2 MFLOPs per target yields +19.3/+22.2 pt Recall@2000, confirming robust log-linear scaling. In online A/B tests, TransRetrieval lifts platform revenue by 2.53% under the same end-to-end latency constraint as the production baseline.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: TransRetrieval针对工业推荐检索中直接堆叠Transformer层因异构特征字段导致token范数严重发散、扩展收益递减的问题，提出可随计算预算与跨域数据扩展的Transformer检索框架。其关键使能技术包括：加权平均聚合恢复Transformer依赖的同质token假设；目标token压缩在保留交叉注意力表达力的同时将每候选FLOPs降低85%；位置式域嵌入以极小额外成本统一多域，使跨域数据成为扩展资产。在400亿交互工业数据集与公开KuaiRand基准上，将每目标计算从0.1扩展至2 MFLOPs带来Recall@2000提升+19.3/+22.2个百分点，验证稳健的对数线性扩展。在线A/B测试中，在与生产基线相同的端到端延迟约束下，平台收入提升2.53%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TransRetrieval通过加权平均聚合、目标token压缩和位置式域嵌入，让Transformer检索在工业推荐中实现计算与跨域数据的对数线性扩展，并在同等延迟下提升线上收入。
papers.core_method: 提出面向工业推荐检索的Transformer框架：用加权平均聚合消除异构字段的token范数发散，恢复同质token假设；用目标token压缩降低每候选FLOPs约85%并保留交叉注意力表达力；用位置式域嵌入以近零成本统一多域数据，将跨域数据转化为扩展资产。
innovation_points: 加权平均聚合恢复Transformer所需的同质token假设，解决异构字段token范数发散导致的扩展收益递减
目标token压缩将每候选FLOPs降低85%，同时保留交叉注意力表达力
位置式域嵌入以极小额外成本统一多域，使跨域数据成为扩展资产
在工业规模数据与公开基准上验证计算扩展的稳健对数线性规律
experiment_results: 在400亿交互工业数据集与KuaiRand基准上，每目标计算从0.1扩展至2 MFLOPs，Recall@2000分别提升+19.3和+22.2个百分点，呈稳健对数线性扩展
在线A/B测试中，在与生产基线相同的端到端延迟约束下，平台收入提升2.53%
limitations: 摘要未披露目标token压缩对召回多样性与长尾候选的具体影响
跨域统一依赖位置式域嵌入，摘要未说明域数量或域间分布差异极大时的表现
线上收益仅在单一平台A/B中报告，摘要未给出多业务或多场景的泛化证据
papers.practical_value: 在同等端到端延迟约束下实现收入提升2.53%，且目标token压缩大幅降低每候选计算量，为工业推荐检索系统提供可随算力与跨域数据扩展的工程可行方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 它直面推荐检索中Transformer扩展收益递减的根因——异构字段token范数发散，并给出可落地的聚合、压缩与域嵌入组合，同时用工业规模数据与线上A/B验证对数线性扩展和收入增益，对生成式推荐与语义ID检索的基座化扩展有直接参考价值。

papers.title: SARM: LLM-Augmented Semantic Anchor for End-to-End Live-Streaming Ranking
papers.abstract: Large-scale live-streaming recommendation requires precise modeling of non-stationary content semantics under strict real-time serving constraints. In industrial deployment, two common approaches exhibit fundamental limitations: discrete semantic abstractions sacrifice descriptive precision through clustering, while dense multimodal embeddings are extracted independently and remain weakly aligned with ranking optimization, limiting fine-grained content-aware ranking. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{SARM}, an end-to-end ranking architecture that integrates natural-language semantic anchors directly into ranking optimization, enabling fine-grained author representations conditioned on multimodal content. Each semantic anchor is represented as learnable text tokens jointly optimized with ranking features, allowing the model to adapt content descriptions to ranking objectives. A lightweight dual-token gated design captures domain-specific live-streaming semantics, while an asymmetric deployment strategy preserves low-latency online training and serving. Extensive offline evaluation and large-scale A/B tests show consistent improvements over production baselines. SARM is fully deployed and serves over 400 million users daily.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: 针对大规模直播推荐中内容语义非平稳且实时服务约束严格的问题，论文指出离散语义抽象因聚类损失描述精度、稠密多模态嵌入独立提取且与排序优化弱对齐，均限制细粒度内容感知排序。为此提出SARM端到端排序架构，将自然语言语义锚直接融入排序优化，每个语义锚表示为可学习文本token并与排序特征联合优化，使内容描述适配排序目标；轻量双token门控设计捕捉直播领域语义，非对称部署策略兼顾低延迟在线训练与服务。离线评估与大规模A/B测试显示相对生产基线一致提升，系统已全量部署，日服务超4亿用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SARM用可学习文本语义锚替代离散聚类与弱对齐稠密嵌入，在严格实时约束下实现端到端内容感知的直播排序并完成超4亿用户规模部署。
papers.core_method: 将自然语言语义锚表示为可学习文本token，与排序特征联合优化，形成以多模态内容为条件的细粒度作者表示；采用轻量双token门控设计捕捉直播领域语义，并通过非对称部署策略分离在线训练与服务路径以控制延迟。
innovation_points: 以可学习文本token作为语义锚，直接嵌入排序优化，避免聚类离散化造成的信息损失
语义锚与排序特征联合训练，使内容描述自适应排序目标，缓解多模态嵌入与排序弱对齐问题
双token门控设计针对直播领域语义进行轻量化建模
非对称部署策略在保持低延迟在线训练与服务的同时支撑端到端架构
experiment_results: 离线评估相对生产基线取得一致提升（摘要未给出具体指标数值）
大规模A/B测试相对生产基线取得一致提升（摘要未给出具体提升幅度）
系统已全量部署，日服务超4亿用户
limitations: 摘要未披露离线评估与A/B测试的具体指标与提升幅度，难以量化各组件贡献
非对称部署与双token门控的工程细节及延迟开销未在摘要中说明
语义锚对多模态内容非平稳变化的适应机制缺乏消融证据
papers.practical_value: 为直播推荐提供可落地的端到端语义排序方案：以文本语义锚替代离散聚类，减少语义损失并增强内容感知排序；非对称部署兼顾实时性，已在超4亿日活用户的生产环境验证，对大规模推荐系统上线有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了如何把LLM式自然语言语义表示以可学习token形式嵌入工业排序模型，并在严格实时约束下完成超大规模部署，为生成式推荐与语义ID路线提供了端到端排序的工程范例。

papers.title: ReuseGR: Offline--Online Decoupled Generative Retrieval via Adaptive Prefix Reuse
papers.abstract: Larger generative retrieval models can improve retrieval quality, but their decoding cost makes low-latency serving difficult. When different users submit the same query, generating complete Semantic IDs (SIDs) for every request repeats computation, while their interaction histories call for different results. The challenge is to reuse large-model computation across requests while keeping retrieval personalized. We propose \textbf{ReuseGR}, which separates query-level candidate planning from request-level personalized completion. A 7B offline planner generates SID prefix sets shared across requests with the same query. A 0.5B online model uses each request's history to select prefixes and generate the remaining tokens. ReuseCut chooses a cache depth for each query based on historical coverage, balancing computation reuse and candidate coverage. To strengthen online completion, we transfer 7B suffix-scoring knowledge to 0.5B through path-level knowledge distillation (Path KD). BudgetCut then selects scored branches to improve final top-100 recall under a fixed branch budget. Its selection policy is initialized by on-policy distillation (OPD) and refined through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). On an industrial search-advertising dataset with approximately 2M query--item records and 3.38M catalog items, ReuseGR improves query-level HR@100 by 3.83 percentage points and reduces mean online latency by 38.9\% relative to an all-online 0.5B baseline when prefixes are prepared. It achieves HR@100 comparable to an all-online 7B baseline with 57.7\% lower online latency. A 14-day user-level online A/B test against the 0.5B baseline shows relative gains of 0.93\% in click-through rate and 1.05\% in revenue per thousand requests.
papers.summary: ReuseGR 针对生成式检索中“大模型提升质量但解码成本高、低延迟服务困难”的问题，提出离线-在线解耦的生成式检索框架：将查询级候选规划与请求级个性化补全分离。离线 7B 规划器为同一查询生成共享的 SID 前缀集合；在线 0.5B 模型结合用户历史选择前缀并生成剩余 token。ReuseCut 依据历史覆盖率自适应选择缓存深度，平衡计算复用与候选覆盖；Path KD 将 7B 后缀打分知识迁移到 0.5B；BudgetCut 在固定分支预算下选择打分分支以提升 top-100 召回，其策略经 OPD 初始化并用 GRPO 精炼。在约 200 万查询-商品记录、338 万商品的工业搜索广告数据上，相对全在线 0.5B 基线，查询级 HR@100 提升 3.83 个百分点、平均在线延迟降低 38.9%；与全在线 7B 基线 HR@100 相当，在线延迟低 57.7%。14 天用户级 A/B 测试相对 0.5B 基线 CTR 提升 0.93%、RPM 提升 1.05%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ReuseGR 通过离线大模型共享 SID 前缀、在线小模型个性化补全，在工业搜索广告中实现接近 7B 的检索质量与显著更低的在线延迟。
papers.core_method: 离线 7B 规划器为同一查询生成共享 SID 前缀集合；在线 0.5B 模型基于请求历史选择前缀并生成剩余 token。ReuseCut 按历史覆盖率自适应确定缓存深度；Path KD 做路径级知识蒸馏迁移后缀打分；BudgetCut 在固定分支预算下选择分支，策略由 OPD 初始化并经 GRPO 优化。
innovation_points: 查询级候选规划与请求级个性化补全的离线-在线解耦架构，复用大模型计算同时保留个性化
ReuseCut 基于历史覆盖率自适应选择缓存深度，显式平衡计算复用与候选覆盖
Path KD 将 7B 后缀打分知识迁移至 0.5B 在线模型，并以 OPD+GRPO 优化 BudgetCut 分支选择策略
experiment_results: 工业搜索广告数据集（约 200 万查询-商品记录、338 万商品）：相对全在线 0.5B 基线，查询级 HR@100 提升 3.83 个百分点，平均在线延迟降低 38.9%
与全在线 7B 基线 HR@100 相当，在线延迟低 57.7%
14 天用户级在线 A/B 测试相对 0.5B 基线：CTR 相对提升 0.93%，RPM 相对提升 1.05%
limitations: 前缀复用依赖同一查询的重复出现，长尾查询的复用收益可能受限
离线前缀需预先准备，缓存深度与分支预算等超参需按场景调优
实验仅基于单一工业搜索广告数据集，跨领域泛化性未验证
papers.practical_value: 在搜索广告等低延迟高并发场景中，以离线大模型规划加在线小模型补全的方式，在接近 7B 模型检索质量的同时大幅降低在线解码成本，并已通过 14 天线上 A/B 验证点击率与千次请求收入的正向收益。
papers.why_it_matters: 为生成式检索的工业落地提供了可复用的解耦范式：把昂贵的大模型计算移到离线并跨请求复用，同时用蒸馏与策略优化保证在线个性化与召回，兼顾质量、延迟与商业指标。

papers.title: Towards Comprehensible Recommendation with Large Language Model Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Recommender systems have become increasingly ubiquitous in daily life. While traditional recommendation approaches primarily rely on ID-based representations or item-side content features, they often fall short in capturing the underlying semantics aligned with user preferences (e.g., recommendation reasons for items), leading to a semantic-collaborative gap. Recently emerged LLM-based feature extraction approaches also face a key challenge: how to ensure that LLMs possess recommendation-aligned reasoning capabilities and can generate accurate, personalized reasons to mitigate the semantic-collaborative gap. To address these issues, we propose a novel Content Understanding from a Collaborative Perspective framework (CURec), which generates collaborative-aligned content features for more comprehensive recommendations. CURec first adapts the LLM with recommendation objectives through post-training, equipping it with instruction-following and chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. Next, we use the LLM-generated features to train the recommender model. Then, we treat the user-item prediction scores produced by the trained recommender model as reward signals to guide RL-based refinement of the LLM, thereby improving the quality of generated reasons and pattern. The corrected reasons are directly integrated into the recommender model to enhance comprehensibility and recommendation performance. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of CURec over existing methods.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: 该论文针对传统推荐系统依赖ID表示或物品侧内容特征、难以捕捉与用户偏好对齐的语义（如推荐理由）所导致的语义-协同鸿沟问题，提出从协同视角理解内容的框架CURec。CURec首先通过面向推荐目标的后训练适配LLM，使其具备指令遵循与思维链推理能力；随后用LLM生成的特征训练推荐模型；再将训练后推荐模型给出的用户-物品预测分数作为奖励信号，通过强化学习精炼LLM，提升生成理由与模式的质量；修正后的理由直接融入推荐模型，以增强可解释性与推荐性能。公开基准实验表明CURec优于现有方法。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CURec用推荐模型预测分数作强化学习奖励来精炼LLM生成的推荐理由，把协同信号回灌到内容理解中，缓解语义-协同鸿沟。
papers.core_method: 三阶段框架：1）以推荐目标对LLM做后训练，赋予指令遵循与思维链推理能力；2）用LLM生成的内容特征训练推荐模型；3）以推荐模型的用户-物品预测分数为奖励信号，通过强化学习精炼LLM，使其生成协同对齐的理由与模式，并将修正后的理由直接集成进推荐模型。
innovation_points: 提出从协同视角理解内容的CURec框架，用推荐模型预测分数作为RL奖励信号反向精炼LLM，形成内容理解与协同信号的闭环
通过推荐目标后训练使LLM具备推荐对齐的推理能力，生成个性化推荐理由以缓解语义-协同鸿沟
将LLM修正后的理由直接融入推荐模型，同时提升可解释性与推荐性能
experiment_results: 论文称在公开基准上CURec优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体指标数值与数据集名称，无法量化比较
limitations: 摘要未报告具体数据集、基线配置与量化提升幅度，实验细节需查阅全文
RL精炼依赖推荐模型预测分数作为奖励，奖励质量受推荐模型自身偏差影响，摘要未讨论该风险
方法涉及LLM后训练与强化学习多阶段流程，计算与工程成本未在摘要中说明
papers.practical_value: 为推荐系统提供了一条用协同信号监督LLM内容理解的可行路径，生成的推荐理由可直接用于提升推荐可解释性与用户信任，适合需要理由展示的线上推荐场景；但多阶段训练流程的工程成本需在落地前评估。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把LLM生成理由的质量与推荐模型的协同预测直接挂钩，用RL闭环替代单纯的内容特征提取，为弥合语义-协同鸿沟提供了可复用的训练范式，对生成式推荐与可解释推荐研究均有参考价值。

papers.title: Scaling Graph Neural Networks for Friend Recommendation: Multi-Hash User Embeddings and Temporal Neighbor Sampling
papers.abstract: Friend recommendation is inherently graph-structured: the relevance of a potential connection depends on multi-hop social context rather than user attributes alone. However, deploying message-passing GNNs on a production-scale social graph with hundreds of millions of users and tens of billions of edges requires addressing numerous modeling and systems challenges. We present a scalable end-to-end GNN ranking system for production social graphs, focusing on two design choices that are critical in this setting: multi-hash ID embeddings and temporal neighbor sampling. Multi-hash embeddings are common for high-cardinality features, but industrial GNN systems typically either ignore trainable IDs or accept full embedding tables, exceeding 200 GB for our graph. We integrate multi-hash as the primary node representation, reducing the ID-embedding table size by more than 98 percent while preserving ranking quality. Temporal neighbor sampling is well understood in principle, but existing implementations scan full adjacency lists, which is a non-starter for users with tens of thousands of friends. We implement timestamp-sorted CSR storage with binary search, reducing the per-node temporal sampling cost from $O(deg(v) + k)$ to $O(\log(deg(v)) + k)$. Beyond these components, we show that this combination scales and yields measurable production impact. On a graph with 194M users and 28B edges, offline ablations isolate each design choice's contribution. In an online A/B test, our system increases friend additions from recommendations by 16 percent and unique friend adders by 11.5 percent over a strong production baseline. We release our framework for distributed training and inference on large temporal graphs.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM)
papers.summary: 该论文面向生产级社交图（1.94亿用户、280亿边）的好友推荐排序任务，提出可扩展的端到端GNN系统。针对高基数用户ID嵌入表超过200GB的问题，将多哈希ID嵌入作为主节点表示，在保持排序质量的同时把ID嵌入表缩小98%以上；针对时间邻居采样需扫描完整邻接表、对拥有数万好友的用户不可行的问题，采用按时间戳排序的CSR存储与二分查找，把单节点采样代价从O(deg(v)+k)降到O(log(deg(v))+k)。离线消融实验分别验证两项设计的贡献，在线A/B测试中推荐带来的好友添加量提升16%、独立添加好友用户数提升11.5%，并开源分布式训练与推理框架。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用多哈希ID嵌入压缩98%嵌入表、用时间戳排序CSR加二分查找降低采样代价，使GNN好友推荐在亿级用户社交图上取得16%好友添加提升。
papers.core_method: 构建面向生产社交图的端到端GNN排序系统：以多哈希用户ID嵌入替代全量嵌入表作为主节点表示；邻居采样采用按时间戳排序的CSR存储，通过二分查找定位时间窗口内的邻居，实现高效时间邻居采样；并配套分布式训练与推理框架。
innovation_points: 将多哈希ID嵌入作为GNN主节点表示，在工业系统中兼顾可训练ID与嵌入表规模，表大小缩减超98%且排序质量不降
实现时间戳排序CSR存储加二分查找的时间邻居采样，将每节点采样复杂度从O(deg(v)+k)降至O(log(deg(v))+k)
在1.94亿用户、280亿边的真实社交图上完成离线消融与在线A/B验证，并开源分布式训练推理框架
experiment_results: 离线消融在1.94亿用户、280亿边的图上分别隔离两项设计选择的贡献
在线A/B测试中，推荐带来的好友添加量较强生产基线提升16%，独立添加好友用户数提升11.5%
ID嵌入表规模缩减超过98%，排序质量保持
limitations: 证据仅来自摘要与元数据，缺少多哈希冲突率、哈希函数数量等超参数敏感性分析
在线收益为相对强基线的提升，未披露绝对量级、长期留存或生态影响
方法面向好友推荐排序场景，向其他图任务的泛化性未在材料中验证
papers.practical_value: 为亿级用户、百亿边社交图上的GNN推荐提供了可落地的工程方案：多哈希嵌入显著降低内存与存储成本，时间戳CSR加二分查找解决高好友数用户的采样瓶颈，开源框架可直接复用于大规模时序图训练与推理。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把GNN推荐从实验室图规模推进到真实生产社交图，并给出可量化的线上收益；两项设计分别对应工业GNN最痛的嵌入表内存与邻居采样效率问题，对构建大规模图推荐系统具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: DiMuRe: Diagnosis-Guided Multilevel Recovery for Robotic Task Execution
papers.abstract: Disturbances can invalidate the conditions required by a robot's next action even when much of its task program remains useful. A recovery system must therefore choose a response suited to the current state. We present DiMuRe (diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery), a framework for robot-use agents that uses phase-specific evidence and method preconditions to select program reuse or predefined recovery skills, including bounded vision-language-action (VLA) grasping. After the original program exits, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can generate corrective code from images and execution feedback. Local verification checks the outcome of each recovery attempt. We also introduce LIBERO-Disturb, a benchmark for robustness and recovery under mid-execution disturbances, supporting program-based agents and VLA policies. On 801 scheduled disturbed Encore development cases, Local DiMuRe (program reuse and recovery skills) achieves 77.65% complete-task success, compared with 58.68% for the original program under the same physical-step allowance. Full DiMuRe achieves 81.90% with terminal replanning, an additional step allowance, and early handoff. Local DiMuRe also uses fewer physical steps per scheduled episode than the original program.
papers.summary: DiMuRe 针对机器人任务执行中扰动导致下一步动作条件失效的问题，提出诊断引导的多级恢复框架。其核心是依据阶段特定证据与方法前置条件，在程序复用、预定义恢复技能（含受限 VLA 抓取）和由多模态大模型基于图像与执行反馈生成纠正代码之间做选择，并对每次恢复尝试做局部验证。作者同时构建 LIBERO-Disturb 基准，支持程序型智能体与 VLA 策略在中途扰动下的鲁棒性与恢复评测。在 801 个受扰动 Encore 开发案例上，Local DiMuRe 完整任务成功率为 77.65%，原程序在相同物理步数预算下为 58.68%；Full DiMuRe 在加入终端重规划、额外步数预算与提前交接后达到 81.90%，且 Local DiMuRe 每回合物理步数更少。
papers.one_line_takeaway: DiMuRe 用诊断引导的多级恢复策略，在扰动下显著提升机器人任务完成率并减少物理步数消耗。
papers.core_method: 在原始任务程序退出后，利用阶段特定证据与方法前置条件进行诊断，选择程序复用、预定义恢复技能（含受限 VLA 抓取）或由 MLLM 根据图像和执行反馈生成纠正代码；每次恢复尝试后执行局部验证，并支持终端重规划与提前交接。
innovation_points: 提出诊断引导的多级恢复框架，按当前状态选择程序复用、恢复技能或 MLLM 生成纠正代码，而非单一回退策略
将受限 VLA 抓取作为预定义恢复技能之一，与程序型智能体协同
引入局部验证机制检查每次恢复尝试的结果
构建 LIBERO-Disturb 基准，支持程序型智能体与 VLA 策略在中途扰动下的鲁棒性与恢复评测
experiment_results: 在 801 个受扰动 Encore 开发案例上，Local DiMuRe 完整任务成功率为 77.65%，原程序在相同物理步数预算下为 58.68%
Full DiMuRe 在终端重规划、额外步数预算与提前交接下达到 81.90%
Local DiMuRe 每回合物理步数少于原程序
limitations: Full DiMuRe 的 81.90% 依赖额外步数预算与终端重规划，与 Local DiMuRe 的对比条件不完全一致
评测主要基于作者构建的 LIBERO-Disturb 与 Encore 开发案例，尚未见真实机器人平台或更多外部基准的验证
MLLM 生成纠正代码的可靠性与局部验证的覆盖范围未在摘要中量化说明
papers.practical_value: 为机器人任务执行系统提供可落地的扰动恢复层：优先复用原程序与预定义技能，必要时才调用 MLLM 生成纠正代码，并以局部验证控制风险；在保持较低物理步数消耗的同时提升任务完成率，适合对执行效率与鲁棒性均有要求的工业与服务机器人场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把恢复决策从单一回退提升为基于诊断的多级选择，并给出可复现的扰动基准与量化收益，对程序型机器人智能体与 VLA 策略的鲁棒性研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Diverse-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation generates the semantic ID (SID) of the next item from a user's interaction history. Existing training objectives mainly supervise target SID tokens, while on-policy distillation (OPD) provides denser supervision through a teacher's probability distribution over all tokens for more effective and efficient training. However, OPD can aggravate popularity bias: teacher feedback favors popular-item tokens, transferring this preference to the student, while student rollout favors popular items, leaving unpopular-item SID paths rarely generated and supervised. These two sources of bias reinforce each other and reduce recommendation diversity. We propose HERO, a diversity-aware OPD framework. Heterogeneous teacher distillation trains two teachers specializing in popular and unpopular items and routes each training sample to the teacher matching the popularity group of its ground-truth item. The student learns from the routed teacher's probability distribution along its own generated SIDs. Diversity-aware item rollout incorporates ground-truth SIDs of unpopular items into training, covering SID paths that the student rarely generates. Only the student is used for inference. Offline experiments on an industrial dataset and three public datasets further demonstrate its effectiveness, diversity, and robustness. Moreover, we deploy HERO in the "Guess What You Like" module on the 1688 homepage, where a 15-day online A/B test shows a 3.412% increase in gross merchandise value (GMV).
papers.summary: 该论文研究生成式推荐中在线策略蒸馏（OPD）加剧流行度偏差的问题：教师反馈偏向热门物品token，学生自回归采样也偏向热门物品，二者相互强化，导致冷门物品的SID路径很少被生成和监督，推荐多样性下降。作者提出HERO多样性感知OPD框架：异构教师蒸馏训练热门与冷门两个教师，按真实物品的流行度分组将样本路由到对应教师，学生在自己生成的SID上学习被路由教师的概率分布；多样性感知物品回放把冷门物品的真实SID纳入训练，覆盖学生很少生成的SID路径。推理时仅用学生模型。工业数据集与三个公开数据集的离线实验验证了有效性、多样性与鲁棒性；在1688首页“猜你喜欢”模块部署，15天在线A/B测试GMV提升3.412%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: HERO用热门/冷门双教师路由加冷门SID回放，缓解在线策略蒸馏的流行度偏差，在1688线上A/B测试中带来3.412%的GMV提升。
papers.core_method: 在生成式推荐的在线策略蒸馏框架下，按真实物品的流行度分组，将训练样本路由到分别擅长热门与冷门物品的两个异构教师，学生在自身rollout生成的SID序列上对齐被路由教师的完整token概率分布；同时引入多样性感知物品回放，将冷门物品的真实SID路径注入训练，以覆盖学生采样中稀缺的SID路径；推理阶段只保留学生模型。
innovation_points: 识别并形式化OPD在生成式推荐中的双重流行度偏差：教师概率分布偏好热门token，学生rollout偏好热门物品，二者相互强化
提出异构教师蒸馏与按真实物品流行度分组的样本路由机制，使冷门物品获得针对性稠密监督
设计多样性感知物品回放，用冷门物品真实SID补齐学生很少生成的SID路径
推理仅用学生模型，不增加线上服务开销，并完成工业级部署与在线A/B验证
experiment_results: 工业数据集与三个公开数据集的离线实验表明，方法在有效性、多样性和鲁棒性上均有提升（摘要未给出具体离线指标数值）
1688首页“猜你喜欢”模块15天在线A/B测试显示GMV提升3.412%
limitations: 摘要未报告离线实验中有效性、多样性、鲁棒性的具体量化指标与消融数据
双教师训练与样本路由增加训练阶段的计算与工程复杂度，摘要未讨论其成本
在线验证仅报告GMV单一业务指标，未披露多样性等线上辅助指标
papers.practical_value: 面向真实电商推荐场景，在不增加推理成本的前提下缓解生成式推荐的流行度偏差，兼顾热门物品的转化效率与冷门物品的曝光多样性；已在1688首页核心推荐模块完成部署并通过在线A/B验证业务价值，具备可复用的工程路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把LLM式在线策略蒸馏引入生成式推荐，并指出稠密教师监督会放大流行度偏差这一被忽视的副作用，给出可落地的双教师路由与SID回放方案，同时具备离线与工业在线双重证据，对语义ID生成式推荐的训练目标设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Utility-Aware Generative Recommendation: Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes and Utility-Guided Decoding
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation has been widely adopted in large-scale industrial recommendation systems, where multimodal item embeddings are quantized into offline semantic identifiers (SIDs) and items are retrieved by autoregressively generating their SIDs. However, conventional SID construction often underrepresents item utility reflected in post-exposure behaviors such as shares, long views, and video completion, making semantically similar items with different utility insufficiently distinguishable while struggling to accommodate rapidly changing utility signals. Moreover, generation likelihood may be misaligned with downstream utility, causing high-utility candidates to be prematurely pruned during beam search before post-generation reranking or training-time reward alignment can effectively compensate. To address these limitations, we propose UAGR, which aligns both SID construction and decoding with downstream multi-objective utility. Our Utility-Enriched Semantic Codes preserve the original semantic information while incorporating item-level utility without increasing SID length or vocabulary size, supporting incremental utility updates with no additional tokenization or sequence-decoding cost. Meanwhile, our Utility-Guided Decoding estimates candidate utility by combining predictions of multiple post-exposure outcomes and incorporates these estimates into beam scoring, reducing the risk of prematurely pruning high-utility paths while enabling flexible utility control without interfering with generative backbone training. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests under real-world traffic demonstrate the effectiveness and deployability of UAGR, which has been fully deployed on Kuaishou and increases video watch time by 0.206\% online.
papers.summary: 针对生成式推荐中语义ID（SID）构建忽视曝光后效用信号、生成似然与下游多目标效用错位的问题，本文提出UAGR框架，从SID构建与解码两个环节对齐下游效用。在SID侧，提出效用增强语义码，在不增加SID长度与词表规模的前提下将物品级效用注入语义码，保留原语义信息并支持效用增量更新，且不引入额外分词或序列解码开销；在解码侧，提出效用引导解码，通过组合多个曝光后行为结果的预测来估计候选效用并融入beam打分，降低高效用路径被过早剪枝的风险，同时支持灵活的效用调控且不干扰生成主干训练。离线实验与真实流量在线A/B测试验证了有效性与可部署性，系统已在快手全量部署，线上视频观看时长提升0.206%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UAGR将曝光后多目标效用同时注入语义ID构建与beam解码，在不增加SID长度和解码开销的前提下提升生成式推荐的线上观看时长。
papers.core_method: 将物品级效用信号编码进语义码以增强SID的效用区分度，并在beam search打分中融合多曝光后行为结果的效用预测，实现SID构建与解码两阶段对下游多目标效用的对齐。
innovation_points: 效用增强语义码：在保持原语义信息、不增加SID长度与词表规模的前提下注入物品效用，并支持效用增量更新，无额外分词与序列解码成本
效用引导解码：以多曝光后行为预测组合估计候选效用并纳入beam打分，缓解高效用候选被过早剪枝的问题
效用调控与主干解耦：可在不干扰生成主干训练的情况下灵活调节效用权重
SID构建与解码两端统一对齐下游多目标效用，而非仅在重排或训练期奖励对齐阶段补偿
experiment_results: 离线实验验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体离线指标数值）
快手真实流量在线A/B测试显示视频观看时长提升0.206%
系统已在快手完成全量部署，验证了可部署性
limitations: 摘要未披露离线实验的具体数据集、基线对比与消融数值，难以评估各模块的独立贡献
效用信号依赖曝光后行为，存在曝光偏差与效用快速变化下的时效性挑战，摘要未说明相应处理细节
线上收益幅度较小（观看时长+0.206%），其在不同业务场景与流量规模下的泛化性尚不明确
papers.practical_value: 面向大规模工业推荐系统，方法不增加SID长度、词表规模与解码开销，支持效用增量更新，可直接嵌入现有生成式推荐链路；已在快手全量部署并带来观看时长正向收益，具备明确的工程可落地性。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出生成式推荐中语义相似但效用不同的物品难以区分、生成似然与下游效用错位导致beam过早剪枝这两个工业痛点，并给出低开销、可与生成主干解耦的SID与解码协同对齐方案，配有真实流量A/B与全量部署证据，对生成式推荐的工业落地有直接参考价值。

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.
papers.summary: RoboColosseum 提出一个分布式物理评测框架，把统一策略服务与标准化协议部署到多地点本地运行的机器人网络上，以解决通用机器人策略跨本体、跨任务、跨环境评测难以复现的问题。首轮研究覆盖 SO-101、Franka、Bimanual-YAM 与 G1 Humanoid 四种本体，评测五个 VLA 策略与三个前沿 AI 智能体。Open Track 在匹配的本地条件下进行盲测成对比较，不做任务特定适配；Fine-tune Track 给每个策略每任务相同 100 条示范，衡量 20 个任务的适配能力。124 个站点共 5,699 次成对比较显示，前沿智能体与专用 VLA 策略表现相当，但所有系统都难以可靠完成开放世界任务；微调后 GR00T N1.7 在 SO-101 领先，pi0.5 在 Franka 与 Bimanual-YAM 领先。跨本体任务套件的策略排名一致性很弱（Kendall W=0.24），Open Track 排名难以预测微调后的相对表现，三个共享本体上均出现明显名次反转。部分进度指标揭示成功率遗漏的差异：G1 Humanoid 上无策略完成五个任务，但平均进度在 13.3% 至 23.2% 之间。Open Track 排名随试验累积趋于稳定，主动匹配以显著更少物理试验达到与均匀采样相当的排名一致性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 分布式真实环境评测揭示机器人策略跨本体排名不一致、零样本排名难以预测微调表现，部分进度与主动匹配是提升物理评测效率的关键。
papers.core_method: 构建分布式评测框架：统一策略服务接口加标准化评测协议，连接多站点本地运行的异构机器人；设计 Open Track（盲测成对比较、无任务适配）与 Fine-tune Track（每任务等量 100 条示范）两条评测轨道，并引入部分进度度量与主动匹配采样策略。
innovation_points: 分布式多站点真实环境评测协议，兼顾跨本体差异与可复现性
Open Track 与 Fine-tune Track 双轨设计，分离零样本泛化与任务适配能力评估
引入部分进度指标，刻画任务失败时的完成程度差异
主动匹配采样在保持排名一致性的同时显著减少物理试验次数
experiment_results: 124 站点 5,699 次 Open Track 成对比较：前沿智能体与专用 VLA 策略相当，所有系统开放世界任务可靠性均不足
微调后 GR00T N1.7 在 SO-101 领先，pi0.5 在 Franka 与 Bimanual-YAM 领先；跨本体任务套件排名一致性弱（Kendall W=0.24）
G1 Humanoid 上无策略完成五个任务，平均进度 13.3%–23.2%；Open Track 排名难以预测微调后表现并出现名次反转
limitations: 首轮仅覆盖四种本体、五个 VLA 策略与三个前沿智能体，规模有限
部分进度指标虽揭示差异，但任务成功率整体偏低，开放世界任务完成度不足
排名稳定性依赖试验累积，主动匹配虽减少试验但未给出统一的最优采样理论保证
papers.practical_value: 为企业与社区提供可复现的分布式真实机器人评测基础设施，帮助判断策略在跨本体部署中的泛化与适配边界，主动匹配可降低物理评测成本，部分进度指标为失败任务提供细粒度改进信号。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把机器人策略评测从单点实验室推向多站点真实环境，并用数据说明零样本排名不能替代微调评测、成功率不能替代进度度量，对 VLA 策略选型与评测协议设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model: code
papers.abstract: Code and analysis outputs for the paper Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model (SPAIS Workshop at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning, CoRL 2026). The code studies OpenVLA-7B fine-tuned on LIBERO-Goal. It labels the goal that each closed-loop rollout executes, tests negated and redirected instructions, localizes the goal with activation patching, edits it with patches and steering vectors, and evaluates goal read-outs as runtime monitors.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.summary: 该研究围绕视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中目标表征的可解释性与可控性展开，以在LIBERO-Goal上微调的OpenVLA-7B为对象。作者先为每次闭环rollout标注其实际执行的目标，再测试否定式与重定向指令对行为的影响；随后用激活修补定位承载目标信息的内部表征，并通过补丁与引导向量对该表征进行编辑，最后评估目标读出信号作为运行时监控器的可行性。工作属于机制可解释性与表征工程路线，关注模型内部目标状态能否被定位、改写并用于在线监测，而非提出新的VLA架构或训练目标。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该工作表明VLA模型内部存在可定位、可编辑的目标表征，并可作为运行时监控信号。
papers.core_method: 以LIBERO-Goal微调的OpenVLA-7B为对象，构建闭环rollout的目标标注流程；通过否定与重定向指令探测目标敏感性；采用激活修补定位目标相关表征；用补丁与引导向量实施表征编辑；将目标读出信号作为运行时监控器进行评估。
innovation_points: 将目标表征分析从静态探测推进到闭环rollout层面的目标标注与行为验证
结合激活修补定位与引导向量编辑，对VLA内部目标状态进行因果性干预
把目标读出信号转化为运行时监控器，连接可解释性与在线安全监测
experiment_results: 给定材料仅提供代码与分析输出的元数据，未给出具体定量指标，无法报告定位精度、编辑成功率或监控性能数值
摘要层面确认完成了目标标注、否定/重定向指令测试、激活修补定位、补丁与引导向量编辑及监控评估等实验环节
limitations: 证据仅来自标题、摘要与学术元数据，缺少完整实验数据与统计细节
研究对象限于OpenVLA-7B与LIBERO-Goal单一基准，泛化性未在材料中体现
作为CoRL 2026 SPAIS Workshop论文，尚缺同行评审的完整结果支撑
papers.practical_value: 为机器人VLA策略提供了一条可操作的内部状态审计路径：目标读出可作为部署时的运行时监控信号，用于检测指令误解或目标漂移；表征编辑则为行为纠正与安全干预提供潜在手段，降低对重训练或外部奖励模型的依赖。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA模型正被用于真实机器人控制，但其内部目标状态长期不透明。该工作把目标表征的可定位、可编辑与可监控三者串联，为VLA的可解释性与部署安全提供了可复用的分析框架与代码基础。

papers.title: Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up
papers.abstract: We reimplement the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) and test the uncertainty estimate that its follow-up, RWM-U, uses to penalize reward in offline policy optimization. Our implementation matches the released model's gradients. On held-out data, training on the model's own rollouts beats one-step training at the preregistered long horizon for all ten episodes, but loses on short one-step windows. RWM-U's ensemble disagreement ranks rollout errors better than forecast step (Spearman rho = 0.90 at 100 steps), yet its spread substantially understates error: one-sigma coverage on the released checkpoint is 4.6% at 100 steps, versus 68% for a calibrated Gaussian. Rolling ensemble members on their own predictions raises coverage to 33%. The implemented squared-error loss on sampled predictions drives each member's variance toward zero. A horizon-specific rescaling restores one-sigma coverage under leave-one-episode-out evaluation, but not two-sigma coverage. We also identify two defects in the released evaluation pipeline. The study covers one robot, one gait and one dataset; it trains no policy.
papers.summary: 本文复现了Robotic World Model（RWM）的动力学模型，并检验其后续工作RWM-U用于离线策略优化中奖励惩罚的不确定性估计。复现实现与发布模型的梯度一致。在留出数据上，按预注册的长时域评估，使用模型自身rollout训练在全部十个episode上优于单步训练，但在短时域单步窗口上表现更差。RWM-U的集成分歧对rollout误差的排序能力优于预测步数（100步时Spearman rho=0.90），但其分布宽度显著低估误差：发布检查点上的1σ覆盖率在100步时仅为4.6%，而校准高斯应为68%。对集成成员自身预测进行滚动可将覆盖率提升至33%。所实现的采样预测平方误差损失使各成员方差趋近于零。按horizon特定的重缩放可在留一episode评估下恢复1σ覆盖率，但无法恢复2σ覆盖率。作者还指出发布评估流程中的两个缺陷。该研究仅覆盖一个机器人、一种步态和一个数据集，且未训练任何策略。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RWM-U的集成分歧能正确排序rollout误差，但其不确定性尺度被严重低估，需按horizon重缩放才能部分校准。
papers.core_method: 复现RWM动力学模型并验证梯度一致性；在留出数据上比较模型自身rollout训练与单步训练；评估RWM-U集成分歧对rollout误差的排序能力与覆盖率校准；分析平方误差损失对集成方差的影响；尝试滚动集成预测与horizon特定重缩放来改善校准。
innovation_points: 复现并验证RWM动力学模型的梯度一致性
系统评估RWM-U不确定性估计的排序能力与尺度校准，揭示排序正确但尺度错误的问题
指出采样预测平方误差损失导致集成方差趋近于零的机制
提出horizon特定重缩放以部分恢复覆盖率校准
experiment_results: 长时域rollout训练在全部十个episode上优于单步训练，但短时域单步窗口上更差
100步时集成分歧对rollout误差的Spearman rho=0.90，但1σ覆盖率仅4.6%（校准高斯为68%）
滚动集成预测将覆盖率提升至33%；horizon重缩放恢复1σ但未恢复2σ覆盖率
limitations: 仅覆盖一个机器人、一种步态和一个数据集，泛化性有限
未训练任何策略，无法直接评估不确定性惩罚对策略优化的下游影响
重缩放仅恢复1σ覆盖率，2σ覆盖率仍未校准
papers.practical_value: 为使用世界模型不确定性进行离线策略优化的工程实践提供警示：集成分歧可用于排序但不可直接作为校准误差使用，需针对预测horizon进行重缩放；同时提示损失函数设计对集成方差的影响，有助于避免过度自信的奖励惩罚。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究揭示了世界模型不确定性估计中排序正确但尺度错误的关键问题，对基于模型的不确定性惩罚与离线策略优化具有直接指导意义，并指出了发布评估流程的缺陷，值得关注世界模型可靠性与校准的研究者阅读。

papers.title: RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation benchmarks are the standard way to compare robot policies, but each benchmark brings its own evaluator, observation layout, and action convention, and evaluation is slow: 500 RoboTwin Easy episodes with one simulator and one model on one GPU take 359.7 minutes. Profiling the official StarVLA evaluator shows that simulation occupies CPU cores while the GPU averages 14.3% utilization. RoboScope Kit wraps each model once in a Python class called a Policy, and each benchmark once in an adapter around the benchmark's own evaluator, so the benchmark's rules and scoring stay unchanged. Scheduling runs simulator workers and Policy replicas as separate pools, sizes both from measured probes, and shards work deterministically across GPU instances; runtime optimization renders only the observations an action-chunk Policy reads. Adapters cover six benchmark families. On LIBERO-Long with a StarVLA checkpoint on one 48 GiB RTX 4090, the concurrency search selects twelve simulator workers sharing three Policy replicas, which evaluate 500 episodes 4.45$\times$ faster than the official StarVLA evaluation with equivalent success rates, 2.78$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 1.52$\times$ faster than vla-eval at its tuned configuration. With CUDA MPS, which lets the replicas run their kernels concurrently, the search selects sixteen workers sharing four replicas, 6.16$\times$ faster than StarVLA, 3.85$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 2.10$\times$ faster than vla-eval. On RoboTwin Easy, four GPUs with chunk-boundary observation complete the 500 episodes in 14.4 minutes, 25.04$\times$ faster than the single-GPU baseline, with identical success outcomes and terminal steps.
papers.summary: RoboScope Kit 针对具身智能策略评测中基准接口割裂与评测速度慢的问题，提出统一评测框架。每个模型被封装为 Policy 类，每个基准通过适配器包裹其原有评测器，保持基准规则与评分不变。调度层将模拟器 worker 与 Policy 副本作为独立资源池，依据实测探针确定规模，并在多 GPU 实例间确定性分片；运行时仅渲染动作块策略实际读取的观测。适配器覆盖六类基准。在 LIBERO-Long 上，单张 48 GiB RTX 4090 经并发搜索选出 12 个模拟器 worker 共享 3 个 Policy 副本，500 回合评测较官方 StarVLA 快 4.45 倍且成功率一致；启用 CUDA MPS 后快 6.16 倍。RoboTwin Easy 上四 GPU 14.4 分钟完成 500 回合，较单 GPU 基线快 25.04 倍，成功结果与终止步数完全一致。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboScope Kit 用统一 Policy 接口与基准适配器解耦模型和评测器，并通过资源池调度与按需渲染，在保持评分一致的前提下将具身策略评测加速 4.45 至 25 倍。
papers.core_method: 将模型统一封装为 Policy 类，基准侧以适配器包裹原有评测器以保留规则与评分；调度器把模拟器 worker 和 Policy 副本分为两个资源池，基于实测探针确定并发规模，跨 GPU 实例确定性分片任务；运行时优化只渲染动作块策略读取的观测，并支持 CUDA MPS 让副本内核并发执行。
innovation_points: 模型与基准双向解耦：Policy 封装模型、适配器封装基准评测器，评分规则不变，覆盖六类基准家族
模拟器 worker 与 Policy 副本分离的双资源池调度，依据实测探针定容并确定性分片
按动作块策略实际读取的观测做按需渲染，减少无效模拟与传输开销
支持 CUDA MPS 的多副本内核并发，进一步压缩评测墙钟时间
experiment_results: LIBERO-Long 单张 48 GiB RTX 4090：12 worker 共享 3 副本，500 回合较官方 StarVLA 快 4.45 倍、较 RLinf 快 2.78 倍、较调优 vla-eval 快 1.52 倍，成功率一致
启用 CUDA MPS 后选 16 worker 共享 4 副本，较 StarVLA 快 6.16 倍、较 RLinf 快 3.85 倍、较 vla-eval 快 2.10 倍
RoboTwin Easy 四 GPU 14.4 分钟完成 500 回合，较单 GPU 基线快 25.04 倍，成功结果与终止步数完全一致
limitations: 适配器仅覆盖六类基准家族，未覆盖的基准需额外开发适配
并发规模依赖实测探针，换硬件或模型需重新搜索配置
摘要未报告多节点或异构集群下的扩展性数据
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能策略提供可复用的统一评测入口，显著降低多基准对比的工程成本与等待时间；资源池调度与按需渲染可直接用于企业机器人策略的回归测试与选型评测，评分一致性保证结果可比。
papers.why_it_matters: 具身智能评测长期受限于各基准接口割裂与模拟器低 GPU 利用率，该工作在不改变基准语义的前提下系统性地解决接口统一与吞吐瓶颈，是评测基础设施层面的实用贡献。

papers.title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.
papers.summary: TriPhysBench 针对具身智能体在物理场景中协同运用物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理的能力评估不足问题，构建了包含 200 个视频、410 道问题的基准，受波普尔“三个世界”启发，将三类能力纳入统一评测，并设计测量型与知识型子任务，分别考察获取观测与外部规格并用于定量问题的能力。六个代表性视觉语言模型中最佳答案准确率仅 50.38%，显示协同能力有限。作者进一步提出 TriPhys 框架，从完整工具集成轨迹中学习统一策略，用中间推理引导检索与计算，并将工具反馈纳入后续物理推断；在训练未见的 110 道视频问题上，三种 Qwen 配置的答案与解答得分均提升，TriPhys-27B 相对 Qwen3.6-27B 骨干答案准确率相对提升 17.7%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TriPhysBench 揭示现有视觉语言模型在物理感知、知识检索与定量推理协同上的明显短板，TriPhys 通过工具集成轨迹学习提供可验证的改进路径。
papers.core_method: 构建 410 题、200 视频的 TriPhysBench，按测量型与知识型子任务统一评估物理感知、知识检索与推理；提出 TriPhys，从完整工具集成轨迹学习统一策略，以中间推理引导检索与计算，并将工具反馈融入后续物理推断。
innovation_points: 受波普尔“三个世界”启发，将物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理纳入同一评测框架
设计测量型与知识型互补子任务，强调观测获取与外部规格应用的定量判断
提出从完整工具集成轨迹学习统一策略的 TriPhys，显式利用中间推理与工具反馈
experiment_results: 六个代表性视觉语言模型中最佳答案准确率仅 50.38%
在训练未见的 110 道视频问题上，TriPhys 在三种 Qwen 配置上均提升答案与解答得分
TriPhys-27B 相对 Qwen3.6-27B 骨干答案准确率相对提升 17.7%
limitations: 基准规模为 410 题、200 视频，覆盖范围有限
最佳模型准确率仅 50.38%，任务仍具挑战性
TriPhys 仅在三种 Qwen 配置上验证，泛化性有待更广泛评估
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体在真实物理场景中的感知、知识检索与定量推理协同提供可复现评测基准，并给出基于工具集成轨迹的策略学习路径，有助于指导面向物理世界交互的模型训练与系统设计。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将物理智能评估从事件识别推进到物理过程理解与定量推理，并给出可验证的学习框架，对具身智能评测与后训练研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.
papers.summary: 该论文关注视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人部署中的执行效率问题：动作分块策略在推理下一块时会停顿，且执行速度受保守示教数据限制。作者提出免训练的执行层PTS（Path-preserving Time Scaling），将机器人运动视为参考路径的时间重参数化，路径仅随新观测改变。PTS包含路径层与时间层：路径层对每次重规划做确定性单步解码，并从推理期间消耗的进度处进入；时间层累加计划增量，在夹爪运动时保持机械臂1x速度，并按执行器线性范围与延迟下分块可行性限速。作者分析了入口错位与随机采样对延续误差的偏差和方差影响，并推导出加速收益的盈亏平衡成功率。在LIBERO上对两个冻结VLA注入推理延迟，PTS相对最强可部署基线将任务吞吐提升33%（pi0.5）和104%（SmolVLA），成功率持平或更优，在全部六种模型-套件组合中最佳，并超过零延迟1x执行；仅时间层相对同单步解码器的异步1x执行提升28%和38%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PTS以路径保持的时间重参数化实现免训练VLA执行加速，在保持或提升成功率的同时显著提高吞吐。
papers.core_method: 将冻结动作分块策略的机器人运动建模为参考路径的时间重参数化：路径层对每次重规划做确定性单步解码，并从推理期间已消耗的进度处进入；时间层累加计划增量，夹爪运动时机械臂保持1x，按执行器线性范围与延迟下分块可行性限速。
innovation_points: 提出免训练执行层PTS，统一处理推理停顿与保守慢速两种时间损失，避免现有方法叠加失效的问题
路径层实现确定性单步解码与进度对齐进入，消除入口错位与随机采样带来的偏差和方差
时间层基于执行器线性范围与延迟下分块可行性进行限速，并推导加速收益的盈亏平衡成功率
experiment_results: LIBERO注入推理延迟下，PTS相对最强可部署基线吞吐提升33%（pi0.5）和104%（SmolVLA），成功率持平或更优
在全部六种模型-套件组合中最佳，并超过零延迟1x执行
仅时间层相对同单步解码器的异步1x执行提升28%和38%；LIBERO-Dynamic上相对停等执行提升38%，与异步1x执行相当
limitations: 实验限于LIBERO仿真基准与两个冻结VLA，未提供真实机器人部署验证
方法依赖动作分块策略与执行器线性范围等先验，对更复杂动力学或非分块策略的适用性未验证
盈亏平衡成功率分析基于延续误差的偏差-方差建模，实际场景中模型误差分布可能偏离假设
papers.practical_value: 为已部署的冻结VLA策略提供免训练、即插即用的执行加速层，在不重训模型的前提下提升任务吞吐并保持成功率，降低推理延迟带来的停机损失，对真实机器人部署有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作指出VLA部署中的时间浪费独立于模型能力，并给出可证明的路径保持执行框架，兼顾异步与加速两类优化，为VLA线上高效执行提供了新思路与可复现的基准结果。

papers.title: When Embodied AI Infers Too Much
papers.abstract: As embodied AI systems enter homes, hospitals, and public spaces, they introduce a new class of privacy risks—not by recording more, but by inferring more. Drawing on modalities such as thermal imaging, radio-frequency sensing, chemical analysis, and pressure mapping, these systems can construct rich behavioural and physiological models of individuals, often without explicit user awareness or consent. While each signal may appear innocuous in isolation, sensor fusion can enable powerful inferences about health, habits, and emotional states. This article examines how current legal frameworks only partially address this shift from observation to inference, and explores how sensor design, regulatory oversight, and user-facing transparency can mitigate the risks. We argue that safeguarding privacy in the age of embodied AI requires recognising inference itself as a site of regulation and design—before silent insights become structural intrusions.
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 本文关注具身AI系统在进入家庭、医院和公共空间后带来的新型隐私风险：风险核心不在于记录更多数据，而在于推断更多信息。作者指出，热成像、射频感知、化学分析和压力映射等模态可被融合，用于构建个体的行为与生理模型，且常在用户不知情或未同意的情况下进行；单一信号看似无害，传感器融合却能推断健康、习惯与情绪状态。文章分析现行法律框架仅部分回应从观察到推断的转变，并探讨传感器设计、监管监督与面向用户的透明度如何缓解风险。核心主张是将推断本身视为监管与设计对象，在无声洞察变成结构性侵入之前加以约束。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 具身AI的隐私风险正从记录转向推断，推断本身应成为监管与设计的核心对象。
papers.core_method: 概念分析与政策讨论：梳理具身AI多模态传感（热成像、射频感知、化学分析、压力映射）及传感器融合的推断能力，评估现行法律框架对推断型风险的覆盖缺口，并从传感器设计、监管监督和用户透明度三方面提出缓解路径。
innovation_points: 将具身AI隐私风险重新界定为从观察到推断的转变，而非单纯的数据采集量增加
强调传感器融合使孤立无害信号组合成对健康、习惯和情绪状态的强推断能力
主张把推断本身作为监管与设计对象，提出在无声洞察固化为结构性侵入前进行干预
experiment_results: 本文为概念与政策分析文章，未报告实验数据或定量评估结果
limitations: 未提供实证数据或系统评估来量化推断风险
对具体法律条款和监管机制的分析较为概括，缺乏可操作细则
传感器设计与透明度措施的有效性未经验证
papers.practical_value: 为具身AI系统的传感器设计、隐私影响评估和用户透明度机制提供政策与设计思路，帮助开发者和监管者在产品早期识别并约束推断型隐私风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着具身AI进入家庭、医院和公共空间，隐私治理不能只关注数据采集，还需关注系统能推断出什么；本文为这一转变提供了及时的框架性讨论。

papers.title: Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract: RL locomotion policies trained under nominal simulation conditions may encounter distribution shifts that compromise safety. Predictive monitors could anticipate violations, but their world-model forecasts may become unreliable under shift, and ensemble disagreement is not calibrated. We evaluate predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for frozen Ant-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5 policies using closed-loop world-model rollouts and a three-model ensemble. Across external-force, observation-noise, and mass shifts, predicted robustness ranks HalfCheetah's future STL violations strongly, whereas disagreement does not reliably track observation prediction error or violations. Under severe noise, violations remain common ($64.2\pm24.4\%$ at $K{=}20$ across three PPO seeds), yet current-state robustness without prediction comes within $0.03$ AUROC of predictive robustness. Penalizing predicted robustness by disagreement does not consistently improve ranking. Ant provides complementary per-specification evidence, but its composite target has no positive violations and its any-violation target is single-class in most evaluated seed-condition slices. Overall, predictive robustness provides useful STL-specific ranking but little demonstrated additional ranking value over the current state; these findings caution against treating ensemble disagreement as a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
papers.summary: 本文研究强化学习运动策略在分布偏移下的安全监控问题，评估基于闭环世界模型推演的预测式信号时序逻辑（STL）监控是否优于当前状态鲁棒性评估。作者在冻结的Ant-v5与HalfCheetah-v5策略上，用三模型集成进行闭环世界模型推演，覆盖外力、观测噪声与质量偏移三类分布偏移。结果显示：预测鲁棒性对HalfCheetah未来STL违规具有较强排序能力，而集成分歧并不能可靠跟踪观测预测误差或违规；在严重噪声下违规仍普遍（K=20时64.2±24.4%），但无预测的当前状态鲁棒性AUROC仅差0.03；用分歧惩罚预测鲁棒性也未稳定提升排序。Ant提供逐规约的补充证据，但其复合目标无正违规、任一违规目标在多数切片为单类。结论是预测鲁棒性有STL特定排序价值，但相对当前状态额外增益有限，不应把集成分歧当作安全不确定性的可靠指标。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 预测式STL鲁棒性可排序未来违规，但相对当前状态鲁棒性增益有限，集成分歧不是可靠的安全不确定性信号。
papers.core_method: 对冻结的Ant-v5与HalfCheetah-v5策略，使用三模型集成的闭环世界模型推演生成未来轨迹，计算预测STL鲁棒性，并与集成分歧、当前状态鲁棒性对比；在外部力、观测噪声和质量偏移下评估排序能力（AUROC）与违规率。
innovation_points: 将预测式STL监控与集成分歧在RL运动分布偏移下进行系统对比评估
采用闭环世界模型推演而非开环预测，考察预测可靠性随偏移退化
揭示集成分歧与观测预测误差、STL违规之间缺乏校准关系
指出当前状态鲁棒性在多数场景已接近预测鲁棒性的排序表现
experiment_results: HalfCheetah上预测鲁棒性对未来STL违规排序较强，分歧不能可靠跟踪预测误差或违规
严重噪声下K=20违规率64.2±24.4%（三个PPO种子），当前状态鲁棒性AUROC仅差0.03
分歧惩罚未稳定提升排序；Ant复合目标无正违规，任一违规目标多数切片为单类
limitations: 仅评估两个冻结策略与三类偏移，结论泛化性有限
Ant任务目标存在单类与无正违规问题，统计证据不完整
未给出预测鲁棒性相对当前状态的显著增益，工程部署价值待验证
papers.practical_value: 为RL运动控制的安全监控选型提供警示：优先使用当前状态STL鲁棒性作为轻量监控基线，谨慎将集成分歧作为安全不确定性代理；预测式监控仅在需要STL特定前瞻排序时考虑。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作以负面/审慎证据纠正了“集成分歧即安全不确定性”的常见假设，并量化了预测式监控相对当前状态的实际增益边界，对安全监控系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $α$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $α\in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.
papers.summary: 该论文研究机器人机械臂潜空间路径规划（LSPP）中的安全性问题。现有方法用二分类碰撞分类器约束避障，但其在障碍边界附近梯度饱和且缺乏时间结构，导致优化器停滞且无前向不变性保证。作者用潜空间中学习的神经控制屏障函数（CBF）替代分类器，训练目标包含安全/不安全符号约束与在障碍盲标称规划器转移上的离散时间递减条件，规划时通过闭式一阶校正将目标导向的潜步投影回CBF约束。在7自由度Franka Panda上，固定障碍任务成功率达75.6%，比35组调优分类器最优配置高12.0个百分点；多位置任务达83.8%；衰减率α扫描显示最佳区间为[0.10,0.20]。完全随机障碍场景成功率降至33.0%，作者归因于训练转移与校正规划器访问状态间的协变量偏移。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用潜空间神经控制屏障函数替代二分类碰撞分类器，为LSPP提供前向不变性保证并显著提升固定障碍任务成功率，但随机障碍下仍受协变量偏移制约。
papers.core_method: 在VAE学习的潜空间中训练神经控制屏障函数，采用三项损失：安全/不安全样本的符号约束、在障碍盲标称规划器状态转移上评估的离散时间递减条件；规划时对每个目标导向潜步施加闭式一阶投影校正，使其满足CBF约束。
innovation_points: 将控制屏障函数引入潜空间路径规划，替代饱和梯度且无时间结构的二分类碰撞分类器
设计三项训练目标，在标称规划器转移上施加离散时间递减条件以提供前向不变性
规划时采用闭式一阶校正投影，计算轻量且无需显式逆运动学
experiment_results: 7-DoF Franka Panda固定障碍任务成功率75.6%，比35组调优分类器最优配置高12.0个百分点
多位置任务成功率83.8%
完全随机障碍场景成功率降至33.0%，归因于协变量偏移；α最佳区间为[0.10,0.20]
limitations: 随机障碍场景成功率仅33.0%，训练转移与校正规划器访问状态存在协变量偏移
实验限于7-DoF Franka Panda仿真任务，未报告真实机器人部署结果
CBF在潜空间学习，其安全保证依赖潜空间表示与解码器保真度，摘要未量化该影响
papers.practical_value: 为机械臂潜空间规划提供可微、计算轻量的安全约束机制，避免显式逆运动学与分类器梯度饱和问题，适合固定或有限位置障碍的工业抓取与操作场景；随机障碍下需进一步处理分布偏移。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作指出二分类碰撞分类器在LSPP中的梯度饱和与无不变性保证缺陷，并给出CBF式替代方案与闭式投影，为生成式/潜空间运动规划的安全约束设计提供可复用思路，同时诚实揭示随机障碍下的协变量偏移瓶颈。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $π_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $π_{0.5}$.
papers.summary: 该论文针对扩散式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将预训练VLM仅作为静态条件、限制其感知与推理能力引导动作生成的问题，提出JADE联合动作去噪器。其核心思路是构造结构化动作潜变量，使VLM在每一步去噪中同时读取当前噪声动作、视觉观测与语言指令，并通过门控交叉注意力动态引导动作专家，使VLM的引导随生成过程演化；同时监督VLM从噪声动作潜变量恢复干净动作，赋予其直接的动作学习信号，将感知与控制耦合。联合去噪还支持更少采样步数，配合自适应步长调度平衡性能与推理延迟。在RoboDojo上，JADE平均成功率达12.67%，为所评估的基于π0.5方法中最高，并与大规模预训练的近期VLA和WAM基础模型具有竞争力；在RoboTwin 2.0上亦有提升，并在四个真实双臂任务上将平均成功率较π0.5提高20.8个百分点。
papers.one_line_takeaway: JADE让预训练VLM从静态条件提供者转变为与动作专家联合去噪的主动参与者，以结构化动作潜变量和门控交叉注意力实现感知-控制耦合，在仿真与真实双臂任务上取得提升。
papers.core_method: 将动作编码为结构化动作潜变量；在每个去噪步骤中，VLM同时接收当前噪声动作、视觉观测和语言指令，通过门控交叉注意力向动作专家提供随生成过程演化的引导；额外监督VLM从噪声动作潜变量恢复干净动作，形成直接动作学习信号；联合去噪支持更少采样步数，并引入自适应步长调度以平衡任务性能与推理延迟。
innovation_points: 打破VLM仅作静态条件的级联范式，使VLM与动作专家在去噪过程中联合细化动作
以结构化动作潜变量作为VLM可读取的接口，并用门控交叉注意力实现动态、逐步演化的引导
对VLM施加从噪声动作恢复干净动作的监督，将感知与控制的耦合转化为直接动作学习信号
联合去噪减少采样步数，配合自适应步长调度抵消VLM参与带来的额外推理成本
experiment_results: RoboDojo上平均成功率12.67%，为所评估的基于π0.5方法中最高，并与大规模预训练的近期VLA和WAM基础模型具有竞争力
在RoboTwin 2.0上性能亦有提升
四个真实世界双臂任务平均成功率较π0.5提高20.8个百分点
limitations: VLM参与去噪带来额外推理成本，虽通过减少采样步数和自适应步长调度缓解，但未给出明确的延迟或吞吐量化数据
真实世界评估仅覆盖四个双臂任务，场景与任务多样性有限
摘要未报告与大规模预训练基线在参数量、数据规模上的可比性细节，跨规模比较的公平性有待进一步说明
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作策略学习，JADE提供了一种在保持预训练VLM感知与推理能力的同时将其深度耦合进动作生成的工程路径；联合去噪减少采样步数与自适应步长调度直接回应线上推理延迟约束，真实双臂任务20.8个百分点的成功率提升显示其在企业真实操作场景中的落地潜力。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作重新定义了预训练VLM在VLA系统中的角色，从被动条件编码器变为主动联合去噪器，为提升分布外泛化与感知-控制耦合提供了新范式，同时兼顾推理效率，对具身智能基础模型设计具有参考价值。

papers.title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $τ$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制中每步都需通过数十亿参数VLM重编码全观测、导致推理频率与语义更新频率错配的问题，提出Leap-VLA。其核心是将低频VLM作为语义锚点并缓存上下文，高频流匹配动作专家复用缓存语义，同时接入由掩码重建、光流和深度预训练的紧凑编码器提供的新鲜低延迟视觉流；通过自适应层归一化将缓存年龄τ注入专家，并在训练中显式覆盖缓存年龄采样与年龄递增像素腐蚀。在异步部署栈上，LIBERO-Spatial在2秒语义刷新下从61.4%提升至95.5%，1秒刷新达95.9%；四个LIBERO套件平均在1秒和2秒刷新下分别保持95.2%和94.5%（匹配锚点为96.3%）。此外，前向-only块边界软微调实现零延迟重规划且无损失（97.1%），并利用零成本负样本训练思维链裁决门控，在指令-场景不匹配时冻结执行。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Leap-VLA通过低频VLM语义缓存与高频流匹配动作专家解耦，显式建模缓存年龄，在异步部署下大幅缩小陈旧性差距并实现零延迟重规划。
papers.core_method: 将VLM作为低频语义锚点并缓存其上下文，高频流匹配动作专家复用缓存语义并融合紧凑编码器的新鲜视觉流；用自适应层归一化注入缓存年龄τ，训练时采样真实缓存年龄并施加年龄递增像素腐蚀；部署时采用前向-only块边界软微调实现零延迟重规划，并引入思维链裁决门控处理指令-场景不匹配。
innovation_points: 低频VLM语义锚点与高频流匹配动作专家解耦，突破每步全量重编码的算力瓶颈
显式将缓存年龄τ通过自适应层归一化条件化动作专家，并用年龄采样与像素腐蚀训练覆盖陈旧性函数
前向-only块边界软微调（soft-nudge）实现零额外延迟的逐步重规划且无性能损失
利用零成本负样本训练思维链裁决门控，在指令-场景不匹配时冻结执行
experiment_results: LIBERO-Spatial在2秒语义刷新下从61.4%提升至95.5%，1秒刷新达95.9%（距频率匹配锚点1.6个百分点）
四个LIBERO套件平均在1秒和2秒刷新下分别保持95.2%和94.5%，匹配锚点为96.3%
软微调重规划在零额外延迟下达到97.1%成功率；裁决门控在可行指令上不损成功率并能在不匹配时冻结执行
limitations: 实验局限于LIBERO仿真套件，未提供真实机器人平台或企业业务场景的线上验证数据
缓存年龄条件化与像素腐蚀训练依赖对部署陈旧性分布的建模，跨硬件与网络条件的泛化性未充分讨论
思维链裁决门控依赖零成本负样本的构造质量，对复杂指令-场景不匹配的覆盖范围有限
papers.practical_value: 为机器人控制提供了一条可落地的异步部署路径：低频VLM语义缓存显著降低每步推理算力，高频动作专家满足20-50Hz反应控制需求；零延迟重规划与不匹配冻结机制提升了线上执行的安全性与响应性，适合对实时性和算力约束敏感的真实业务场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面VLA部署中语义更新频率与反应控制频率的错配这一工程核心矛盾，给出了从训练到部署的完整陈旧性建模方案，并以可复现的LIBERO数据量化了缓存复用的收益，对生成式推荐与机器人控制中低频大模型加高频执行器的系统设计具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. Project page: https://auriga.stelledge.com/ Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Auriga
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉语言模型直接作为机器人策略时存在的规划-执行鸿沟问题展开研究。在RoboDojo基准上，移除机械臂执行后GPT-6 Astra成功率从22.5%升至76.2%，量化了该鸿沟。作者提出Auriga，一个任务无关的智能体执行框架，模型在显式任务信念上做决策，通过直接工具调用或多步Python程序行动；框架提供校准的3D测量、以手指为参考的双臂控制和单一准入网关。运动前模型在仿真暂停时检查视觉轨迹预览，执行中框架检查阶段容差与抓取边界，偏离时停机并返回测量差异供原地恢复。经13轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结评估，Auriga在RoboDojo排行榜以57.7%成功率（64.0分）居首，同模型下较参考框架翻倍以上，场景随机化下仍第一而学习策略最多下降33.9%；在RoboCasa365上同一冻结框架达73.2%成功率，复合任务上超过VLA辅助智能体最多23.1%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Auriga用任务无关的执行框架而非更强模型，弥合了VLM规划与机器人执行之间68.3%的鸿沟，并在零样本操作基准上取得领先。
papers.core_method: 提出任务无关的智能体执行框架Auriga：模型在显式任务信念上做所有任务决策，通过直接工具调用或合成的多步Python程序行动；框架提供校准的3D测量、以手指为参考的双臂控制、单一机器人准入网关，以及运动前的视觉轨迹预览（仿真暂停）和执行中的阶段容差与抓取边界检查，偏离时停机并返回测量差异供原地恢复。
innovation_points: 将规划-执行鸿沟显式量化并作为核心问题，提出以执行框架而非模型能力为主的解决路径
任务无关的框架设计：模型保留全部任务决策权，框架只提供测量、控制与安全准入等基础设施
运动前视觉轨迹预览与执行中容差检查、偏离停机及原地恢复机制
经13轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结评估，强调零样本与无目标任务试错或重置
experiment_results: RoboDojo排行榜第一，成功率57.7%（64.0分），同模型下较参考框架翻倍以上，弥合68.3%的规划-执行鸿沟
场景随机化下仍保持第一，而学习策略成功率最多下降33.9%
RoboCasa365上同一冻结框架达73.2%成功率，复合任务上超过VLA辅助智能体最多23.1%
limitations: 评估主要基于RoboDojo与RoboCasa365两个基准，真实物理机器人部署验证未在给定材料中体现
框架依赖校准的3D测量与仿真暂停预览，真实场景中传感器噪声与实时性约束可能影响效果
摘要未提供失败案例分布与恢复机制的定量成功率，鲁棒性边界不明确
papers.practical_value: 为企业具身智能落地提供工程约束下的参考：通过任务无关执行框架、准入网关与容差检查降低对模型直接控制机器人的依赖，提升零样本部署的稳定性与安全性，并给出可复用的轨迹预览与偏离恢复工程模式。
papers.why_it_matters: 它表明具身操作的关键瓶颈可能不在模型规划能力而在执行接口与安全约束，为VLM作为机器人策略的工程化提供了可复现的框架级方案与基准证据。

papers.title: Reflex: Fast Robot Policy Serving by Reusing and Correcting Past Actions
papers.abstract: Modern robot policies often perform expensive inference to generate action chunks, making serving a latency bottleneck for real-time control and a throughput bottleneck for multi-robot serving. Building on the success of caching in image, video, and audio generation, recent robot-policy advances have reported promising speedups by reusing intermediate denoising states to avoid redundant computation. Surprisingly, we find that such reuse often offers little advantage over simply running fewer denoising steps from fresh noise, without any cache. Moreover, accelerating denoising leaves the expensive policy backbone intact, which can account for 70% of GPU time. We present Reflex, a serving layer that turns past policy executions into a backbone-free path for future decisions. Rather than reusing intermediate computations, Reflex caches complete action chunks to bypass both the backbone and action head. This introduces two challenges: similar observations can demand different actions, and small action deviations (errors) in reuse can compound into execution stalls. Reflex addresses these through two-level cache correction. At the action level, it learns action-aware similarity from past policy decisions, assembles compatible chunks, and applies lightweight residual correction to limit action mismatch. At the execution level, it captures task progress and adaptively refreshes the original policy to limit accumulated errors and balance inference cost. Without modifying the underlying policy, Reflex improves inference latency by 1.4x to 11x and throughput by 2.0x to 2.2x on representative workloads and real robots, while preserving comparable task success.
papers.summary: Reflex 针对机器人策略推理中动作块生成开销大、成为实时控制与多机服务瓶颈的问题，重新审视了复用中间去噪状态这一常见加速思路，发现其相对从新噪声少跑几步去噪并无明显优势，且无法绕过占 GPU 时间约 70% 的策略骨干。为此，Reflex 提出一种服务层方案：缓存完整动作块，使未来决策走无骨干路径，同时绕过骨干与动作头。为应对相似观测可能对应不同动作、以及复用误差累积导致执行停滞两大挑战，Reflex 设计两级缓存校正：动作级学习动作感知相似度、组装兼容动作块并施加轻量残差校正；执行级捕捉任务进度并自适应刷新原策略以限制累积误差、平衡推理成本。在不修改底层策略的前提下，Reflex 在代表性负载与真实机器人上将推理延迟降低 1.4 至 11 倍、吞吐提升 2.0 至 2.2 倍，并保持可比的任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Reflex 用完整动作块缓存加两级校正替代中间状态复用，在不改策略的前提下显著降低机器人策略服务延迟并提升吞吐。
papers.core_method: 将历史策略执行结果缓存为完整动作块，未来决策直接复用缓存以绕过策略骨干与动作头；通过动作级相似度学习、兼容块组装与轻量残差校正，以及执行级任务进度感知的自适应策略刷新，控制动作偏差与累积误差。
innovation_points: 指出复用中间去噪状态相对少步去噪优势有限，且无法绕过占 GPU 时间约 70% 的骨干网络
以完整动作块缓存构建无骨干推理路径，同时绕过骨干与动作头
提出动作级与执行级两级缓存校正，分别限制动作不匹配与累积误差
作为服务层方案，无需修改底层策略即可部署
experiment_results: 在代表性负载与真实机器人上，推理延迟降低 1.4 至 11 倍
吞吐提升 2.0 至 2.2 倍
任务成功率保持可比；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: 依赖历史执行缓存，任务分布剧烈变化时缓存命中与校正效果可能受限
执行级自适应刷新需平衡误差与推理成本，参数调节可能影响收益
材料未给出成功率的具体量化对比与更多任务场景的验证
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略在线服务提供无需改模型的加速层，可同时缓解实时控制延迟与多机器人服务吞吐瓶颈，便于在现有策略栈上部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 它挑战了中间状态复用这一流行加速假设，并给出绕过昂贵骨干的缓存校正路线，对机器人策略服务系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Atomic Creator Tokens for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Recommending creators that a user does not yet follow is a cold-start problem: from hundreds of thousands of popular creators and only a short trail of prior engagements, the system must predict the next creator worth surfacing. The prevailing generative recommendation recipe tokenizes each creator into a \emph{Semantic ID} (SID) by quantizing a frozen embedding and trains a language model to generate SIDs. We show that this SID layer, not the language model, is the binding constraint. The creator-to-SID map is many-to-one, so colliding creators must be resolved by a popularity tie-break that caps creator-level recall and favors already-popular creators, and the frozen quantizer stops the training gradient from reaching the creator representation. We propose Atomic Creator Token (ACT), which gives every creator its own vocabulary token trained end-to-end. The map is bijective, so collisions are impossible and inference is a direct top-$k$ over creator logits. In a controlled comparison on production data in which the token layer is the only variable, ACT improves creator-level Recall@15 by 19.8 points ($1.84\times$) over a matched SID baseline, still leads when the SID codebook is enlarged $64\times$, and serves at ${\sim}2.7\times$ lower per-user latency. The advantage carries over to the public KuaiRand dataset, where ACT is the only method that beats a global-popularity baseline, provided each creator token sees enough training examples. In a live A/B test, ACT is directionally positive on every reported metric against both the SID-enhanced and the classic production rankers.
papers.summary: 该论文针对大规模创作者推荐中的冷启动问题，指出现有生成式推荐依赖的语义ID（SID）层才是性能瓶颈：创作者到SID的映射是多对一，导致碰撞需靠流行度打破平局，从而限制创作者级召回并偏向热门创作者；同时冻结的量化器阻断了梯度回传到创作者表示。作者提出原子创作者令牌（ACT），为每个创作者分配独立词表令牌并端到端训练，使映射成为双射，推理时直接对创作者logits取top-k。在生产数据控制实验中，仅改变令牌层，ACT将创作者级Recall@15提升19.8个百分点（1.84倍），SID码本扩大64倍仍领先，且每用户延迟降低约2.7倍；在KuaiRand公开数据集上，ACT是唯一击败全局流行度基线的方法（前提是每个创作者令牌有足够训练样本）；线上A/B测试中，ACT相对SID增强版和经典生产排序器在所有报告指标上均呈正向趋势。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 语义ID层而非语言模型是生成式创作者推荐的主要瓶颈，原子创作者令牌通过双射词表与端到端训练显著提升召回并降低延迟。
papers.core_method: 为每个创作者分配一个独立词表令牌，替代基于冻结嵌入量化的语义ID；令牌嵌入与语言模型端到端联合训练，使创作者表示能接收梯度；推理时直接对创作者令牌的logits做top-k检索，避免多对一碰撞和流行度平局裁决。
innovation_points: 揭示语义ID层是多对一映射和冻结量化器导致召回上限与流行度偏置的根因
提出原子创作者令牌，实现创作者到令牌的双射映射，彻底消除碰撞
令牌表示端到端训练，梯度可直达创作者表示
推理简化为对创作者logits直接top-k，降低延迟
experiment_results: 生产数据控制实验中，仅改变令牌层，ACT将创作者级Recall@15提升19.8个百分点（1.84倍）
SID码本扩大64倍后ACT仍领先，且每用户延迟降低约2.7倍
KuaiRand公开数据集上ACT是唯一击败全局流行度基线的方法，但需每个创作者令牌有足够训练样本
线上A/B测试中ACT相对SID增强版和经典生产排序器在所有报告指标上方向性为正
limitations: ACT依赖每个创作者令牌有足够训练样本，长尾创作者可能受益有限
线上A/B测试仅报告方向性为正，未给出具体显著性与幅度数据
方法针对创作者推荐场景，向其他实体类型泛化需进一步验证
papers.practical_value: 为大规模创作者推荐提供可直接替换语义ID层的工程方案：消除碰撞与流行度偏置，提升创作者级召回，同时降低推理延迟，适合线上生成式推荐系统部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了生成式推荐中语义ID的默认设计，用控制实验证明令牌层是约束瓶颈，并给出简单有效的端到端替代方案，对生成式推荐系统设计有直接指导意义。

papers.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.
papers.summary: 该论文针对MoE大模型部署时需存储全部专家导致内存开销大的问题，发现MoE层专家输出存在结构化冗余：在不同模型和任务类别上，专家输出的稳定秩和熵有效秩均远低于名义专家数，输出分布的有效模态也更少。基于此，作者将专家剪枝重新建模为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，并用贪心策略高效优化，而非仅独立打分排序或穷举组合。在统一框架下提出两种方法：PEEP通过最大化加权投影能量保持功能子空间，DCEP通过最小化加权覆盖误差保持分布几何。两者均引入路由器权重作为先验，兼顾专家全局结构关系与局部重要性。在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，75%和50%保留率下多数基准优于SOTA，通用任务与数学推理平均性能最佳。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MoE专家输出存在结构化冗余，将剪枝建模为结构保持的子集选择问题可优于独立打分排序的剪枝方法。
papers.core_method: 先实证分析专家输出的稳定秩、熵有效秩和有效模态数远低于专家数，揭示结构化冗余；再将专家剪枝形式化为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，用贪心策略优化；提出PEEP（最大化加权投影能量以保持功能子空间）和DCEP（最小化加权覆盖误差以保持分布几何），均以路由器权重为先验融合全局结构与局部重要性。
innovation_points: 发现并量化MoE专家输出的结构化冗余，用稳定秩、熵有效秩和有效模态数刻画
将专家剪枝从独立打分排序重构为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，并用贪心策略高效求解
提出PEEP和DCEP两种互补方法，分别从功能子空间和分布几何角度保持专家结构
引入路由器权重作为先验，联合考虑全局结构关系与局部专家重要性
experiment_results: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，75%和50%专家保留率下，多数基准优于SOTA基线
在通用任务和数学推理任务上均取得最佳平均性能
摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅报告相对排名结论
limitations: 仅在两个MoE模型上验证，泛化性有待更多模型和规模验证
贪心策略为近似优化，未与穷举最优解进行理论或实验对比
未报告剪枝后推理延迟、吞吐等实际部署指标
papers.practical_value: 面向MoE大模型内存受限部署场景，提供无需重训练的结构保持专家剪枝方案，可在保留75%或50%专家时维持通用与数学推理性能，降低存储开销，适合企业侧模型压缩与推理成本优化。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作从专家输出结构化冗余这一新视角切入MoE剪枝，将问题从独立评分提升为结构保持的子集选择，为MoE压缩提供了可解释且有效的建模范式，对基座模型高效部署有直接参考价值。

papers.title: SACQ: Structure-Aware Codebook Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable capable robot behavior, but their large memory footprint limits deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Weight quantization is a natural remedy, yet post-training quantization (PTQ) recipes inherited from large language models degrade when applied to VLAs at ultra-low precision. Existing low-bit PTQ methods often fail to explicitly account for the structure of downstream operations and allocate precision without considering its effect on the policy actions. We introduce SACQ, an ultra- low-bit weight-only vector-codebook quantization framework for VLAs. SACQ combines (1) structure-aware codebook fitting with role-specific quadratic metrics that reflect input statistics and downstream sensitivity; (2) action-aware mixed-bit allocation based on the increase in final-action error as individual layers are compressed; and (3) two-stage post-quantization refinement that reassigns codeword indices with second-order error compensation and calibrates codebooks and row-group scales against the decoded action. Using GR00T N1.7, SACQ achieves 93.85% average success across four LIBERO suites at 1.5 bits per language/action weight while reducing model memory by 4.83x. With INT8 activation quantization and low-precision attention, it retains 93.55% success while running 1.51x faster than BF16. On SimplER, SACQ further achieves 63.76% and 52.27% success under Visual Matching and Variant Aggregation at 2 bits per language/action weight, compared to 58.90% and 53.45% for BF16, respectively.
papers.summary: SACQ针对超低比特视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型部署时内存受限的问题，指出现有从大语言模型继承的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在超低精度下会失效，且未显式考虑下游算子结构与量化对策略动作的影响。作者提出仅权重量化的向量码本框架SACQ，包含三部分：基于角色特定二次度量、反映输入统计与下游敏感性的结构感知码本拟合；依据逐层压缩引起的最终动作误差增量进行动作感知混合比特分配；以及两阶段量化后精化，通过二阶误差补偿重排码字索引，并针对解码动作校准码本与行组缩放。在GR00T N1.7上，语言/动作权重1.5比特时LIBERO四个套件平均成功率93.85%，内存降低4.83倍；结合INT8激活量化与低精度注意力仍保持93.55%成功率，且比BF16快1.51倍。SimplER上2比特时Visual Matching与Variant Aggregation成功率分别为63.76%和52.27%，对比BF16的58.90%和53.45%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SACQ通过结构感知码本拟合与动作感知比特分配，让VLA模型在1.5-2比特权重下保持甚至超过BF16的任务成功率并显著降低内存。
papers.core_method: 仅权重的向量码本训练后量化框架：用角色特定二次度量进行结构感知码本拟合；按逐层压缩对最终动作误差的增量做动作感知混合比特分配；两阶段量化后精化，包括二阶误差补偿的码字索引重排，以及面向解码动作的码本与行组缩放校准。
innovation_points: 将码本拟合的二次度量与VLA下游算子角色及输入统计绑定，显式考虑结构信息
以最终动作误差增量而非权重重建误差驱动混合比特分配，使精度分配对齐策略行为
两阶段后量化精化：码字索引重排加二阶补偿，并直接以解码动作为目标校准码本与缩放
experiment_results: GR00T N1.7在LIBERO四个套件上，语言/动作权重1.5比特平均成功率93.85%，内存降低4.83倍
结合INT8激活量化与低精度注意力，成功率93.55%，比BF16快1.51倍
SimplER上2比特时Visual Matching 63.76%、Variant Aggregation 52.27%，BF16分别为58.90%和53.45%
limitations: 摘要未报告1.5比特下逐套件成功率方差或与BF16逐套件对比的完整数据
方法依赖校准数据统计与下游敏感性度量，跨机器人平台或任务分布的泛化性未在摘要中验证
仅评估权重向量码本量化，未讨论训练时量化或与激活量化的联合优化空间
papers.practical_value: 面向资源受限机器人平台，SACQ在1.5比特权重下将VLA内存降低约4.8倍且保持高任务成功率，配合INT8激活还可获得1.51倍推理加速，为超低比特VLA片上部署提供可用的PTQ路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 它揭示了LLM式PTQ在VLA超低比特下失效的根因，并给出以动作误差为中心的结构感知量化范式，对具身智能模型压缩与边缘部署有直接参考价值。

papers.title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic manipulation remains a major challenge in robotics, exemplified by piano playing, which requires coordinated control of fingers and provides a demanding testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). Although previous work established a benchmark for robotic piano playing, it is restricted to two hands and does not support unified evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce OmniPiano, a benchmark that provides one to up to five Shadow Hands and supports standard, robust, safe, and multi-agent RL within a shared piano-playing task family. OmniPiano is developed for scalable and diverse piano-playing tasks with configurable perturbations, explicit safety constraints, and decentralized cooperation settings. Particularly, to facilitate usability and extendability, OmniPiano adopts a highly modular design and provides comprehensive tasks to support RL study of task performance, robustness, safety, and cooperation in dexterous control. With at least 912 task settings and 36 baseline algorithms, OmniPiano further incorporates LLM-based agents to broaden the evaluation scope and reveal new insights. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art RL algorithms and frontier LLM-based agents still struggle on challenging piano-playing tasks, even under standard RL settings, highlighting substantial room for improvement in dexterous control. The code, dataset, tutorial, and demo are available at https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/.
papers.summary: OmniPiano 针对灵巧机器人操作中钢琴演奏这一高难度测试场景，指出现有基准仅限双手且缺乏统一评估的问题，提出一个支持1至5只Shadow Hand、覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体强化学习的统一基准。该基准通过可配置扰动、显式安全约束与去中心化协作设置，构建可扩展的多样化钢琴任务族，并采用高度模块化设计以提升可用性与可扩展性。基准包含至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，同时引入基于LLM的智能体以拓宽评估范围。大量评估显示，即使标准RL设定下，先进RL算法与前沿LLM智能体在挑战性钢琴任务上仍表现不佳，表明灵巧控制仍有显著提升空间。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OmniPiano 将钢琴演奏扩展为支持1至5只手、覆盖标准/鲁棒/安全/多智能体RL的统一灵巧操作基准，并揭示现有RL与LLM智能体仍难以胜任。
papers.core_method: 构建统一钢琴演奏任务族，支持1至5只Shadow Hand；通过可配置扰动、显式安全约束和去中心化协作设置，将标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL纳入同一基准；采用模块化设计提供至少912种任务设置和36个基线算法，并引入LLM智能体扩展评估。
innovation_points: 将钢琴演奏基准从双手扩展到1至5只Shadow Hand，支持更丰富的灵巧控制与协作场景。
在统一任务族中同时覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL评估，并提供可配置扰动与显式安全约束。
提供至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，并引入LLM智能体拓宽评估范围。
采用高度模块化设计，提升基准的可用性与可扩展性。
experiment_results: 摘要称大量评估显示先进RL算法与前沿LLM智能体在挑战性钢琴任务上仍表现不佳，即使标准RL设定下也是如此；未给出具体性能数值。
基准包含至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，但摘要未报告各算法的具体得分或排名。
引入LLM智能体进行评估并揭示新见解，但摘要未提供其具体量化结果。
limitations: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，难以量化现有算法与LLM智能体的性能差距。
基准基于Shadow Hand与钢琴演奏场景，向其他灵巧操作任务的泛化性尚未在摘要中说明。
多智能体与安全约束下的评估细节及任务覆盖范围在摘要中未充分展开。
papers.practical_value: 为灵巧机器人操作研究提供统一、可扩展的强化学习基准，覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体协作四类评估需求，便于比较不同RL算法与LLM智能体在复杂协调控制任务上的表现，并推动安全约束与去中心化协作场景下的可复现研究。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将钢琴演奏从双手基准扩展为多手、多范式统一评估平台，填补了灵巧控制中标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL缺乏统一基准的空白，并通过LLM智能体评估揭示现有方法的不足，为后续研究提供可扩展的测试基础。

papers.title: CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision
papers.abstract: Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.
