papers.summary: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能否利用自身动作概率信号预测任务失败。作者提出CalVLA，用成功与失败轨迹及Action-Confidence Alignment（ACal）平方边际排序损失，塑造OpenVLA-7B的原生动作token置信度，并通过低秩适配器更新模型，无需额外失败检测器。观测在同一任务内按相近归一化已用时间配对，而非物理进度等价。在LIBERO-10的500个配置留出测试集上，三个随机种子下联合失败判别AUROC为0.7392±0.0480（130与260步平均）；冻结策略探针为0.6146–0.6436，但优于线性探针的结论统计上不显著。同一置信度汇总下，AUROC从适配前0.4485升至适配后0.7327，平均任务成功率从58%降至55%。结果表明失败判别改善，而非控制能力或安全收益得到确立。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CalVLA通过结果监督让VLA策略的原生动作置信度具备失败判别力，但未提升控制成功率，也未确立安全收益。
papers.core_method: 在OpenVLA-7B上使用低秩适配器，以成功和失败rollout为监督，采用Action-Confidence Alignment（ACal）平方边际排序损失，直接塑造动作token的原生置信度，无需辅助失败检测器；训练样本在同一任务内按相近归一化已用时间配对。
innovation_points: 将失败预测从外接检测器转为策略原生动作token置信度的结果监督校准
提出ACal平方边际排序损失，利用成功/失败rollout对比塑造置信度
用低秩适配器微调OpenVLA-7B，保持参数高效且不引入额外推理模块
按任务内相近归一化时间配对观测，控制时间进度对置信度比较的干扰
experiment_results: LIBERO-10留出测试集（500配置）上，三随机种子联合失败判别AUROC为0.7392±0.0480，取130与260步平均
同一置信度汇总下AUROC从适配前0.4485升至适配后0.7327
冻结策略探针AUROC为0.6146–0.6436，但相对线性探针的优越性统计不显著；平均任务成功率从58%降至55%
limitations: 仅证明失败判别改善，未证明控制能力提升或安全收益
相对线性探针的优越性统计不显著，证据强度有限
配对基于相近归一化已用时间而非等价物理进度，可能引入噪声
papers.practical_value: 为VLA策略提供一种无需额外失败检测器的原生置信度信号，可用于机器人任务执行中的失败预警与人工接管触发；但当前成功率下降且安全收益未确立，落地前需进一步校准与验证。
papers.why_it_matters: 它探索了VLA策略自省能力这一关键方向，把失败判别内化到动作概率中，为具身智能的可靠部署提供了轻量级置信度校准思路，同时诚实报告了控制性能与统计显著性的边界。

papers.title: Design and Development of an AI-Based Voice-Controlled Robot for Intelligent Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Most low-cost voice-controlled robots accept only a handful of fixed words such as “forward” and “stop”, and depend on a smartphone app for speech recognition. This paper presents the design and development of an AI-based voice-controlled mobile robot that holds natural spoken conversations and turns free-form requests into safe movements. The robot is built around an ESP32 microcontroller with an INMP441 I²S MEMS microphone, a MAX98357A I²S class-D amplifier and speaker, an L298N dual H-bridge driving two DC gear motors with wheels, a servo for head and gesture movements, and a 2S pack of 18650 lithium-ion cells with a main switch. A hybrid architecture is used: a compact keyword-spotting model on the ESP32 detects the wake word and a local “stop” command without any network, while the spoken request is streamed to an AI server where speech-to-text, a large language model and text-to-speech produce a structured JSON action and a spoken reply. A command validator on the ESP32 checks every action against a whitelist, speed limits and a time-out before the motors move, so the language model can never drive the robot outside its safe envelope. A review of 19 related studies shows that earlier robots offered either fixed-vocabulary control on cheap hardware or natural-language interaction on expensive platforms, but rarely both. Design calculations show that a 4-second request needs 128 kB of audio, well within the ESP32's memory, and that the battery pack supports an estimated 13.4 h of mixed use. An experimental protocol with metrics for recognition accuracy, latency, safety response and user experience is provided for prototype validation.
papers.venue: International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology
papers.summary: 本文设计并开发了一款基于AI的语音控制移动机器人，旨在解决低成本机器人仅支持固定词汇、依赖手机App进行语音识别的问题。系统以ESP32微控制器为核心，集成I²S MEMS麦克风、I²S D类功放与扬声器、L298N双H桥电机驱动、舵机及18650锂电池组。采用混合架构：ESP32端运行紧凑关键词唤醒模型，本地识别唤醒词与“停止”指令，无需网络；自由语音请求流式传输至AI服务器，经语音转文本、大语言模型和文本转语音生成结构化JSON动作与语音回复。ESP32端命令验证器依据白名单、速度限制和超时机制校验每个动作，确保语言模型无法使机器人超出安全边界。对19项相关研究的综述表明，现有机器人难以兼顾低成本硬件与自然语言交互。设计计算显示4秒请求需128kB音频，在ESP32内存范围内；电池组支持约13.4小时混合使用。论文提供了包含识别准确率、延迟、安全响应和用户体验指标的实验协议，用于原型验证。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出ESP32端唤醒与安全校验、服务器端大模型语义解析的混合架构，在低成本硬件上实现自然语言语音控制机器人并保证动作安全。
papers.core_method: 采用ESP32+INMP441麦克风+MAX98357A功放+扬声器+L298N电机驱动+舵机+18650电池的硬件平台；软件上采用端云混合架构：ESP32本地运行关键词唤醒模型识别唤醒词和“停止”指令，自由语音请求流式上传至AI服务器，由语音转文本、大语言模型和文本转语音生成结构化JSON动作与语音回复；ESP32端命令验证器通过白名单、速度限制和超时机制校验动作后再驱动电机。
innovation_points: 端云混合语音交互架构：本地唤醒与停止保障低延迟和断网安全，云端大模型负责自由语言理解
在ESP32端引入命令验证器，以白名单、速度限制和超时机制约束大模型输出，形成安全执行边界
面向低成本硬件完成自然语言对话式机器人设计，并给出内存与续航的定量设计计算
提供包含识别准确率、延迟、安全响应和用户体验指标的实验验证协议
experiment_results: 论文未报告实际实验数据，仅提供实验协议与指标定义
设计计算表明4秒语音请求需128kB音频，处于ESP32内存范围内
电池组估计支持约13.4小时混合使用
limitations: 尚未给出原型实测的识别准确率、延迟和安全响应数据，验证协议有待执行
依赖网络连接AI服务器完成自由语言理解，离线时仅支持唤醒词和停止等本地指令
综述仅覆盖19项相关研究，且系统面向低成本移动机器人，通用性有待验证
papers.practical_value: 为低成本机器人提供了一条可复用的端云混合语音交互与安全校验设计路径，命令验证器机制可防止大模型输出直接驱动执行器带来的安全风险，适合教育、服务原型和嵌入式AI教学等场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 展示了如何在资源受限的ESP32平台上结合本地唤醒、云端大模型语义解析与硬件级安全校验，为生成式AI落地嵌入式机器人和具身交互提供了工程参考，并强调了大模型输出到物理执行之间的安全约束设计。

papers.title: ROSTrans: Empirically Benchmarking LLMs for ROS1-to-ROS2 Migration
papers.abstract: Although large language models have shown strong capabilities in domain-specific code generation, their performance in robotics software development, especially for the Robot Operating System (ROS), remains largely unexplored. ROS code generation presents distinctive challenges, including complex inter-node coordination, middleware configuration, and lifecycle semantics that go far beyond standard coding benchmarks, and many important correctness properties become observable only once migrated nodes are launched and communicate. We present ROSTrans, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on ROS1-to-ROS2 code migration, a representative and practically important setting for ROS code generation. ROSTrans comprises 108 scaffolded completion tasks drawn from a diverse set of 70+ open-source ROS1 repositories and organized into a hierarchical taxonomy assessing interface-level, behavioral-level and system-level correctness. For every task we establish an executable reference: a verified ROS2 implementation, a runtime test suite that launches the nodes and exercises their topics, services, actions and parameters, and a container ensuring reproducibility. Candidates are scored by injecting only their target files into an otherwise fixed copy of the reference package, so a candidate can neither supply nor weaken the tests it is judged by. Evaluating six frontier LLMs over five stochastic generations per task, we find pass@1 below 10.9%, and that 56.5% of all samples build successfully and then fail at runtime,and 32.0% fail runtime assertions on the migrated interfaces, a class of error no compile-only oracle can detect. Execution-guided repair further improves task success, reaching 49.1% and 47.2% for Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.5 after three rounds, respectively.
papers.summary: ROSTrans 针对大模型在机器人操作系统（ROS）代码生成中的空白，构建了 ROS1 到 ROS2 迁移的基准测试。该基准包含 108 个补全任务，来自 70 多个开源 ROS1 仓库，按接口级、行为级和系统级正确性分层评估。每个任务提供可执行参考：经验证的 ROS2 实现、启动节点并测试话题/服务/动作/参数的运行时测试套件，以及可复现容器。评分时仅将候选生成的目标文件注入固定参考包，防止候选削弱测试。评估六个前沿 LLM（每任务五次随机生成），pass@1 低于 10.9%；56.5% 的样本编译成功但运行时失败，32.0% 在迁移接口上运行时断言失败，这是仅编译检查无法发现的错误。执行引导修复使 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.5 三轮后任务成功率分别达 49.1% 和 47.2%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 现有前沿 LLM 在 ROS1 到 ROS2 迁移任务上 pass@1 不足 11%，运行时正确性构成主要瓶颈，执行引导修复可显著提升成功率。
papers.core_method: 构建 ROSTrans 基准：从 70+ 开源 ROS1 仓库抽取 108 个补全任务，按接口级、行为级、系统级正确性分层；每个任务提供经验证的 ROS2 参考实现、运行时测试套件和可复现容器；评分时仅注入候选目标文件到固定参考包，确保测试不可被削弱；采用 pass@1 和运行时断言失败率评估六个前沿 LLM，并测试执行引导修复。
innovation_points: 首个面向 ROS1-to-ROS2 迁移的 LLM 代码生成基准，覆盖接口、行为和系统三级正确性。
引入可执行参考与运行时测试套件，能检测编译成功但运行时失败的迁移错误。
评分机制隔离候选代码与测试，防止候选削弱或替换测试，保证评估公正。
系统量化执行引导修复对迁移任务成功率的提升效果。
experiment_results: 六个前沿 LLM 的 pass@1 均低于 10.9%。
56.5% 的样本编译成功但运行时失败，32.0% 在迁移接口上运行时断言失败。
执行引导修复三轮后，Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.5 任务成功率分别达 49.1% 和 47.2%。
limitations: 基准仅覆盖 ROS1 到 ROS2 迁移场景，未扩展到其他机器人软件生成任务。
评估仅涉及六个前沿 LLM，未覆盖更广泛模型或微调方法。
执行引导修复依赖运行时反馈，未讨论无执行环境下的替代方案。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人软件工程中 LLM 辅助迁移提供可复现、防作弊的评估基准，揭示运行时正确性这一关键瓶颈，并验证执行引导修复的工程价值，有助于指导企业构建更可靠的 ROS 代码迁移工具链。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作填补了 LLM 在 ROS 代码生成与迁移评估上的空白，指出仅编译通过远不足以保障迁移正确性，为后续研究提供了可执行、可复现的基准和明确的改进方向。

papers.title: $\nabla$Mimic: Ultra-Efficient Humanoid Control with Differentiable Simulation
papers.abstract:
Robot policy learning is dominated by zeroth-order methods such as PPO, which treat the simulator as a black box and pay for it with enormous sample counts. First-order policy learning differentiates through the dynamics, but on contact-rich whole-body control it has rarely worked: its gradients explode. A recent world-model method showed that derivative information can make humanoid motion tracking far more efficient, using surrogate gradients of a learned model. We show that exact gradients of the simulator itself do better, once two obstacles are removed. Exact gradients contain rare unbounded samples, because contact dynamics is not differentiable everywhere and its derivative diverges near some events; and they are expensive, because the simulator's adjoint has to replay the contact solve. $
abla$Mimic bounds these samples with median-relative per-sample gradient clipping at every step of the backward pass, and reuses each costly simulated window by multistep regression onto gradient-derived action targets, which bounds every action target independently of the gradient scale. NablaEngine, a differentiable GPU simulation engine for the Unitree G1, removes the cost: it computes MuJoCo's full contact dynamics with fused per-world kernels and the adjoint of a whole control step as a single megakernel, with analytic gradients that match float64 finite differences, $11.5	imes$ faster than the available MuJoCo Warp adjoint. On whole-body tracking of all 40 LAFAN1 clips with one policy on one GPU, $
abla$Mimic reaches the score reported by the state-of-the-art world-model method, 0.82, in 20 minutes instead of 1.2 h, and 0.874 in 1.8 h. SHAC, the standard first-order baseline, stops on exploding gradients within minutes. We release NablaEngine and $
abla$Mimic as open-source infrastructure for first-order humanoid policy learning.
papers.summary: 该论文研究如何利用可微仿真器的一阶梯度进行人形机器人全身控制策略学习，以替代PPO等零阶方法。作者指出，精确梯度存在两个障碍：接触动力学不可微导致梯度爆炸，以及伴随求解需重放接触求解而代价高昂。为此提出∇Mimic：在反向传播每一步采用中值相对逐样本梯度裁剪，并通过多步回归到梯度导出的动作目标来复用每个仿真窗口，使动作目标独立于梯度尺度；同时构建NablaEngine，一个面向Unitree G1的可微GPU仿真引擎，用融合逐世界内核计算MuJoCo完整接触动力学，并将整个控制步的伴随作为单个巨型内核，其解析梯度与float64有限差分匹配，比MuJoCo Warp伴随快11.5倍。在单GPU上对全部40个LAFAN1片段进行全身跟踪，∇Mimic在20分钟内达到0.82分，1.8小时达到0.874分；标准一阶基线SHAC在数分钟内因梯度爆炸停止。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过梯度裁剪与多步回归稳定精确仿真梯度，并配合高效可微GPU引擎，∇Mimic将人形全身跟踪的一阶策略学习效率提升至20分钟达到0.82分。
papers.core_method: 提出∇Mimic一阶策略学习框架：在反向传播中采用中值相对逐样本梯度裁剪，抑制接触事件附近的无界梯度样本；通过多步回归到梯度导出的动作目标，复用昂贵仿真窗口并约束动作目标尺度；构建NablaEngine可微GPU仿真引擎，以融合逐世界内核和单巨型内核伴随实现MuJoCo完整接触动力学的高效解析梯度。
innovation_points: 针对接触动力学不可微导致的梯度爆炸，提出中值相对逐样本梯度裁剪，在反向传播每一步约束无界样本。
提出多步回归到梯度导出的动作目标，复用每个仿真窗口，使动作目标独立于梯度尺度。
构建NablaEngine，将整个控制步的伴随计算作为单个巨型内核，解析梯度与float64有限差分匹配，比MuJoCo Warp伴随快11.5倍。
在单GPU上以单一策略完成全部40个LAFAN1片段的全身跟踪，显著缩短训练时间。
experiment_results: 在全部40个LAFAN1片段全身跟踪中，∇Mimic在20分钟内达到0.82分，与最先进世界模型方法报告分数持平，后者需1.2小时。
训练1.8小时后达到0.874分。
标准一阶基线SHAC在数分钟内因梯度爆炸停止；NablaEngine解析梯度与float64有限差分匹配，比MuJoCo Warp伴随快11.5倍。
limitations: 摘要未说明方法在更广泛接触场景或不同机器人平台上的泛化能力。
未提供与零阶方法PPO在样本效率上的直接对比数据。
未讨论梯度裁剪与多步回归超参数对最终性能的敏感性。
papers.practical_value: 为第一阶人形机器人策略学习提供开源基础设施NablaEngine与∇Mimic，显著降低训练时间与算力需求，使单GPU在20分钟内完成全身跟踪策略训练，有助于加速人形机器人控制策略的迭代与部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作证明精确仿真梯度在接触丰富的人形全身控制中可行且高效，解决了长期困扰一阶方法梯度爆炸与计算昂贵的两大障碍，并开源引擎与算法，为后续一阶策略学习研究提供可复现的高效基线。

papers.title: Human-Centered Vision-Language-Action Models for Collaborative Robotics: Biosignals, Human-State Estimation, and Shared Autonomy — A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: This systematic review will identify, classify, and synthesise research on foundation-model-based robot systems (vision-language-action, vision-language, and large language models) that collaborate with a human partner in physical tasks, with particular attention to human-centered sensing such as surface electromyography and inertial sensing. Two pre-specified search streams are used: a core stream on foundation-model systems in human–robot collaboration, and an adjacent stream on biosignal-informed human-state estimation for physical collaboration. Sources are Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, IEEE Xplore, and arXiv (core stream only), covering 2015–2026. Screening follows PRISMA 2020 with two independent reviewers, and results are synthesised narratively following the SWiM guideline. The full protocol (v1.2), including validated search strings and pilot results, is attached.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇系统性综述的研究方案（protocol），而非已完成的实证研究。其研究问题是：如何识别、分类并综合基于基座模型（视觉-语言-动作VLA、视觉-语言VL、大语言模型LLM）的机器人系统在与人类伙伴进行物理协作任务时的研究，并特别关注以人为中心的传感（如表面肌电sEMG和惯性传感）所提供的人类状态估计。技术路线采用两条预先设定的检索流：核心流聚焦人机协作中的基座模型系统，邻近流聚焦面向物理协作的生物信号驱动人类状态估计；数据源为Scopus、Web of Science核心合集、IEEE Xplore及arXiv（仅核心流），时间跨度2015–2026年；筛选遵循PRISMA 2020并由两名独立评审者执行，综合采用SWiM指南的叙事性方法。当前材料仅给出协议v1.2、验证过的检索式与试点结果，尚未报告任何纳入研究数量或综合结论。

papers.title: Logged Is Not Done: Verifiable AI Operations for the EU AI Act Era (Part 01 of 15)
papers.abstract: Abstract As AI agents start to act in European critical infrastructure (telecom networks, payment systems, cloud platforms and industrial robots), a recurring gap appears. A system can log that an operation was authorized and acknowledged, yet still be unable to show that the evidence behind it was current, or that the reported result matches what actually happened. This gap matters to obligations under the EU AI Act, including: risk management (Article 9); record-keeping and logging (Article 12); human oversight (Article 14); accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity (Article 15); post-market monitoring and serious-incident reporting (Articles 72–73). This publication presents the foundational part of a 15-part technical series, also submitted as an IETF Internet-Draft. It defines a vendor-neutral evidence-consistency framework built on these elements: every consequential operation receives a stable identity and a declared verification objective; each observation carries its provenance, resource generation, time interval and clock uncertainty; domain-specific checks produce a scoped three-valued result: SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED or UNRESOLVED. UNRESOLVED is a first-class outcome. Missing or stale evidence is recorded honestly rather than reported as success, which gives auditors, oversight personnel and incident investigators a reconstructable decision record. The framework keeps verification separate from authority. A positive result never grants permission to act; any consequential effect stays under a separate, accountable control boundary. Acknowledgement, completion, physical outcome and financial settlement are reconciled as independent evidence. A three-layer architecture keeps shared evidence semantics apart from twelve domain profiles: radio access and network incident recovery; telecom sessions and charging; hardware and DMA command paths; multi-agent negotiation and asynchronous tools; robotics and physical safety; multilingual emergency instructions; browser agents and agent migration; autonomous commerce; accelerator reset. The material is also relevant to engineering work under NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, DORA and the Machinery Regulation. The PDF includes: a reader's summary with diagrams; an analytical latency and capacity model with a measurement plan; 12 proposed verification tests; threat and edge-case profiles; a searchable catalogue of 639 engineering mechanisms. The document describes technical mechanisms and makes no legal-compliance, certification or conformity claim.

papers.summary: 该论文针对AI代理在欧洲关键基础设施中执行操作时，日志记录无法证明证据时效性与结果真实性的缺口，提出一套供应商中立的证据一致性框架。框架为每个重要操作赋予稳定身份与验证目标，每条观测携带来源、资源代际、时间区间与时钟不确定性，领域检查输出SUPPORTED、CONTRADICTED或UNRESOLVED三值结果，并将UNRESOLVED作为一等结果诚实记录。验证与授权分离，正向结果不授予行动权限。三层架构将共享证据语义与十二个领域配置解耦，覆盖电信、支付、机器人、浏览器代理等场景。文档还包含延迟容量模型、12项验证测试、威胁画像与639项工程机制目录，但未报告实证数据。

innovation_points: 将UNRESOLVED作为一等验证结果，诚实记录证据缺失或过期，而非默认成功
验证与授权严格分离，正向验证结果不自动授予行动权限
观测元数据显式包含资源代际、时间区间与时钟不确定性，支持可重建决策记录

papers.title: UGR: Unified Generative Ranking for Heterogeneous E-commerce Recommendation
papers.abstract: List-wise ranking in e-commerce recommendation must balance user utility and commercial value across organic content, ads, and candidates from other businesses, while modeling candidate interactions and sequential dependencies. Existing generative ranking methods typically learn from logged exposure sequences and operate on truncated candidate sets from a single business. Exposure-sequence learning may not fully exploit post-exposure feedback signals. Meanwhile, generative ranking over heterogeneous, multi-business candidates remains less explored, particularly when recommendation scores and advertising value must be jointly modeled under generalized second-price (GSP) auctions. We propose Unified Generative Ranking (UGR), which performs generative ranking over the full request-level multi-business heterogeneous candidate set, typically comprising around a thousand candidates in production, and directly generates multi-business ranking lists through candidate-aware autoregressive decoding. To go beyond exposure-sequence imitation, UGR introduces complementary feedback supervision through weighted supervised fine-tuning and permutation preference optimization, which respectively leverage observed post-exposure feedback and feedback-derived preferences among permutations. UGR uses a training-time advertising debiasing tower to model historical ad exposure effects and incorporates current ad value during serving while preserving the existing allocation and GSP pricing rules. Multi-value sequence retrieval produces candidate ranking lists, and the existing downstream evaluator selects the final list for exposure. Offline experiments demonstrate consistent gains in ranking quality, while online A/B tests on Taobao's Guess You Like recommendation service yield improvements of 1.76% in Core IPV, 3.29% in Transaction Volume, and 2.10% in GMV over the production baseline.
papers.summary: UGR针对电商推荐中多业务异构候选集（约千级）的列表级排序问题，指出现有生成式排序方法依赖曝光序列学习、仅处理单业务截断候选集，且未充分挖掘曝光后反馈信号，也缺乏在GSP拍卖下联合建模推荐分数与广告价值的探索。为此提出统一生成式排序框架，在请求级全量多业务候选集上进行候选感知自回归解码，直接生成多业务排序列表；通过加权监督微调和排列偏好优化引入曝光后反馈监督，突破曝光序列模仿的局限；采用训练期广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光效应，并在服务期融入当前广告价值，同时保持既有分配与GSP定价规则；多价值序列检索产出候选排序列表，由下游评估器选择最终曝光列表。离线实验显示排序质量稳定提升，淘宝猜你喜欢在线A/B测试中核心IPV提升1.76%、交易量提升3.29%、GMV提升2.10%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UGR在千级多业务异构候选集上实现统一生成式排序，通过曝光后反馈监督与广告去偏，在保持GSP机制下同时提升推荐质量与商业价值。
papers.core_method: 以请求级全量多业务异构候选集为输入，采用候选感知自回归解码直接生成多业务排序列表；引入加权监督微调与排列偏好优化，利用曝光后反馈及反馈导出的排列偏好进行互补监督；设置训练期广告去偏塔建模历史广告曝光效应，服务期融入当前广告价值并保持既有分配与GSP定价规则；多价值序列检索生成候选排序列表，由现有下游评估器选择最终曝光列表。

训练期广告去偏塔与服务期广告价值注入相结合，在保持GSP定价规则下联合建模推荐分数与广告价值

papers.title: PFA: Attention Can Be Progressively Focused in Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.
papers.summary: 该论文研究长序列生成式推荐（GR）自回归beam search解码中全注意力带来的在线推理延迟问题。作者分析GR解码注意力模式，发现注意力逐步聚焦于少量关键历史token，且跨解码步的重要性排序相对稳定。据此提出渐进聚焦注意力PFA：首步保留全注意力探索全局偏好，随后通过跨beam加权聚合建立共享重要性排序，将选中token的KV cache重排为连续内存布局，后续解码步复用该排序并几何缩减token预算。在2个公开基准和1个大规模工业数据集上优于SOTA基线，并在某大型电商广告平台7天在线A/B测试中取得业务收益且保持低延迟。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PFA利用GR解码中注意力渐进聚焦与跨步排序稳定的特性，以共享排序和连续KV cache实现低延迟稀疏解码，并在电商广告线上A/B中验证业务增益。
papers.core_method: 首步全注意力探索全局历史偏好；通过跨beam加权聚合建立共享token重要性排序；将选中token的KV cache重排为连续内存布局；后续解码步复用排序并几何缩减token预算，降低计算与内存访问开销。
innovation_points: 揭示GR解码中注意力渐进聚焦与跨步排序一致性两个注意力模式
提出跨beam加权聚合的共享重要性排序，避免每步重复token选择
将选中token的KV cache重排为连续内存布局，降低非连续内存访问开销
后续解码步几何缩减token预算，兼顾关键语义保留与延迟降低
experiment_results: 在2个公开基准和1个大规模工业数据集上优于SOTA基线
在某大型电商广告平台7天在线A/B测试中取得显著业务收益并保持低推理延迟
摘要未给出具体指标数值，无法补充量化结果
limitations: 依赖GR解码注意力模式假设，对其他任务或架构的泛化性未在摘要中说明
首步仍需全注意力，超长序列首步开销可能仍较高
摘要未报告稀疏化对推荐效果的具体损失边界
papers.practical_value: 面向长用户行为序列的生成式推荐在线服务，PFA在beam search解码中降低推理延迟并保持关键语义，适合对延迟敏感的电商广告等大规模线上场景，且已有7天A/B业务验证。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把对GR解码注意力模式的观察转化为可落地的稀疏解码工程方案，同时覆盖公开基准与工业线上A/B，对长序列生成式推荐的在线部署有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Improving Fine-Grained Manipulation through Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design
papers.abstract: Fine-grained manipulation requires a robot policy to follow instructions, remain robust to visual variations, and translate predicted actions into precise robot control. We present Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design (DEED), a framework for adapting a pretrained vision-language-action policy to the five MetaFine tasks through structured demonstration expansion and execution design. DEED generates demonstrations for different instructions from the same initial scene and renders each physical trajectory under different camera positions and lighting conditions while preserving its original states and action targets. A hierarchical sampling strategy balances instructions, trajectories, and visual conditions during supervised adaptation. At deployment, DEED converts predicted action chunks into robot commands using inverse kinematics, gripper mappings selected for each task, and closed-loop replanning. DEED achieves an official Overall score of 85.55%. Fixed-policy evaluations show that performance varies with execution horizon, denoising budget, and gripper mapping.
papers.summary: 本文提出DEED框架，用于将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略适配到MetaFine的五项细粒度操作任务。研究问题在于：细粒度操作要求机器人策略同时具备指令跟随、视觉鲁棒性和精确控制能力，而有限的示范数据与执行设计不足会制约适配效果。技术路线包含两部分：一是结构化示范扩展，即针对同一初始场景为不同指令生成示范，并在保持原始状态与动作目标不变的前提下，将每条物理轨迹在不同相机位置和光照条件下渲染，同时采用分层采样策略在监督适配中平衡指令、轨迹与视觉条件；二是执行设计，在部署阶段通过逆变换运动学、按任务选择的夹爪映射和闭环重规划，将预测的动作块转换为机器人命令。官方评测Overall得分为85.55%，固定策略评估显示性能随执行时域、去噪预算和夹爪映射而变化。
papers.one_line_takeaway: DEED通过示范扩展与执行设计，把预训练VLA策略有效适配到细粒度操作任务，官方Overall得分85.55%。
papers.core_method: 对预训练VLA策略进行监督适配：针对同一初始场景为不同指令生成示范，并在不同相机位置与光照下渲染轨迹且保持状态和动作目标不变；用分层采样平衡指令、轨迹与视觉条件；部署时用逆运动学、任务特定夹爪映射和闭环重规划把动作块转成机器人命令。
innovation_points: 结构化示范扩展：同一初始场景多指令示范，并在多相机、多光照下渲染且保持状态与动作目标不变
分层采样策略：在监督适配中平衡指令、轨迹与视觉条件三类分布
执行设计：逆变换运动学、按任务选择夹爪映射与闭环重规划结合，将动作块转为精确控制命令
experiment_results: 官方评测Overall得分为85.55%
固定策略评估显示性能随执行时域、去噪预算和夹爪映射变化
limitations: 摘要未给出各MetaFine任务的分解结果与对比基线数据
未报告示范扩展规模、渲染条件数量等消融实验细节
执行设计中的夹爪映射按任务人工选择，泛化性未验证
papers.practical_value: 为预训练VLA策略在真实细粒度操作任务上的落地提供了可复用的适配流程：通过低成本示范扩展提升视觉鲁棒性与指令覆盖，并通过执行层设计把动作预测稳定转换为机器人控制命令，对工业与实验室精细操作场景有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
papers.abstract: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations. Here, we show that multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake, spanning history-taking, differential diagnosis, and initial management planning. In a randomized, double-blind crossover study ($N = 60$ matched scenario pairs, 120 encounters) comparing the RL-trained agent against its identically prompted base model, 32 board-certified psychiatrists role-played standardized patients while a separate panel of 15 independent, board-certified psychiatrists scored the de-identified transcripts. The trained agent outperformed the base model in 76.7% of matched scenario pairs ($p < 0.0001$), with gains on an adapted clinical-examination rubric ($d_z = 0.77$, $p < 0.0001$), patient-centered communication (82.0% vs. 65.2%, $p < 0.001$), and differential diagnosis appropriateness (68.3% vs. 33.3%, $p < 0.001$). Across 127 psychiatrist-validated simulated intake scenarios, the trained agent nearly doubled its base model's clinical rubric score (0.706 vs. 0.379; composite reward 0.564 vs. 0.294, $p < 0.0001$). To systematically probe conversational safety, we established two Delphi-consensus taxonomies, of clinical safety risks and relational competencies, from which 256 challenging adversarial presentations were derived; we find that training in simulation environments more than halved under-triage of acute safety risks (12.9% vs. 30.5%, $p < 0.0001$). Simulation environments thus provide a controlled testbed for training and stress-testing psychiatric conversational agents, with gains that transferred to psychiatrist-enacted encounters, though residual gaps require safeguards and clinician oversight.
categories: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare and Education
papers.summary: 该研究针对精神科接诊访谈这一核心诊断环节，探索在仿真环境中用多轮强化学习训练语言模型，使其完成病史采集、鉴别诊断与初始管理规划。研究采用随机双盲交叉设计，60对匹配场景、120次会诊，由32名认证精神科医生扮演标准化病人，15名独立认证精神科医生对去标识化转录评分。结果显示，训练后智能体在76.7%的匹配场景对中优于同提示的基座模型，临床检查量表效应量d_z=0.77，以患者为中心的沟通82.0%对65.2%，鉴别诊断适当性68.3%对33.3%；在127个经精神科医生验证的仿真接诊场景中，临床评分几乎翻倍（0.706对0.379）。研究还基于两套德尔菲共识分类法构建256个对抗性呈现，发现仿真训练将急性安全风险的低分诊率从30.5%降至12.9%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 在仿真环境中进行多轮强化学习，可显著提升语言模型在精神科结构化接诊中的临床检查、沟通、鉴别诊断与安全分诊表现，且效果可迁移至精神科医生扮演的真实式会诊。
papers.core_method: 以语言模型为基座，在受控仿真接诊环境中采用多轮强化学习进行后训练；使用标准化病人角色扮演与多轮对话交互，结合临床检查量表、患者中心沟通、鉴别诊断适当性及安全风险分诊等信号构建复合奖励；通过随机双盲交叉设计与独立精神科医生评分面板评估，并利用德尔菲共识分类法生成对抗性场景进行安全性压力测试。
innovation_points: 将多轮强化学习后训练应用于精神科接诊访谈这一高风险、长程对话任务，覆盖病史采集、鉴别诊断与初始管理规划全流程

papers.title: Language-Grounded Force/Torque Pretraining for Extrinsic Contact Perception
papers.abstract: Fine manipulation requires robots to recognize when a grasped object makes or changes contact with its environment, yet such extrinsic contact is not always directly observable from vision or local contact geometry. Force and torque signals carry this information, but also vary with object weight, grasp configuration, and robot motion, leaving it unclear whether they can provide a reusable representation of physical state. Here we show that bilateral six-axis force/torque histories can be pretrained as a semantically structured physical representation by aligning them with a frozen language space using supervision generated from simulated pick-and-place interactions. On unseen objects in simulation, the learned representation supports text-prototype readout of robot action, object weight, and grasp interaction. In real-world placement, unlabeled calibration enables contact and support-state recognition without updating the encoder, outperforming a vertical-force sign-reversal rule baseline. For connector insertion, an event absent from pretraining, low-rank adaptation improves data-efficient learning over training from scratch. These results show that force/torque histories can support both direct readout of known physical states and efficient adaptation to new extrinsic-contact events.
papers.summary: 该论文研究机器人精细操作中外在接触（物体与环境接触状态）难以从视觉或局部几何直接观测的问题，提出将双侧六轴力/力矩历史信号与冻结语言空间对齐，从而预训练出语义结构化的物理表征。监督信号来自仿真抓取-放置交互生成的语言描述。在仿真未见物体上，该表征支持以文本原型读出机器人动作、物体重量与抓取交互信息；在真实放置任务中，无需更新编码器，仅用无标签校准即可识别接触与支撑状态，优于垂直力符号反转基线；在预训练中未出现的连接器插入任务上，低秩适配相比从头训练显著提升数据效率。结果表明力/力矩历史既能直接读出已知物理状态，也能高效适配新的外在接触事件。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用语言对齐的双侧六轴力/力矩历史预训练，可获得可读出且可高效适配的外在接触物理表征。
papers.core_method: 以仿真抓取-放置交互生成的语言监督，将双侧六轴力/力矩历史编码器与冻结语言空间对齐进行预训练；下游采用文本原型读出，真实场景用无标签校准，新事件用低秩适配微调。
innovation_points: 将力/力矩历史作为可预训练的物理表征，并与冻结语言空间语义对齐

papers.title: Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies
papers.abstract: Flow policies are among the strongest robot controllers and are well suited to modelling multimodal action distributions. Our analysis shows that the continuous-action distributions of the studied flow policies are well approximated by Gaussians. We propose the Gaussian Action Readout (GAR), which replaces a flow policy's final layer with a Gaussian readout trained on just 0.02% of eligible states, while keeping the rest of the network frozen. It samples with one action-network pass, gives closed-form likelihoods, and achieves near-teacher task success at up to twice the inference speed.
papers.summary: 该论文研究流策略（flow policies）在机器人控制中的推理效率问题。作者首先分析发现，所研究的流策略的连续动作分布可被高斯分布良好近似。基于此，提出高斯动作读出（Gaussian Action Readout, GAR）：将流策略的最后一层替换为高斯读出层，仅用0.02%的可用状态训练该层，同时冻结网络其余部分。GAR只需一次动作网络前向即可采样，并提供闭式似然，在保持接近教师策略任务成功率的同时，推理速度最高提升至两倍。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 流策略的动作分布近似高斯，仅替换末层并微调0.02%状态即可在保持成功率的同时将推理速度提升至两倍。
papers.core_method: 分析流策略动作分布的高斯近似性；将流策略最后一层替换为高斯读出层，冻结其余网络，仅用0.02%的可用状态训练该读出层；推理时单次前向采样并给出闭式似然。
innovation_points: 发现所研究的流策略连续动作分布可被高斯良好近似
提出GAR：仅替换末层为高斯读出并冻结主干，训练成本极低（0.02%状态）
单次前向采样并提供闭式似然，推理速度最高提升至两倍
experiment_results: 达到接近教师策略的任务成功率
推理速度最高提升至两倍
摘要未给出具体成功率数值与任务细节
limitations: 高斯近似假设可能不适用于所有流策略或更复杂的多模态动作分布

papers.why_it_matters: 揭示了流策略动作分布的高斯结构，并给出极简的末层蒸馏方案，在几乎不损失成功率的前提下显著降低推理开销，对机器人策略的实时部署有直接参考价值。

papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Reasoning informs decision-making by connecting intended actions with their expected consequences. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate embodied chains of thought (ECoTs) to guide action generation. However, such guidance remains implicit, as actions are conditioned on ECoTs rather than explicitly optimized to align with them. We introduce CoRAct, a consequence-grounded reasoning-to-action alignment framework that explicitly aligns reasoning and action through reward-guided optimization in action noise space. CoRAct formulates two physically grounded ECoT components as verifiable signals: movement specifies intended motion, while waypoints encode expected spatial consequences. A unified Mixture-of-Transformers jointly models ECoT reasoning, action generation, and action-conditioned future prediction. For candidate actions generated from sampled noise, CoRAct computes alignment rewards based on movement consistency and agreement between predicted outcomes and specified waypoints. These rewards guide group-relative optimization of the initial noise distribution, steering action generation toward consistency with intended actions and expected consequences. Experiments across RoboCasa, VLABench, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements in task success, generalization, and reasoning-execution alignment over strong ECoT-based VLA baselines. CoRAct also grounds externally provided ECoTs in executable behavior, enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel scenarios by leveraging knowledge from powerful vision-language models. Project page and dataset: https://onlyxingxingzyx.github.io/CoRAct/
papers.summary: 针对现有VLA模型仅将动作条件化于具身思维链（ECoT）而缺乏显式对齐的问题，本文提出CoRAct框架，将推理到动作的过程转化为后果驱动的对齐优化。方法上，把ECoT中的运动意图与路点空间后果作为可验证信号，用统一Mixture-of-Transformers联合建模推理、动作生成与动作条件未来预测；在动作噪声空间采样候选动作，依据运动一致性与预测结果-路点一致性计算对齐奖励，并以组相对优化更新初始噪声分布，使生成动作与意图及预期后果一致。在RoboCasa、VLABench及真实操作任务上，相较强ECoT基线，任务成功率、泛化与推理-执行对齐均有提升，并可将外部ECoT落地为可执行行为，实现零样本适应新场景。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CoRAct用后果驱动的奖励在动作噪声空间显式对齐ECoT推理与动作生成，提升VLA的任务成功率与推理-执行一致性。
papers.core_method: 将ECoT分解为运动意图与路点空间后果两类可验证信号；用Mixture-of-Transformers联合建模ECoT推理、动作生成和动作条件未来预测；从采样噪声生成候选动作，按运动一致性与预测-路点一致性计算对齐奖励，以组相对优化更新初始噪声分布。
innovation_points: 把ECoT从隐式条件改为显式可验证信号，用运动一致性与路点一致性构造对齐奖励
在动作噪声空间做组相对优化，直接调整生成动作的初始噪声分布而非仅条件化
统一Mixture-of-Transformers同时建模推理、动作与动作条件未来预测，形成闭环验证
支持将外部ECoT落地为可执行行为，实现零样本新场景适应
experiment_results: 在RoboCasa、VLABench及真实操作任务上，相较强ECoT-based VLA基线，任务成功率、泛化与推理-执行对齐均有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）

奖励设计基于运动一致性与路点一致性，对更抽象或非空间后果的推理覆盖有限
摘要未报告具体量化指标与消融，难以评估各组件贡献
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作等具身场景，提供将高层推理显式落到可执行动作的对齐训练范式，可利用强VLM的外部ECoT实现零样本新场景适应，降低推理与执行脱节带来的部署风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把VLA中“推理指导动作”从隐式条件化推进为可优化的对齐目标，给出可验证信号与噪声空间奖励优化的具体路线，对提升具身策略的可靠性与泛化有参考价值。

papers.title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
papers.abstract: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena. The core bottleneck is that creating better simulations requires significant expert effort and therefore does not scale. To address this, we introduce Gym-Anything for Robotics, a framework in which coding agents create realistic robotics simulations. Our core insight is that simulation creation is a coding agent task, so improvements in coding agents translate directly into richer and more faithful simulations. We select simulations based on U.S. GDP data to cover economically valuable physical work, define what makes a good simulation and a good task, and develop an adversarial creation-audit loop that checks each simulation and task against these definitions. Using this pipeline, we build RoboWorld, a set of 25 simulations with 25 test and 175 training RL environments of varying difficulty. Even the best frontier models fail on every RoboWorld test task, achieving an average reward of only 0.06. Building on RoboWorld, we introduce several new ways for frontier models to improve, including in-context learning across repeated attempts, a privileged teacher that reads the simulator state and teaches a student in context, self-assisted learning from the model's own privileged experience, and code policies that generate demonstrations across varied scenes to train vision-language-action models (VLAs) such as $π_{0.5}$. Each of these substantially improves performance. We release our pipeline, RL environments, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Code and data are available at https://gym-anything.github.io/robotics
papers.summary: 该论文针对机器人仿真环境覆盖范围窄、依赖专家手工构建、难以规模化的问题，提出将仿真创建本身视为编码智能体任务，从而让编码智能体的能力提升直接转化为更丰富、更真实的仿真。作者依据美国GDP数据选择具有经济价值的物理工作场景，定义优质仿真与任务的标准，并设计对抗式创建-审计循环来校验每个仿真与任务。基于该流水线构建了RoboWorld，包含25个仿真、25个测试与175个训练RL环境，难度各异。实验显示最强前沿模型在所有测试任务上均失败，平均奖励仅0.06；论文进一步提出跨重复尝试的上下文学习、读取仿真器状态的特权教师、自辅助学习以及生成演示训练VLA（如π0.5）等改进路径，均带来显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 把机器人仿真创建交给编码智能体，可用GDP导向的任务筛选与对抗式审计规模化生成RL环境，并暴露前沿模型在物理任务上的严重不足。
papers.core_method: 将仿真创建建模为编码智能体任务：按美国GDP数据选取经济价值高的物理工作场景，定义优质仿真与任务标准，构建对抗式创建-审计循环自动检查并迭代仿真与任务，最终生成RoboWorld基准（25个仿真、25个测试与175个训练RL环境）。
innovation_points: 把仿真环境构建从专家手工工程转变为编码智能体任务，使编码智能体进步可直接扩展仿真丰富度与保真度

跨重复尝试的上下文学习、特权教师、自辅助学习与代码策略生成演示等改进方式均带来显著性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）
limitations: 摘要未报告各改进方法的具体量化提升幅度与统计细节
仿真覆盖范围仍受GDP场景选择与编码智能体能力边界约束
未提供从仿真到真实世界迁移的实证结果
papers.practical_value: 为具身AI与VLA训练提供可规模化生成的RL环境与基准，降低对专家手工构建仿真的依赖；GDP导向的场景选择使仿真更贴近高经济价值物理工作，代码策略生成演示可直接用于训练视觉-语言-动作模型。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把仿真创建这一瓶颈转化为可随编码智能体进步而自动扩展的工程问题，并公开流水线、RL环境与基准，为机器人基础模型的大规模训练与评测提供新范式。

papers.title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated promising capabilities in robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Recent advances have further incorporated future prediction to enhance the understanding of environmental dynamics and task progression. However, existing methods often model short-term dynamics and long-term task objectives separately, while directly incorporating predicted futures into action policies without sufficiently considering their relevance to current action requirements. To address these limitations, we propose HiFOR, a hierarchical foresight framework with action-guided world retrieval. Specifically, Hierarchical Foresight Prediction jointly predicts short-term state evolution, semantic milestones, and final goal states through a Hierarchical Dependency Mask (HDM), establishing dependencies across temporal horizons. Building upon these predictions, Structure-Aware Latent World Modeling organizes future latent representations along the horizon, view, and spatial dimensions to facilitate fine-grained retrieval. Furthermore, Action-Guided Factorized World Retrieval adaptively retrieves relevant future information from the structured latent world based on evolving action representations during denoising, providing targeted guidance for action generation. Extensive experiments on two simulation benchmarks and six real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary: HiFOR 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中未来预测与动作生成脱节的问题，提出分层前瞻框架。现有方法将短期动态与长期任务目标分开建模，且把预测未来直接注入动作策略，未充分考虑其与当前动作需求的相关性。HiFOR 通过分层依赖掩码（HDM）联合预测短期状态演化、语义里程碑与最终目标状态，建立跨时间尺度的依赖；再用结构感知潜在世界建模，沿时间、视角与空间维度组织未来潜在表示以支持细粒度检索；最后在去噪过程中依据演化的动作表示，自适应检索相关未来信息，为动作生成提供定向引导。实验在两个仿真基准和六个真实机器人操作任务上验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
papers.one_line_takeaway: HiFOR 用分层前瞻预测加动作引导的世界检索，让 VLA 模型按当前动作需求取用未来信息，而非盲目注入预测。
papers.core_method: 分层前瞻预测（HDM 联合建模短期状态、语义里程碑与最终目标）+ 结构感知潜在世界建模（按时间/视角/空间组织未来表示）+ 动作引导的因子化世界检索（去噪中按动作表示自适应检索未来信息）。
innovation_points: 用分层依赖掩码统一短期动态与长期目标预测，建立跨时间尺度依赖
将未来潜在表示结构化组织为时间、视角、空间维度，支持细粒度检索
在动作去噪过程中以演化动作表示引导未来信息检索，实现按需取用
experiment_results: 在两个仿真基准和六个真实机器人操作任务上验证有效性
摘要未提供具体量化指标，无法报告数值结果
limitations: 摘要未给出定量结果与消融细节，效果幅度无法评估
真实任务仅说明数量，未披露任务类型与评测协议
检索机制引入额外计算开销，摘要未讨论实时性
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作场景，强调预测未来与当前动作需求的对齐，为 VLA 策略在真实任务中提供更定向的未来引导，具备工程落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出未来预测不能直接注入策略，而应按动作需求检索，为 VLA 中世界模型与动作生成的耦合提供了新设计范式。

papers.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
papers.abstract: Human cognition flexibly draws on a shared perceptual foundation to understand environments, attend to referenced entities, reason about spatial relationships, and act. Endowing aerial robots with an analogous functional organization remains challenging, as existing systems are often specialized for individual capabilities, dependent on offboard computation, or unable to sustain closed-loop operation on resource-constrained platforms. We present OpenFlyV2, a unified onboard vision-language-action architecture that uses a shared vision-language representation to support semantic understanding, language-grounded perception, spatial reasoning, and continuous aerial control within a single model. A compact action expert converts the shared multimodal context into short-horizon flight waypoints, while motion-aware temporal memory and action priors reduce the computational cost of closed-loop execution. We construct \dataset{}, a simulation-based dataset comprising approximately 70,000 navigation trajectories and 60,000 vision-language instruction--response pairs. OpenFlyV2 generates action chunks, each comprising 12 waypoints, entirely onboard at 10 Hz using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. It transfers zero-shot from simulation to physical quadrotor flight, achieving a 48\% navigation success rate across four real-world environments without real-world aerial training data. Extensive results demonstrate that broad vision-language competence and continuous closed-loop flight can coexist within a single model on a resource-constrained aerial platform. Code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/Ideal-ljl/AeroBrain.
papers.summary: OpenFlyV2面向资源受限的空中机器人，提出统一机载视觉-语言-动作架构，用共享视觉-语言表征同时支撑语义理解、语言定位感知、空间推理与连续飞行控制。模型通过紧凑动作专家将多模态上下文转为短时域航点，并借助运动感知时序记忆与动作先验降低闭环执行计算开销。作者构建约7万条导航轨迹和6万条视觉-语言指令-响应对的仿真数据集。在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上，模型以10 Hz完全机载生成每块12个航点的动作块，零样本从仿真迁移到真实四旋翼，在四个真实环境中取得48%导航成功率，且未使用真实空中训练数据。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OpenFlyV2证明在资源受限的机载平台上，单一模型可同时具备广谱视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞行控制，并实现仿真到真实四旋翼的零样本迁移。
papers.core_method: 采用统一视觉-语言-动作架构：共享视觉-语言表征支撑语义理解、语言定位感知与空间推理；紧凑动作专家将多模态上下文解码为短时域航点动作块；引入运动感知时序记忆与动作先验以降低闭环推理成本；基于仿真构建约7万条导航轨迹和6万条视觉-语言指令-响应对进行训练。
innovation_points: 统一机载VLA架构，在同一模型中耦合语义理解、语言定位感知、空间推理与连续空中控制
紧凑动作专家输出短时域航点动作块，配合运动感知时序记忆与动作先验降低闭环计算开销
构建大规模仿真导航轨迹与视觉-语言指令-响应对数据集，支撑联合训练
在Jetson Orin NX上实现10 Hz完全机载闭环执行，并零样本迁移到真实四旋翼
experiment_results: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上完全机载运行，以10 Hz生成每块12个航点的动作块
零样本从仿真迁移到真实四旋翼，在四个真实环境中取得48%导航成功率，未使用真实空中训练数据
limitations: 真实环境导航成功率为48%，仍有较大提升空间
真实世界评估仅覆盖四个环境，泛化范围有限
依赖仿真数据训练，仿真到真实的差距仍是主要约束
papers.practical_value: 为资源受限的空中机器人提供可完全机载运行的统一感知-推理-控制模型，减少对离线计算的依赖，支持在Jetson级边缘平台上以10 Hz闭环飞行；零样本仿真到真实迁移降低了真实空中数据采集与训练成本，对无人机自主导航产品化具有直接工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作回应了空中机器人领域的关键工程矛盾：广谱视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞行控制能否在资源受限机载平台上共存。其统一架构、动作块生成与机载实时执行方案，为后续机载VLA系统设计与仿真到真实迁移提供了可复现的技术路线。

papers.title: RoboSeed: Multidimensional Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models: Capability, Resource Affordability, and Research Evidence
affiliations: Xi’an University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract: Choosing a robot action model requires evidence about task capability, adaptation cost, deployment requirements, and the reliability of reported conclusions. Success rates alone offer limited guidance to researchers with different computing budgets and goals. We propose RoboSeed, a multidimensional evaluation framework for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM), within a continuing program to train, evaluate, and openly release robot models with verifiable evidence for model selection. The framework defines five dimensions: capability, downstream training affordability, deployment affordability, locally verified research value, and reproduction evidence. It maps empirical measurements and audit criteria to 0-100 profiles using fixed normalization anchors, with balanced, training-constrained, and deployment-constrained preference settings. Interface and protocol checks establish when comparisons are appropriate. Missing measurements remain explicit, incomplete aggregate scores are withheld, and weighted input coverage identifies evidence gaps. We apply the framework to representative VLA and WAM models, drawing on local training, released-weight evaluation, task-level audits, and an evaluation-system study. The results reveal budget-dependent backbone choices, sensitivity to adaptation recipes, and differences between language and visual task interfaces. Reproducible scoring code and machine-readable evidence support extension to additional models. The study provides dimension-level assessments and priorities for further measurement, while incomplete serving traces and heterogeneous protocols preclude overall numerical rankings.
papers.summary: RoboSeed 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界-动作模型（WAM）选型中仅凭成功率难以指导不同算力预算研究者的问题，提出多维评估框架。框架定义能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地可验证研究价值与复现证据五个维度，用固定归一化锚点将经验测量与审计标准映射为0-100画像，并提供均衡、训练受限、部署受限三种偏好设置；通过接口与协议检查判定比较是否适当，缺失测量显式保留、不完整聚合分数不予给出，以加权输入覆盖率标识证据缺口。作者在代表性VLA与WAM模型上结合本地训练、发布权重评估、任务级审计与评估系统研究进行应用，结果显示骨干选择依赖预算、对适配配方敏感、语言与视觉任务接口存在差异。研究给出维度级评估与后续测量优先级，但因服务轨迹不完整与协议异质，未给出总体数值排名。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboSeed 用五维可审计画像替代单一成功率，揭示VLA/WAM选型随算力预算与适配配方而变，并因证据缺口拒绝总体排名。
papers.core_method: 构建五维评估框架（能力、下游训练可负担性、部署可负担性、本地可验证研究价值、复现证据），以固定归一化锚点将经验测量与审计标准映射为0-100画像，设均衡/训练受限/部署受限三种偏好权重；用接口与协议检查约束可比性，缺失测量显式保留、不完整聚合分数扣留，并以加权输入覆盖率标识证据缺口；配套可复现评分代码与机器可读证据。
innovation_points: 将评估从单一成功率扩展为能力、训练成本、部署成本、研究价值与复现证据五维画像
引入固定归一化锚点与三种预算偏好设置，使不同算力目标的研究者可比较选型
以接口/协议检查判定比较适当性，缺失测量显式保留、不完整聚合分数扣留，避免误导性排名
提供可复现评分代码与机器可读证据，支持扩展到更多模型
experiment_results: 在代表性VLA与WAM模型上应用框架，发现骨干选择依赖预算、对适配配方敏感、语言与视觉任务接口存在差异
因服务轨迹不完整与协议异质，未给出总体数值排名，仅提供维度级评估与后续测量优先级
摘要未提供具体量化指标数值
limitations: 服务轨迹不完整，难以支撑部署维度的完整测量
协议异质导致跨模型总体数值排名不可行
框架目前仅应用于代表性模型，扩展性有待更多模型验证
papers.practical_value: 为不同算力预算的研究者与工程团队提供可审计的VLA/WAM选型依据，显式暴露证据缺口，避免被单一成功率误导；可复现评分代码与机器可读证据便于企业按训练或部署约束定制偏好权重。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把机器人动作模型评估从排行榜式成功率转向预算感知、证据可审计的多维画像，并诚实扣留不完整排名，对模型选型与复现研究具有方法论价值。

papers.title: AI for Science in Space: Orbital Laboratories, Planetary Fieldwork, and Embodied Autonomy
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence for science (AI4S) is extending from interpretation of existing data to the design and execution of experiments. Space offers distinctive scientific opportunities while restricting physical support. Microgravity and extraterrestrial environments expose phenomena that terrestrial experiments cannot fully reproduce; finite samples, constrained resources, and limited opportunities for intervention complicate sustained investigation. This critical review examines orbital laboratories and planetary in situ science across biology, materials, fluid and thermal physics, and adaptive exploration. We distinguish learning from space-derived data, selecting scientific actions, executing them, and preserving experimental validity. Terrestrial self-driving laboratories provide complementary evidence on optimization, dedicated automation, robotic manipulation, and the support needed for unattended operation. The synthesis connects scientific gains already demonstrated by bounded AI systems to gaps in observation, executable actions, and continuity of valid evidence. Space robots can expand the attainable scope of autonomous science when necessary interventions exceed validated instrument capabilities and timely human support is unavailable. Their value must be established against dedicated mechanisms, redundancy, and human-supported operation. We develop a framework connecting sample history, scientific decisions, physical execution, and claim-specific validity. A worked orbital design, a planetary extension, and matched evaluation schemes separate the contributions of sensing, decision policies, and physical actions. The resulting agenda measures autonomy through valid scientific return, task coverage, intervention costs, and evidence integrity across complete campaigns.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇批判性综述，考察AI4S在空间场景中从数据解释走向实验设计与执行的问题。作者区分了从空间数据学习、选择科学行动、执行行动与保持实验有效性四个环节，并以地面自驱动实验室在优化、专用自动化、机器人操作与无人值守支持方面的证据作补充。文章提出连接样本历史、科学决策、物理执行与主张特定有效性的框架，并给出一个轨道设计示例、一个行星扩展方案及匹配评估方案，用以分离传感、决策策略与物理行动的贡献。结论强调空间机器人只有在必要干预超出已验证仪器能力且及时人力支持不可得时才有价值，其收益须对照专用机制、冗余与有人支持运行来评估，并以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本与证据完整性衡量自主性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 空间AI4S的关键不是让模型解释更多数据，而是以有效科学回报和证据完整性来衡量从决策到物理执行的闭环自主。
papers.core_method: 批判性综述与框架构建：将空间科学自主性拆分为空间数据学习、科学行动选择、物理执行和实验有效性保持四个环节；以地面自驱动实验室的优化、专用自动化、机器人操作和无人值守支持为对照证据；提出连接样本历史、科学决策、物理执行与主张特定有效性的分析框架，并设计轨道示例、行星扩展和匹配评估方案来分离传感、决策与行动的贡献。
innovation_points: 将AI4S在空间中的能力边界明确区分为数据学习、行动选择、物理执行与有效性保持，避免把数据解释能力等同于实验自主。
提出以样本历史—科学决策—物理执行—主张特定有效性为核心的框架，用于追踪完整科学活动中的证据链。
设计轨道示例、行星扩展与匹配评估方案，以分离传感、决策策略和物理行动各自的贡献。
主张以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本和证据完整性作为自主性的衡量指标，而非单纯任务完成率。
experiment_results: 本文为批判性综述，未报告新的实验数据或定量结果。
文中引用地面自驱动实验室在优化、专用自动化、机器人操作和无人值守运行方面的互补证据，但摘要未给出具体数值。
提出轨道设计示例、行星扩展方案和匹配评估方案作为方法学示例，未提供实测性能数据。
limitations: 作为综述，未提供新的实验验证或定量基准结果。
空间机器人自主性的价值判断依赖与专用机制、冗余和有人支持运行的对照，但文中未给出统一成本模型或量化比较。
框架中的证据完整性、干预成本等指标如何在实际任务中操作化，仍需后续工作细化。
papers.practical_value: 为空间站实验、行星原位探测和无人值守科学载荷的AI系统设计提供评估思路：应把样本历史、决策依据、物理执行和证据有效性纳入同一链条，并以有效科学回报、任务覆盖、干预成本和证据完整性衡量自主系统，而非只看模型精度或任务完成率。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把空间AI4S从“用模型分析数据”推进到“用可验证证据衡量自主实验”的问题设定，为判断空间机器人何时真正优于专用仪器和有人支持运行提供了可操作的评估框架。

papers.title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Experience can help embodied agents turn high-level plans into grounded actions, but transferring it across tasks remains challenging: previously effective strategies may be inapplicable to the current state or fail to produce their intended outcomes. We present EmbodiExp, a framework for constructing transferable experiences and composing them online during embodied task execution. Our key observation is that tasks often share subgoals whose completion can be assessed independently of overall task success. We therefore introduce an outcome-grounded subgoal experience that specifies a subgoal, applicability conditions, an adaptable policy, and a verifiable outcome. During execution, applicable experiences guide action generation, while verified outcomes can establish the conditions required by subsequent experiences, enabling online composition. Subgoal-level outcome attribution further enables failure utilization: failed trajectories can still contribute verified local successes and condition-specific guidance on actions to avoid. Experiments on multiple embodied benchmarks under a fold-based protocol with frozen experience banks demonstrate the effectiveness of EmbodiExp.
papers.summary: EmbodiExp 研究具身智能体跨任务经验迁移难题：已有有效策略可能不适用于当前状态或无法产生预期结果。作者提出以子目标为单元构建可迁移经验，每条经验包含子目标、适用条件、可调整策略和可验证结果；执行时匹配适用经验引导动作生成，已验证结果可为后续经验建立所需条件，实现线上组合。子目标级结果归因还使失败轨迹可被利用，从中提取局部成功与条件特定的避错指导。实验在多个具身基准上采用基于折叠的协议与冻结经验库，验证了方法有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 以可验证子目标结果为经验单元，实现具身智能体跨任务经验的在线组合与失败复用。
papers.core_method: 提出结果锚定的子目标经验表示，每条经验由子目标、适用条件、可适应策略和可验证结果四元组构成；执行时检索适用经验引导动作生成，并用已验证结果建立后续经验所需条件，实现经验在线组合；通过子目标级结果归因，从失败轨迹中提取已验证局部成功和条件特定避错指导。
innovation_points: 以子目标而非完整任务为经验迁移单元，利用子目标完成可独立评估的特性提升跨任务复用性
经验包含适用条件与可验证结果，支持执行中条件传递与在线组合
子目标级结果归因使失败轨迹转化为可复用经验，包括局部成功与避错指导

papers.title: A Review on the Development and Key Technologies of Embodied Intelligent Industrial Robots in Smart Manufacturing
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Industrial robots are widely deployed in manufacturing systems to execute repetitive and predefined tasks. However, with the rise of Industry 4.0 and the growing demand for flexible, customized, and human‐centered production, conventional industrial robotic systems increasingly face limitations in adaptability, autonomy, and interaction capability. In this context, embodied intelligent industrial robots (EIIRs) are emerging as a promising paradigm for next‐generation smart manufacturing. Unlike conventional advanced industrial robots, EIIRs are characterized not merely by stronger sensing or more powerful models, but by a closed‐loop intelligence paradigm grounded in body‐environment interaction, feedback‐driven adaptation, and task‐oriented action execution. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the development, defining characteristics, key technologies, representative applications, and future trends of EIIRs in smart manufacturing. First, the conceptual foundations and defining characteristics of EIIRs are clarified, with particular emphasis on physical embodiment, perception‐action coupling, feedback‐driven closed‐loop adaptation, and grounded mapping from semantic goals to physical actions. Second, the key technological architecture of EIIRs is analyzed from the perspectives of embodied perception, embodied decision‐making and task planning, and embodied control and execution, together with a comparative discussion of traditional hierarchical architectures and embodied closed‐loop architectures. Third, the practical value of EIIRs is examined through representative industrial scenarios, including robotic welding, robotic grinding, precision assembly, human–robot collaboration, and multi‐robot cooperation. Finally, the major technical challenges, future evolution path, and critical turning points of EIIRs are discussed, including industrial world models, long‐horizon task execution, sim‐to‐real transfer, real‐time deployment, and safety assurance. This review aims to provide a structured reference for understanding how embodied intelligence can drive the transition of industrial robotics from predefined automation toward grounded, adaptive, and context‐aware task execution in smart manufacturing.
papers.summary: 该综述聚焦智能制造中具身智能工业机器人（EIIR）的发展与关键技术。作者首先厘清EIIR的概念基础与定义特征，强调物理具身、感知—动作耦合、反馈驱动的闭环适应以及从语义目标到物理动作的落地映射，而非仅靠更强传感或更大模型。其次从具身感知、具身决策与任务规划、具身控制与执行三个层面分析关键技术架构，并对比传统分层架构与具身闭环架构。随后通过机器人焊接、打磨、精密装配、人机协作和多机器人协同等代表性工业场景讨论其实践价值。最后梳理工业世界模型、长时程任务执行、仿真到现实迁移、实时部署与安全保障等挑战与未来演进路径。
papers.one_line_takeaway: EIIR的核心不是更强感知或更大模型，而是以身体—环境交互和反馈闭环实现从语义目标到物理动作的落地执行，推动工业机器人从预定义自动化走向自适应任务执行。
papers.core_method: 综述性方法：先界定EIIR概念与定义特征（物理具身、感知—动作耦合、反馈驱动闭环适应、语义到动作的落地映射），再按具身感知、具身决策与任务规划、具身控制与执行三层技术架构展开分析，并与传统分层架构对比；结合焊接、打磨、精密装配、人机协作、多机器人协同等场景讨论应用价值，最后归纳技术挑战与演进路径。

从感知、决策规划、控制执行三层构建EIIR关键技术架构，并系统对比传统分层架构与具身闭环架构
将具身智能讨论落到焊接、打磨、精密装配、人机协作、多机器人协同等真实工业场景
梳理工业世界模型、长时程任务执行、仿真到现实迁移、实时部署与安全保障等关键转折点

papers.practical_value: 为智能制造企业和技术团队提供EIIR的结构化技术参考：帮助理解从预定义自动化向具身闭环自适应执行的转型路径，指导在感知、决策规划、控制执行三层上的技术选型与架构设计，并提示工业世界模型、长时程任务、仿真到现实迁移、实时性与安全等落地关键约束。
papers.why_it_matters: 具身智能正成为工业机器人升级的重要方向，但概念泛化、架构不清。该综述给出清晰的EIIR定义、三层技术架构与工业场景映射，并系统列出工程化挑战，适合作为理解具身智能如何驱动工业机器人从自动化走向自适应执行的结构化入口。

papers.title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) reformulates item retrieval as autoregressive generation of discrete semantic identifiers (SIDs), offering a unified paradigm for personalized recommendation. GR4AD, as an industrial generative recommendation framework, has greatly improved advertising revenue while enabling efficient real-time serving in Kuaishou. However, continued deployment has exposed three limitations: deterministic SID assignment remains sensitive to semantic boundaries; conventional backbone scaling provides diminishing revenue gains under strict serving constraints; and sequence-level value optimization provides limited credit assignment to intermediate SID decisions, causing likelihood-based beam search to prematurely prune potentially high-value candidates. We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Specifically, GR4AD-X improves SID reliability through Multi-Path assignment. It expands model capacity along multiple complementary dimensions rather than relying solely on wider or deeper backbones, achieving a better effectiveness-efficiency trade-off under strict serving constraints. Finally, Unified Value-Guided Generation and Discrimination (UniVGD) aligns generation with commercial value through prefix-level reward optimization, value-guided beam pruning, and discriminative reranking within a unified model. Large-scale online A/B tests on the Kuaishou advertising platform demonstrate that GR4AD-X achieves a cumulative revenue improvement of 3.07% over the deployed GR4AD baseline while satisfying strict latency and throughput constraints.
papers.summary: 该论文面向快手广告场景的生成式推荐系统GR4AD，针对其线上部署后暴露的三个问题提出GR4AD-X：确定性SID分配对语义边界敏感、常规骨干网络扩容在严格服务约束下收益递减、序列级价值优化对中间SID决策的信用分配不足导致基于似然的beam search过早剪枝高价值候选。方法上分别采用多路径SID分配提升SID可靠性、沿多个互补维度扩展模型容量以在服务约束下取得更优效费比、以及统一价值引导的生成与判别（UniVGD），通过前缀级奖励优化、价值引导的beam剪枝和判别式重排将生成与商业价值对齐。快手广告平台大规模在线A/B测试显示，GR4AD-X在满足严格时延与吞吐约束下相较已部署的GR4AD基线实现累计收入提升3.07%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GR4AD-X通过多路径SID分配、多维度容量扩展与统一价值对齐，在严格线上约束下将快手广告生成式推荐的累计收入较GR4AD基线提升3.07%。
papers.core_method: 在GR4AD框架上提出三项改进：多路径SID分配缓解确定性语义ID对边界的敏感性；沿多个互补维度而非仅加宽加深骨干来扩展容量，以在服务约束下取得更优效费比；UniVGD在统一模型内结合前缀级奖励优化、价值引导的beam剪枝与判别式重排，将生成过程与商业价值对齐。
innovation_points: 多路径SID分配提升语义标识构建的可靠性，降低对语义边界的敏感性
多维度容量扩展策略，在严格时延与吞吐约束下取得更优效果-效率权衡
UniVGD统一价值引导的生成与判别，通过前缀级奖励优化改善中间SID决策的信用分配
价值引导的beam剪枝与判别式重排缓解似然beam search过早剪枝高价值候选的问题
experiment_results: 快手广告平台大规模在线A/B测试：相较已部署的GR4AD基线，累计收入提升3.07%
线上测试同时满足严格的时延与吞吐约束（摘要未给出具体时延与吞吐数值）
摘要未提供离线对比实验的量化数据
limitations: 摘要未报告消融实验，三项改进各自的独立贡献不明确
仅在快手广告单一业务场景验证，跨平台与跨场景泛化性未知
摘要未给出时延、吞吐等约束的具体数值与容量扩展的量化收益
papers.practical_value: 面向大规模广告生成式推荐的工业部署，直接回应SID构建可靠性、服务约束下的容量扩展和价值对齐三类线上工程问题，并已在快手广告平台通过在线A/B验证收入增益，对同类生成式推荐系统的落地具有参考价值。

papers.title: LLM‐Enhanced Semantic Information Alignment for ID Recommendation
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Identity‐based Recommendation (IDR) plays a crucial role in modern personalized recommendation systems by leveraging users' identity information and historical interactions to model long‐term user preferences. However, existing IDR methods face three critical challenges: difficulty in fully capturing latent user preference, limited representational capacity, and poor adaptability to cold‐start scenarios. To address these issues, we propose the LLM‐Enhanced Semantic Information Alignment for ID Recommendation (ESIA‐IDR) framework, which systematically integrates semantic features generated by large language models (LLMs) into ID‐based recommendation. ESIA‐IDR first employs LLMs to deeply perceive unstructured textual data, such as user reviews and product descriptions, thereby effectively mining users' latent interest patterns. An independent pretraining mechanism is then applied to optimize the training dynamics of semantic and ID embeddings, mitigating inconsistencies in convergence behavior. Additionally, a feature discretization strategy is adopted to enhance semantic feature compatibility with traditional recommendation pipelines. During the recommendation phase, semantic‐enhanced features and collaborative signals are jointly modeled to achieve robust performance in cold‐start environments. ESIA‐IDR consists of four key components: Semantic and Interest Perception, Semantic Alignment, Discrete Feature Construction, and Recommendation Integration. By combining pretraining, dimensionality reduction, and similarity‐based bucketing, the framework achieves effective alignment between semantic features and ID feature spaces, bridging the semantic‐structural gap and improving user preference modeling accuracy. Extensive experiments on multiple real‐world datasets demonstrate that ESIA‐IDR achieves a 2.21% improvement in NDCG and a 1.48% improvement in Hit Rate compared to the best‐performing baselines, validating its effectiveness in enhancing recommendation performance.
papers.summary: 该论文针对基于身份的推荐（IDR）在捕捉潜在用户偏好、表征能力与冷启动适应性上的不足，提出ESIA-IDR框架，将大语言模型生成的语义特征系统性地注入ID推荐流程。方法包含四个组件：语义与兴趣感知（用LLM理解用户评论、商品描述等非结构化文本）、语义对齐（独立预训练机制缓解语义嵌入与ID嵌入收敛行为不一致）、离散特征构建（通过降维与相似度分桶的特征离散化提升与传统推荐管线的兼容性）、推荐融合（语义增强特征与协同信号联合建模）。在多个真实数据集上，相较最优基线NDCG提升2.21%、命中率提升1.48%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ESIA-IDR通过LLM语义特征与ID特征空间的对齐及离散化，在保持传统ID推荐管线兼容的同时提升偏好建模与冷启动表现。
papers.core_method: 用LLM从用户评论与商品描述中挖掘潜在兴趣语义；对语义嵌入与ID嵌入采用独立预训练以缓解收敛不一致；通过降维与相似度分桶做特征离散化，使语义特征适配传统推荐管线；最终将语义增强特征与协同信号联合建模完成推荐。
innovation_points: 将LLM语义特征系统性对齐到ID推荐的特征空间，桥接语义与结构之间的鸿沟
针对语义嵌入与ID嵌入收敛行为不一致，设计独立预训练机制优化训练动态
采用降维加相似度分桶的离散化策略，提升语义特征与传统推荐管线的兼容性
语义增强特征与协同信号联合建模，面向冷启动场景提升鲁棒性
experiment_results: 在多个真实数据集上，相较最优基线NDCG提升2.21%
Hit Rate提升1.48%
摘要未给出各数据集的分项结果、消融实验与冷启动专项指标，需查阅全文确认
limitations: 提升幅度相对有限（NDCG 2.21%、HR 1.48%），实际业务收益需进一步验证
依赖用户评论、商品描述等文本质量，文本稀疏或噪声较大场景下语义感知效果可能受限
摘要未披露离散化分桶粒度、预训练成本与线上推理开销等工程细节
papers.practical_value: 框架以插件式方式将LLM语义特征接入既有ID推荐管线，离散化设计降低了对线上系统的改造成本，对文本资源较丰富的电商、内容平台在冷启动与长周期偏好建模上具有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它给出了LLM语义信号落地传统ID推荐的一种可工程化路径：重点不在替换ID体系，而在对齐、离散化与联合建模，对关注生成式语义特征与工业推荐系统结合的读者有借鉴意义。

papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Pairwise Ranking Aggregation via Active LLM Feedback
papers.abstract: Ranking aggregation from multiple retrievers is a powerful yet under-explored technique in modern retrieval and RAG systems. We introduce LLM-IRA, the first extension of the quantum-inspired interactive ranking aggregation framework to document reranking. By leveraging large language models (LLMs) solely for pairwise judgments on high-disagreement document pairs, our method learns fusion weights in a principled, interactive way. The final ranking is a simple, ultra-fast pointwise linear fusion of scores, no full pairwise matrix or expensive listwise prompting is required. Experiments on the BEIR benchmark and TREC Deep Learning tracks with an open-weight instruction-tuned judge (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) show that LLM-IRA matches or numerically exceeds strong static fusion baselines on 5 of 6 evaluated benchmarks. We report two weight-update variants: momentum blending and a full accumulated-history refit, which together reach statistical significance (Wilcoxon signed-rank, p<0.05) over the best unsupervised aggregator on 4 of 6 benchmarks (DL19 under momentum; DL20, DBpedia, and NFCorpus under accumulated refit, which is the stronger of the two configurations overall). On the benchmarks we profiled (DL19, DL20), it already clears the best unsupervised baseline within as few as 5 LLM calls per query, well before exhausting its typical ~25--30 call budget. LLM-IRA also achieves cost-effectiveness comparable to state-of-the-art zero-shot LLM rerankers at an order of magnitude fewer LLM calls, and requires no training data or model fine-tuning.
papers.summary: 该论文提出LLM-IRA，将量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架首次扩展到文档重排序。方法仅用大语言模型对高分歧文档对做成对判断，以交互方式学习多检索器融合权重，最终排序采用极快的逐点线性融合，无需完整成对矩阵或昂贵的列表式提示。在BEIR和TREC DL上，使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct作为开放权重指令微调评判器，LLM-IRA在6个基准中的5个匹配或数值上超过强静态融合基线；两种权重更新变体（动量混合与全历史累积重拟合）合计在4个基准上相对最佳无监督聚合器达到统计显著（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p<0.05）。在DL19、DL20上每查询仅约5次LLM调用即超过最佳无监督基线，远低于典型25-30次调用预算，且无需训练数据或微调。
papers.one_line_takeaway: LLM-IRA用少量高分歧文档对的LLM成对判断学习检索器融合权重，以极低LLM调用成本实现可媲美甚至超越强静态融合与零样本LLM重排序的聚合效果。
papers.core_method: 扩展量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架：仅对高分歧文档对调用LLM做成对偏好判断，交互式更新各检索器融合权重；最终排序为逐点线性分数融合，避免完整成对矩阵和列表式提示；提供动量混合与全历史累积重拟合两种权重更新变体。
innovation_points: 首次将量子启发的交互式排序聚合框架扩展到文档重排序场景
仅对高分歧文档对进行LLM成对判断，显著降低LLM调用成本
最终采用逐点线性融合，推理超快且无需完整成对矩阵或列表式提示
无需训练数据或模型微调，并给出动量混合与累积重拟合两种权重更新策略
experiment_results: 在BEIR和TREC DL的6个基准中，5个上匹配或数值超过强静态融合基线
两种权重更新变体合计在4个基准上相对最佳无监督聚合器达到统计显著（Wilcoxon符号秩检验，p<0.05）
在DL19、DL20上每查询约5次LLM调用即超过最佳无监督基线，低于典型25-30次调用预算；成本效益与先进零样本LLM重排序器相当，LLM调用量少一个数量级
limitations: 实验仅使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct单一开放权重评判器，未验证其他LLM评判器的泛化性
统计显著性仅在6个基准中的4个上成立，并非全部基准
方法依赖高分歧文档对的选择策略，其阈值与调用预算对效果的影响未充分展开
papers.practical_value: 为RAG与多检索器系统提供低成本、免训练的排序聚合方案：仅需少量LLM成对判断即可学习融合权重，线上推理为超快线性融合，适合对延迟和调用成本敏感的真实检索业务。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把LLM的判断能力用在信息量最高的高分歧文档对上，以极少调用换取可学习的融合权重，兼顾效果、成本与部署简洁性，为多路召回融合和RAG重排序提供了可落地的工程路径。

papers.title: SkillCT: A Multidimensional Benchmark and Execution-Free Baseline for Agent Skill Assessment
papers.abstract: Agent skills package instructions, scripts, and resources for specialized tasks and are increasingly distributed through public Web repositories. However, existing skill benchmarks primarily focus on downstream task execution, insufficiently assessing specification quality, behavioral robustness, semantic alignment, and responsibility boundaries. Their reliance on task-specific tools, environments, and repeated executions limits scalability and pre-deployment assessment. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillCT, a benchmark that broadens skill assessment from downstream utility to a multidimensional characterization of skill quality. SkillCT evaluates skills across nine complementary dimensions spanning three aspects: Static Assessment, which captures intrinsic properties of the skill specification; Dynamic Assessment, which measures whether the induced behavior remains stable across backbone models and request variations; and Human-Assisted Assessment, which examines behavior-chain consistency and task granularity. These dimensions provide a broader view of skill quality than execution success. Applying SkillCT to a public skill corpus establishes a reference benchmark for analyzing quality weaknesses and relationships across dimensions. Building on this benchmark, we propose an execution-free quality evaluation baseline that predicts the multidimensional quality profiles of unseen skills by retrieving and leveraging similar reference skills, without executing the skills under evaluation. This reduces token consumption and evaluation time, while preserving consistency with the full assessment. Furthermore, SkillCT-guided optimization improves downstream task success and execution efficiency, demonstrating its value for skill refinement. These findings highlight the effectiveness of SkillCT in supporting scalable skill assessment, optimization, and repository maintenance.
papers.summary: 针对现有Agent技能基准过度依赖下游任务执行、难以评估规范质量与行为鲁棒性的问题，本文提出SkillCT多维技能评估基准，将技能质量从单一执行效用扩展为静态、动态、人工辅助三方面共九个互补维度的刻画：静态评估捕捉技能规范的内在属性，动态评估衡量诱导行为在不同基座模型与请求变体下的稳定性，人工辅助评估考察行为链一致性与任务粒度。作者在公开技能语料上构建参考基准，分析质量弱点与维度间关系，并提出免执行的质量评估基线，通过检索相似参考技能预测未见技能的多维质量画像，在保持与完整评估一致性的同时降低token消耗与评估时间。SkillCT引导的优化还能提升下游任务成功率与执行效率。

papers.title: PailitaoMMSearch2.0 Technical Report: Scaling Generative Retrieval to Unified End-to-End Multimodal Search
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval models have been increasingly adopted in search and recommendation systems. However, industrial generative retrieval models are commonly specialized to a fixed online scenario: they learn from scenario-specific interactions, support a narrow set of query forms and retrieval objectives. We study how to remove these couplings and build a unified end-to-end multimodal search system for open-ended image--text queries, heterogeneous shopping intents, and online scenarios with different resource constraints. We present \textbf{PailitaoMMSearch}, which directly generates product Semantic IDs from a raw query image and free-form instruction and scales along three dimensions. \textbf{Data scaling} uses a reusable toolset that can be composed into intent- and lifecycle-specific workflows for cold-start synthesis, quality control, real-traffic refinement, and continuous data production. \textbf{Intent scaling} progressively equips one model with e-commerce product knowledge, multiple retrieval relations, and adjustable reasoning budgets through continual pre-training (CPT), mixed-budget supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and unified reinforcement learning (RL). The RL stage combines intent-balanced optimization and Sample--Beam rollouts aligned with multi-candidate serving. \textbf{Scenario scaling} exposes quality--cost operating points across model capacity and reasoning budget. The system is deployed in multimodal search applications on Taobao Pailitao. A controlled online A/B test reports statistically significant improvements, including item page views $\textbf{+17.90\%}$, transactions $\textbf{+27.04\%}$, and gross merchandise value $\textbf{+8.94\%}$.
categories: Advanced Image and Video Retrieval Techniques
papers.summary: PailitaoMMSearch2.0 针对工业生成式检索模型通常绑定单一在线场景、仅支持有限查询形式与检索目标的问题，提出统一端到端多模态搜索系统，直接从原始查询图像与自由指令生成商品 Semantic ID。系统沿三个维度扩展：数据维度以可复用工具集组合出面向冷启动合成、质量控制、真实流量精炼与持续生产的工作流；意图维度通过持续预训练注入电商商品知识、混合预算监督微调赋予多种检索关系、统一强化学习（意图均衡优化与对齐多候选服务的 Sample-Beam rollout）调节推理预算；场景维度给出模型容量与推理预算下的质量—成本操作点。系统已部署于淘宝拍立淘多模态搜索，受控在线 A/B 测试报告点击商品页浏览量 +17.90%、交易 +27.04%、GMV +8.94% 的显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PailitaoMMSearch2.0 用统一端到端多模态生成式检索替代场景专用模型，并在淘宝拍立淘线上 A/B 中取得显著交易与 GMV 增益。

papers.title: KL-MOPD: Discrepancy-Aware Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Coordinating multiple recommendation objectives (e.g., click and conversion) is critical for real-world generative recommendation (GR). However, since a positive item in GR can be retrieved only when its tokens are successively selected at every decoding step, traditional item-wise methods lack fine-grained token-wise supervision to guide intermediate steps. Motivated by its success in foundation models, we consider introducing multi-objective on-policy distillation (MOPD) into GR to distill two single-objective teachers into a student at each token. Yet, we find that in vanilla MOPD, (i) teachers exhibit unequal distillation difficulty at each token (i.e., token-level imbalance), and (ii) the harder-to-distill teacher varies across tokens (i.e., cross-token inconsistency), leaving each objective poorly learned at certain steps and hindering positive item retrieval for both objectives, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this challenge, we propose KL-MOPD (KL-Weighted Multi-Objective On-Policy Distillation), a simple yet effective distillation method that allocates token-wise teacher weights proportional to the initial student-teacher token-wise KL divergences, thereby strengthening supervision for the harder-to-distill teacher at every decoding step. Despite its simplicity, we theoretically prove that KL-MOPD strictly outperforms vanilla MOPD in the additive joint recommendation objective under mild conditions. Moreover, KL-MOPD is plug-and-play and computationally efficient, requiring only a one-time pre-training weight calibration with negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks, a billion-scale industrial dataset, and online A/B tests on our e-commerce advertising platform demonstrate that KL-MOPD significantly improves both individual and joint recommendation performance. The anonymous code is provided for peer review.
papers.summary: 该论文研究生成式推荐（GR）中多目标（点击与转化）协调问题。GR按token逐级解码，传统item级方法缺乏token级细粒度监督。作者将基础模型中的多目标在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）引入GR，用两个单目标教师逐token蒸馏学生，但发现原始MOPD存在token级不平衡（各token上教师蒸馏难度不同）和跨token不一致（难蒸馏的教师随token变化）两个问题，导致某些解码步上目标学习不足、正例检索受损。为此提出KL-MOPD，按初始学生-教师token级KL散度分配教师权重，在每个解码步加强对难蒸馏教师的监督。理论上证明在温和条件下KL-MOPD在加性联合推荐目标上严格优于原始MOPD；方法即插即用，仅需一次性预训练权重校准，训练开销可忽略。在三个公开基准、十亿级工业数据集和电商广告平台在线A/B测试上，单目标与联合推荐性能均显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: KL-MOPD按token级KL散度动态加权多目标教师，解决生成式推荐中多目标在线蒸馏的token级不平衡与跨token不一致问题，并在工业在线A/B中验证有效。
papers.core_method: 将多目标在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）引入生成式推荐，把两个单目标教师逐token蒸馏进一个学生；提出KL-MOPD，以初始学生-教师token级KL散度为比例分配各token上的教师权重，在每个解码步强化对更难蒸馏教师的监督；权重仅需一次性预训练校准，方法即插即用、计算高效。
innovation_points: 首次将多目标在线策略蒸馏引入生成式推荐，实现token级多目标监督而非item级监督
识别并形式化原始MOPD在GR中的token级不平衡与跨token不一致两个失效模式
提出按初始KL散度分配token级教师权重的KL-MOPD，并理论证明其在加性联合目标下严格优于原始MOPD
方法即插即用，仅需一次性权重校准，训练开销可忽略
experiment_results: 在三个公开基准和十亿级工业数据集上，KL-MOPD显著提升单目标与联合推荐性能
在电商广告平台在线A/B测试中验证了实际业务收益
理论证明在温和条件下KL-MOPD在加性联合推荐目标上严格优于原始MOPD
limitations: 教师权重依赖初始学生-教师KL散度的一次性校准，学生训练过程中分布漂移后权重是否仍最优未在摘要中说明

papers.practical_value: 面向真实电商广告推荐场景，在十亿级工业数据和线上A/B中验证，可直接用于点击与转化等多目标联合优化；即插即用、仅需一次性校准、训练开销可忽略，工程落地成本低，适合在生成式推荐系统中替换或增强现有多目标蒸馏方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把基础模型中的在线策略蒸馏迁移到生成式推荐，并针对GR逐token解码特性指出原始MOPD的失效模式，给出有理论保证且工程友好的修正方案，同时具备公开基准、十亿级工业数据和在线A/B三层证据，对多目标生成式推荐的训练方法研究与实践均有参考价值。

papers.title: Latent Residual Reasoning for Ranking in Generative Recommendation
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) models for ranking typically adopt a fast-thinking direct prediction paradigm with strong practical efficiency. However, ranking requires fine-grained scoring across multiple candidate items, while existing GR models still mainly rely on one-shot prediction. This raises the question whether additional inference-time computation can further improve ranking quality. Recently, inspired by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning in large language models (LLMs), some work has begun to introduce reasoning into recommendation systems. Some of these methods rely on LLM reasoning frameworks to perform explicit reasoning in textual space, but such designs are not suitable for more widely deployed non-textual recommendation models. A more relevant direction is to introduce latent reasoning into ID-based recommendation models. Although recent work has extended latent reasoning to industrial ranking, how successive reasoning steps should improve fine-grained candidate scores remains less explored. To address this problem, we propose Refiner, a latent residual reasoning framework with parameter-efficient fine-tuning for generative ranking. Our approach introduces three key components: (1) a residual reasoning mechanism that progressively refines ranking scores through cumulative additive corrections, (2) history queries that provide condensed user behavior representations to enhance candidate-specific reasoning, and (3) a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy that leverages LoRA modules to adapt pre-trained models for latent reasoning. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks, an offline industrial dataset, and an online A/B test demonstrate that Refiner consistently improves over direct prediction, validating its effectiveness and practical utility.
papers.summary: 该论文研究生成式推荐（GR）排序中一次性直接预测是否可通过额外推理时计算提升细粒度打分。针对文本空间显式推理不适合广泛部署的非文本ID类推荐模型的问题，提出Refiner潜空间残差推理框架，包含三项关键组件：残差推理机制通过累积加性修正逐步精炼排序分数；历史查询提供压缩的用户行为表示以增强候选特定推理；基于LoRA的参数高效微调策略使预训练模型适配潜空间推理。在两个公开基准、一个离线工业数据集和在线A/B测试上，Refiner相对直接预测取得一致提升，验证了其有效性与实用价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Refiner用潜空间残差推理和LoRA微调，让ID类生成式排序模型通过多步累积修正提升细粒度打分，并在离线与在线A/B中稳定优于直接预测。
papers.core_method: 在ID类生成式推荐排序模型上引入潜空间残差推理：以预训练模型为基座，通过LoRA参数高效微调适配推理；每一步推理产生加性残差修正并累积精炼候选排序分数；同时用历史查询提供压缩的用户行为表示，增强候选特定推理。

设计历史查询作为压缩用户行为表示，为候选特定推理提供上下文
采用LoRA参数高效微调，使预训练ID类推荐模型适配潜空间多步推理，避免文本空间显式推理的部署限制
experiment_results: 在两个公开基准和一个离线工业数据集上，Refiner相对直接预测取得一致提升
在线A/B测试表明Refiner优于直接预测，验证实际效用
