papers.core_method: 采用案例研究法，跟踪一家编程工业机器人的中小企业，在两天集中实践（Focus Days）中让工程师使用可自主执行多步编程任务的AI智能体，任务涉及厂商专用语言与仿真工具视觉反馈；通过观察与对比分析智能体对生产力的影响，并考察AI经验与机器人工程经验的作用差异。
innovation_points: 将AI智能体编程研究从通用软件开发迁移到工业机器人工程这一细分、厂商专用语言与仿真反馈场景
区分AI使用经验与机器人工程经验对智能体成功的影响，发现前者更重要
揭示智能体效果随时间与领域适配改善的强学习曲线，强调纵向研究必要性
experiment_results: 智能体未使工程师整体生产力提升，仅高度重复代码生成任务例外
智能体使用效果随时间改善，工程师学会使用且智能体被适配到领域
AI经验对智能体成功的影响大于机器人工程经验
limitations: 仅为单一中小企业两天案例研究，样本与时间有限，结论外推需谨慎
未提供量化生产力指标或统计检验数据
智能体配置与领域适配的具体细节未充分展开
papers.practical_value: 为企业引入AI智能体提供现实预期：不应期待即插即用，需投入工程师培训、预留学习曲线时间，并针对厂商专用语言与仿真反馈定制智能体配置；同时提示管理者以纵向视角评估AI生产力收益。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究以真实工业场景揭示AI智能体在细分工程领域的落地约束，纠正“即插即用”预期，并为AI生产力评估方法（纵向研究）与企业采纳策略提供实证依据。

papers.title: Whale You Go Green? Immediate and Longitudinal Effects of Embodied Conversational AI Avatars on Sustainable Behavioral Tendencies and Pro-Environmental Attitudes
papers.abstract: Embodied conversational AI can be persuasive, but can it motivate people to develop sustainable behavioral tendencies and increase pro-environmental attitudes? We conducted a randomized experiment (N = 576) comparing four embodied avatars--a beluga whale, Greta Thunberg, Emma Watson, and a generic human--with a text chatbot and no-intervention control. All embodied conditions increased immediate sustainable product selection relative to the control (beta = .401-.609, all q <= .0126) and chatbot (beta = .398-.604, all q <= .007), without differing significantly from one another. Only the Beluga condition increased immediate pro-environmental attitudes relative to the control after correction. Among 287 returners assessed two months later, following an intermediate assigned-condition session, Beluga also showed significantly higher pre-booster sustainable product choice compared to the control (beta = .657, q = .0176). Although it did not significantly outperform other embodied agents, these findings establish the immediate potential of nonhuman embodied avatar interfaces as a promising direction for memorable environmental interventions.
papers.summary: 本研究通过随机实验（N=576）检验具身对话式AI头像能否促进可持续行为倾向与亲环境态度。实验比较白鲸、Greta Thunberg、Emma Watson、通用人类四种具身头像与纯文本聊天机器人及无干预对照组。结果显示，所有具身条件均显著提升即时可持续产品选择（相对控制组β=.401-.609，q≤.0126；相对聊天机器人β=.398-.604，q≤.007），但具身条件间无显著差异；校正后仅白鲸条件显著提升即时亲环境态度。两个月后对287名回访者（其间接受一次同条件强化会话）评估，白鲸组在强化前可持续产品选择仍显著高于控制组（β=.657，q=.0176）。研究表明非人类具身头像界面是 memorable 环境干预的有希望方向，但未显著优于其他具身代理。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 非人类具身对话头像（白鲸）可产生即时且部分持续的可持续行为促进效果，但未显著优于人类具身头像。
papers.core_method: 随机对照实验：N=576被试随机分配至四种具身对话AI头像（白鲸、Greta Thunberg、Emma Watson、通用人类）、纯文本聊天机器人或无干预控制组；测量即时可持续产品选择与亲环境态度；两个月后对287名回访者进行强化会话前测，检验纵向效应。
innovation_points: 首次系统比较非人类具身头像（白鲸）与人类具身头像及纯文本聊天机器人在可持续行为干预中的效果
采用即时与两个月纵向追踪相结合的实验设计，检验干预的记忆保持与持续效应
发现所有具身条件均优于文本与控制组，但具身类型间无显著差异，提示具身性本身而非特定形象是关键
experiment_results: 所有具身条件即时可持续产品选择显著高于控制组（β=.401-.609，q≤.0126）和聊天机器人组（β=.398-.604，q≤.007）
校正后仅白鲸条件即时亲环境态度显著高于控制组
两个月后287名回访者中，白鲸组强化前可持续产品选择显著高于控制组（β=.657，q=.0176）
limitations: 纵向样本仅287名回访者，存在 attrition 偏倚风险
具身条件间无显著差异，无法确定特定头像优势的稳健性
仅测量行为倾向与态度，未观察真实长期行为改变
papers.practical_value: 为可持续消费推广提供低成本、可扩展的对话式AI干预设计依据：具身头像（尤其非人类形象）可提升即时产品选择，白鲸形象在纵向态度保持上具潜力，适合嵌入电商或环保宣传场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究将具身对话AI从说服效果拓展至可持续行为干预，并首次提供纵向证据，为非人类头像在环境传播中的记忆性与持续影响提供实验依据，对AI说服设计与公共政策具参考价值。

papers.title: OneLatent: Latent Reasoning for Efficient Foundation Recommendation Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning capabilities, motivating their use as the backbone of foundation recommendation models (FRMs). Existing methods enhance recommendations through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning under a Think-then-Answer paradigm. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead by generating lengthy reasoning traces and relies on manually designed templates that struggle to capture diverse, dynamic user interests. We propose OneLatent, an efficient latent reasoning framework that compresses explicit reasoning traces into several learnable latent tokens, enabling Latent-Reason-then-Answer inference without generating verbose traces. OneLatent first introduces Multi-View Adaptive CoT (MV-ACoT), which creates diverse, high-quality teacher-generated supervision by exploring user interests from multiple perspectives and automatically adapting reasoning complexity to each instance. Building on pretrained FRMs, it then uses a three-stage latent-token alignment paradigm to progressively internalize CoT traces into learnable latent tokens. Finally, a multistage curriculum-based post-training strategy activates latent-token reasoning for downstream recommendation tasks. Experiments on an industrial-scale Kuaishou dataset and the public Kuaishou LLM-Rec benchmark show that OneLatent consistently outperforms explicit CoT-based methods and traditional baselines. Compared with the Think and No-Think variants of FRMs, OneLatent improves SID@64 by 17.44% and 9.33%, respectively, while achieving over 17x higher online inference throughput. We further develop a production serving system for scalable, real-time FRM inference. An online A/B test in Kuaishou's local-services advertising scenario shows that deploying OneLatent with this system yields an estimated 9.6% revenue lift over strong online baselines, including OneRec and OneReason.
papers.summary: OneLatent针对基础推荐模型（FRM）中显式思维链（CoT）推理带来的推理开销大、依赖人工模板且难以刻画动态用户兴趣的问题，提出一种高效隐式推理框架。该方法首先构建多视角自适应CoT（MV-ACoT），从多角度生成多样化且推理复杂度自适应的教师监督信号；随后在预训练FRM上采用三阶段隐式token对齐范式，将显式CoT轨迹逐步内化为可学习的隐式token；最后通过多阶段课程式后训练激活隐式token推理能力，实现“隐式推理后作答”的推理模式。在快手工业级数据集和公开LLM-Rec基准上，OneLatent一致优于显式CoT方法与传统基线，相比Think与No-Think变体SID@64分别提升17.44%和9.33%，线上推理吞吐提升超过17倍；快手本地服务广告场景的在线A/B测试显示相对OneRec、OneReason等强基线带来约9.6%的收入提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OneLatent用可学习隐式token替代冗长显式CoT，在提升推荐效果的同时将线上推理吞吐提高17倍以上，并已在快手广告场景验证收入增益。
papers.core_method: 提出多视角自适应CoT（MV-ACoT）生成多样化、复杂度自适应的教师推理监督；在预训练FRM上设计三阶段隐式token对齐范式，将显式CoT轨迹逐步压缩并内化为可学习隐式token；再以多阶段课程式后训练激活隐式token推理能力，实现Latent-Reason-then-Answer推理，并配套面向实时FRM推理的生产级服务系统。
innovation_points: 用少量可学习隐式token压缩显式CoT推理轨迹，避免生成冗长推理文本，显著降低推理开销
MV-ACoT从多视角探索用户兴趣并自动适配每个样本的推理复杂度，减少对人工模板的依赖
三阶段隐式token对齐加多阶段课程式后训练，将显式推理能力渐进内化到基座推荐模型中
面向工业部署构建可扩展的实时FRM推理服务系统，并完成在线A/B验证
experiment_results: 在工业级快手数据集与公开快手LLM-Rec基准上一致优于显式CoT方法及传统基线
相比FRM的Think与No-Think变体，SID@64分别提升17.44%和9.33%，线上推理吞吐提升超过17倍
快手本地服务广告场景在线A/B测试中，相对OneRec、OneReason等强在线基线估计带来9.6%收入提升
limitations: 隐式token推理的可解释性弱于显式CoT，推理过程难以直接审阅
方法依赖教师生成的CoT监督与多阶段对齐、课程式后训练流程，训练管线较复杂
线上收益仅在快手本地服务广告单一场景验证，跨业务泛化性仍需更多证据
papers.practical_value: 直接面向工业级推荐系统部署：隐式推理大幅降低线上推理成本并提升吞吐，配套生产服务系统支持实时FRM推理；在线A/B显示可量化的收入提升，为生成式推荐从显式CoT走向高效隐式推理提供可落地路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 它回应了生成式推荐中显式CoT“效果好但太贵、太依赖模板”的核心工程矛盾，用隐式token内化推理能力，并给出从离线指标到线上收入与吞吐的完整工业验证，对基座推荐模型的推理系统设计具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OPTICYCLE and OPTISTATE, two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B-27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage points. Despite their simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows in same-model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes, without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.
papers.summary: 该论文研究大语言模型作为优化建模智能体时，能否在不额外训练的情况下，通过轻量推理框架可靠生成正确的优化模型与求解器程序。作者提出OPTICYCLE与OPTISTATE两种轻量推理harness，并在9个基准、2634个问题、11个Qwen变体（0.6B-27B）上系统评估。结果显示，执行引导的迭代修订对所有模型均稳定提升宏平均准确率，最高提升49.46个百分点；两种harness在同模型对比中优于六个适配的智能体工作流，并在可比规模下优于四个经后训练的优化模型。显式建模状态带来额外但依赖模型的提升，说明额外结构并非普遍有益。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 轻量推理框架配合执行引导修订，无需额外训练即可在优化建模任务上超越复杂智能体工作流与后训练模型。
papers.core_method: 提出OPTICYCLE与OPTISTATE两种轻量推理harness，采用单一模型角色，通过执行求解器程序获得反馈并迭代修订优化建模代码；OPTISTATE额外维护显式建模状态以辅助生成。
innovation_points: 以单一模型角色的轻量推理框架替代复杂多智能体工作流，无需任务特定后训练
系统验证执行引导修订在0.6B-27B多种规模模型上的普适增益
引入显式建模状态并分析其收益的模型依赖性
在统一模型规模下与多个适配智能体工作流及后训练优化模型进行公平对比
experiment_results: 在9个基准、2634个问题上评估11个Qwen变体，执行引导修订使宏平均准确率最高提升49.46个百分点
两种harness在同模型对比中优于六个适配的智能体工作流
在可比模型规模下优于四个经后训练的优化模型，且无需额外训练
limitations: 显式建模状态带来的额外提升依赖具体模型，并非普遍有效
评估主要基于Qwen系列模型，对其他模型家族的泛化性未验证
未报告推理成本、延迟等工程效率指标
papers.practical_value: 为企业在不投入后训练成本的前提下部署优化建模智能体提供了轻量可复用的推理框架，执行引导修订可直接集成到现有LLM推理管线中，降低优化建模自动化门槛。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了依赖复杂智能体编排或任务后训练的主流思路，证明轻量推理框架加执行反馈即可显著提升优化建模正确率，对LLM智能体系统的设计取舍具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To test this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to robotics and make sensorimotor alignment measurable, offering a low-cost, representation-level view of robot foundation models that closed-loop success rates alone cannot reveal.
papers.summary: 该论文研究机器人基础模型评估成本高的问题，提出无需训练的离线指标S²（Sensorimotor Alignment），衡量模型感官表征与物理运动几何结构的一致性。作者将柏拉图表征假说（PRH）扩展到机器人领域，假设具身模型能力越强，其视觉语言表征越应向运动轨迹结构收敛。S²通过表征对齐程度为模型能力提供低成本代理，实验发现其与下游机器人任务成功率正相关，并可在昂贵微调前筛选有潜力的VLM骨干。S²还为VLA与世界动作模型中的现象提供表征层面解释，使感官运动对齐可测量，补充闭环成功率无法揭示的信息。
papers.one_line_takeaway: S²用免训练表征对齐指标低成本预测机器人策略成功率，并把柏拉图表征假说扩展到具身运动模态。
papers.core_method: 提出免训练离线指标S²：先提取模型感官表征与物理运动轨迹的几何结构，再度量二者对齐程度；对齐越高，表示模型感官表征越接近运动模态的统计结构，从而作为下游任务成功率的低成本代理。
innovation_points: 将柏拉图表征假说从视觉-语言扩展到运动轨迹模态，提出感官运动对齐概念
设计免训练、低成本的离线指标S²，可在闭环评估前排序模型
证明S²与多模型家族的下游机器人任务成功率正相关
用S²在昂贵VLA微调前筛选有潜力的VLM骨干，并提供表征层面解释
experiment_results: S²与下游机器人任务成功率在不同模型家族间呈正相关
S²可在VLA微调前识别有潜力的VLM骨干
摘要未给出具体相关系数、任务数量或成功率数值，需查阅全文
limitations: 摘要未报告具体定量结果与统计显著性，证据强度有限
S²为相关性代理，不能替代闭环评估，因果解释力有限
仅在摘要所述模型家族上验证，跨更多具身任务与模态的泛化性未知
papers.practical_value: 为机器人基础模型提供低成本离线筛选工具，减少昂贵闭环rollout；帮助企业在VLA微调前优先选择VLM骨干，降低试错成本，并为模型诊断提供表征层面视角。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把表征假说转化为可测量的工程指标，为具身模型评估提供闭环成功率之外的补充维度，对模型选型与预训练表征诊断有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: Real robot data, rich across tasks and morphologies, is often treated as the bottleneck for training robot learning models, including embodied foundation models that aim for zero-shot physical transfer. In this paper, we investigate the degree to which such models can acquire necessary structure using data from systems without embodiment. To this end, we test if inexpensive, procedurally generated synthetic data can yield useful priors before a model observes any real-world behavior. We study this through robot action prediction, a natural pretraining objective and a direct test of whether structure learned from arbitrary synthetic tasks transfers to embodied settings. We introduce three data generation pipelines that model mathematical abstractions of robotic control, and use them as pretraining priors for a Transformer. We demonstrate that a model trained purely on this non-robotic data attains non-trivial zero-shot prediction performance on unseen physical robot tasks via an in-context learning mechanism, and that our specialized control priors notably improve upon generic causal priors. We also compare against a compute-matched baseline trained on real robot data, and find that it outperforms our model but only on the datasets it was trained on. These findings suggest that procedurally generated, mathematical abstractions can yield useful robotic priors, offering a potential complement to expensive embodied data collection.
papers.summary: 该论文研究具身基础模型能否在未见真实机器人行为前，仅从无实体系统的数据中获得有用先验。作者设计三条程序化数据生成管线，对机器人控制做数学抽象（如状态转移、控制信号等），用其预训练Transformer，并以机器人动作预测作为自然预训练目标与迁移测试。结果显示，纯非机器人数据训练的模型在未见物理机器人任务上通过上下文学习取得非平凡零样本预测性能，且专用控制先验明显优于通用因果先验。与算力匹配的真实机器人数据基线相比，后者仅在其训练过的数据集上占优。结论认为，程序化生成的数学抽象可提供有用机器人先验，有望补充昂贵的具身数据采集。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 程序化生成的非机器人数学抽象数据可为具身模型提供可迁移的零样本动作预测先验，是昂贵真实机器人数据的潜在补充。
papers.core_method: 构建三条程序化数据生成管线，将机器人控制抽象为数学系统并生成合成任务序列；以机器人动作预测为预训练目标训练Transformer；通过上下文学习评估对未见物理机器人任务的零样本迁移，并与通用因果先验及算力匹配的真实机器人数据基线对比。
innovation_points: 提出用无实体、程序化生成的数学抽象数据作为机器人行为先验来源，绕开真实机器人数据瓶颈
设计三条面向机器人控制的专用数据生成管线，而非通用序列或因果数据
以动作预测作为预训练目标，直接检验结构迁移到具身设置的能力
系统比较专用控制先验与通用因果先验，并引入算力匹配的真实数据基线
experiment_results: 纯非机器人数据预训练的模型在未见物理机器人任务上取得非平凡零样本动作预测性能，迁移通过上下文学习机制实现
专用控制先验显著优于通用因果先验
算力匹配的真实机器人数据基线整体更强，但优势仅限其训练过的数据集；摘要未给出具体数值指标
limitations: 真实机器人数据基线在其训练分布内仍优于合成先验模型，合成数据尚不能替代真实数据
零样本性能仅为非平凡水平，未报告具体量化指标与任务覆盖范围
研究限于动作预测任务与Transformer架构，向更广泛具身基础模型的泛化性未验证
papers.practical_value: 为机器人学习提供低成本预训练数据补充路径：在采集昂贵真实机器人数据前，可用程序化数学抽象数据预训练模型以获得可迁移先验，降低对大规模具身数据采集的依赖，并提示专用控制先验优于通用因果先验的工程选择。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直接挑战具身基础模型对真实机器人数据的强依赖，提出可程序化扩展的非实体数据先验路线，并给出与真实数据基线的诚实对比，对预训练数据策略与具身模型扩展规律研究有参考价值。

papers.title: Echo: Coupled Action and Task Status Signal Denoising for Vision Language Action Models
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Recognizing task completion and failure enables robots to stop upon success and initiate recovery or replanning after failure. Existing methods augment Vision Language Action (VLA) policies with task status signal prediction to support these execution decisions. However, learning and integrating these signals can require fine-grained supervision, external monitoring models, or complex architectural designs. Moreover, the potential of task status signals to directly guide action generation remains underexplored. We present Echo, a framework that combines task status signal learning without frame-level progress annotations with a compact design for status prediction and action generation within a single VLA. Specifically, Echo represents task status with stop and failure signals, added as two dimensions of each action chunk and denoised together with robot actions. Their combination distinguishes ongoing execution, successful completion, and failure. To learn these signals without fine-grained progress annotations, Echo constructs successful, failed, and recovery trajectories with complementary supervision properties. To enable status signal-guided action generation, Echo controls interactions between the signals and actions and denoises the signals faster than the actions. These allow later action denoising steps to condition on cleaner status estimates while preserving accurate signal prediction. Extensive real-world manipulation experiments show that Echo accurately predicts task status and consistently improves policy performance.
papers.summary: Echo 关注 VLA 策略在执行中判断任务完成与失败的需求：现有方法依赖细粒度进度标注、外部监控模型或复杂架构，且任务状态信号对动作生成的引导潜力未被充分挖掘。论文提出 Echo 框架，将停止与失败两类状态信号作为每个动作块的两个附加维度，与机器人动作一起做扩散去噪，通过二者组合区分执行中、成功完成与失败三种状态。为摆脱帧级进度标注，Echo 构造成功、失败与恢复轨迹，利用其互补监督属性学习状态信号；同时控制信号与动作的交互，并让状态信号比动作更快去噪，使后续动作去噪步骤能基于更干净的状态估计，同时保持信号预测精度。真实机器人操作实验表明 Echo 能准确预测任务状态并稳定提升策略性能。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Echo 把停止/失败状态信号并入动作块联合去噪，无需帧级进度标注即可让 VLA 策略自主判断任务完成与失败并改善操作性能。
papers.core_method: 将任务状态表示为停止与失败两个信号维度，附加到每个动作块上，与机器人动作在同一扩散/流式去噪过程中联合生成；通过构造成功、失败和恢复轨迹提供互补监督，避免帧级进度标注；设计信号与动作的交互控制，并让状态信号先于动作完成去噪，使后续动作去噪以更干净的状态估计为条件。
innovation_points: 把任务状态信号作为动作块的附加维度与动作联合去噪，在单一 VLA 内同时完成状态预测与动作生成，无需外部监控模型或复杂架构
利用成功、失败、恢复三类轨迹的互补监督学习状态信号，摆脱对帧级进度标注的依赖
采用状态信号快于动作的去噪调度，使动作生成能条件于更干净的状态估计，同时保留信号预测精度
experiment_results: 真实机器人操作实验表明 Echo 能准确预测任务状态，并持续提升策略性能；给定材料未提供具体量化指标与对比数值
limitations: 状态信号仅覆盖停止与失败两类，对更细粒度的执行状态或中间进度刻画有限
方法依赖成功、失败与恢复轨迹的构造，数据采集与场景覆盖成本可能较高
实验限于真实操作任务，泛化到更多机器人平台与任务类型的证据尚不充分
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略提供内生的任务完成与失败判断能力，使机器人成功后及时停止、失败后触发恢复或重规划，减少对外部监控模型和人工进度标注的依赖，降低部署与数据标注成本，对真实操作场景的可靠执行有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把任务状态判断从外挂模块变成与动作生成耦合的内生信号，并给出无需帧级标注的学习路径，为 VLA 策略的自主终止与失败恢复提供了简洁可复用的设计思路。

papers.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.
papers.summary: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽引入多视角输入以提供互补空间信息，但实验显示其策略持续依赖腕部视角，无法随操作阶段动态调整全局-局部视角依赖，限制了阶段适应性与鲁棒性。为此，作者提出FocusVLA，一种阶段感知的多视角路由框架：从历史动作预测未来交互意图，并用该意图在动作生成过程中引导动态视角路由，从而在不同任务阶段自适应协调全局与局部观测，提升多视角利用率。在RoboTwin 2.0上，FocusVLA相较最强基线π0.5平均成功率提升10.10个百分点；真实世界评估中成功率从71.7%提升至85.0%，相对π0.5提升13.3%。其意图预测与动态路由模块可在不修改核心架构的前提下集成到现有VLA框架中。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FocusVLA用未来交互意图引导多视角动态路由，让VLA模型按操作阶段自适应切换全局与局部观测，显著提升成功率且易于集成。
papers.core_method: FocusVLA是一个阶段感知的多视角路由框架。它从历史动作序列中预测未来交互意图，并将该意图作为引导信号，在动作生成过程中动态路由全局视角与腕部局部视角的依赖权重，使模型在不同操作阶段自适应协调全局与局部观测，从而更充分地利用多视角互补信息。意图预测与动态路由模块设计为可插拔组件，不改变现有VLA框架的核心架构。
innovation_points: 提出阶段感知的多视角动态路由机制，按操作阶段自适应调整全局与局部视角依赖，而非固定依赖腕部视角
利用历史动作预测未来交互意图，并以该意图引导视角路由，将未来意图信息引入多视角观测协调
意图预测与动态路由模块可即插即用地集成到现有VLA框架，无需修改核心架构
experiment_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0上，相较最强基线π0.5，平均成功率提升10.10个百分点
真实世界评估中成功率从71.7%提升至85.0%，相对π0.5提升13.3%
摘要未提供消融实验、意图预测精度或路由模块单独贡献的定量数据
limitations: 摘要未报告意图预测模块的准确性及其对路由决策的误差传播影响
真实世界评估的具体任务数量、场景多样性与统计显著性未在摘要中说明
方法依赖历史动作序列预测未来意图，在长时程或动作分布偏移场景下的泛化性未经验证
papers.practical_value: 该方法面向机器人操作中多视角观测利用不足的工程问题，通过可插拔的意图预测与动态路由模块提升现有VLA策略的阶段适应性与鲁棒性，且无需改动核心架构，便于在已有VLA系统中低成本集成，对提升真实操作任务成功率具有直接价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它揭示了现有VLA模型多视角输入利用不充分、过度依赖腕部视角的关键缺陷，并给出一种轻量、可集成的意图引导动态路由方案，在仿真与真实环境中均取得显著成功率提升，对多视角VLA策略设计与工程落地具有参考意义。

papers.title: Full-Weight VLA Fine-Tuning Without an fp32 Master Copy Silently Erases Most Updates
papers.abstract: When a vision-language-action (VLA) model is fine-tuned with its trainable weights in bfloat16 (bf16) and no fp32 master copy, AdamW writes each update straight into bf16, silently rounding away any update smaller than 1/512 of a weight. In 9 of 12 open VLA codebases a default or documented recipe trains this way, 4 on full weight matrices, including LeRobot's SmolVLA default and its $π_0$/$π_{0.5}$ guides. In our LIBERO runs without the copy, a probe every 100 steps finds at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights erased. On the Hugging Face Hub, 99% of sampled full-weight SmolVLA fine-tunes store the action expert in bf16, and 84% of recent $π_{0.5}$ fine-tunes with a training configuration set the bf16 flag. On LIBERO-Object, with rules fixed in advance, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for $π_{0.5}$ at a ten-times lower learning rate, where both models are undertrained, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for $π_{0.5}$ at its default rate. For SmolVLA at its default rate it adds 10.2 points with open-loop 50-action chunks but only 4.2 when re-planning every 10 actions. In these five comparisons and two more against SmolVLA with every trainable weight in bf16, every run with the copy beats every run without it (p < 0.05); all gaps but the 8.7- and 4.2-point ones clear our 10-point threshold. The fix is to keep the trainable weights in fp32 during training, a one-line change for SmolVLA in LeRobot.
papers.summary: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在微调时若可训练权重仅以bf16存储、缺少fp32主副本，AdamW更新会被静默舍入。作者指出12个开源VLA代码库中有9个默认或文档化配方采用此方式，其中4个作用于全权重矩阵，包括LeRobot的SmolVLA默认配置及π0/π0.5指南。在LIBERO实验中，每100步探测发现至少79%的bf16权重更新被擦除；Hugging Face Hub上99%的采样全权重SmolVLA微调将动作专家存为bf16，84%的近期π0.5微调配置开启bf16标志。在LIBERO-Object上，加入fp32副本使SmolVLA成功率从4.3%升至49.3%，π0.5从5.1%升至80.9%（低学习率、欠训练），默认学习率下π0.5从89.0%升至97.7%。修复方法是在训练期间将可训练权重保持为fp32，对LeRobot中的SmolVLA是一行改动。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 全权重VLA微调若缺少fp32主副本，bf16舍入会静默擦除大部分小更新并显著拉低成功率，保留fp32训练权重是必要修复。
papers.core_method: 作者分析bf16训练下AdamW更新被舍入的机制：小于权重1/512的更新在写回bf16时消失。通过审计12个开源VLA代码库的训练配方和Hugging Face Hub上的微调配置，统计bf16存储与标志使用情况；在LIBERO环境对SmolVLA和π0.5进行对照实验，比较有无fp32主副本时的更新擦除比例与任务成功率，并测试不同学习率、动作块长度和重规划频率下的表现。
innovation_points: 系统审计开源VLA代码库与模型Hub配置，揭示bf16无fp32主副本训练在VLA微调中普遍存在
量化bf16舍入对权重更新的擦除比例，每100步探测至少79%更新被擦除
在LIBERO上给出有无fp32副本的对照成功率差距，覆盖SmolVLA与π0.5及多种学习率设置
指出修复成本极低：训练时保持可训练权重为fp32，对LeRobot的SmolVLA仅需一行改动
experiment_results: LIBERO-Object上，加入fp32副本使SmolVLA成功率从4.3%升至49.3%，π0.5从5.1%升至80.9%（低学习率、欠训练）
π0.5在默认学习率下成功率从89.0%升至97.7%
SmolVLA默认学习率下，开环50动作块提升10.2点，每10动作重规划仅提升4.2点
五项比较及另外两项对比中，有fp32副本的运行均优于无副本运行（p<0.05），除8.7和4.2点差距外均超过10点阈值
limitations: 实验集中在LIBERO仿真环境与SmolVLA、π0.5两个模型，未覆盖更多真实机器人平台或更大规模VLA
未系统分析不同优化器状态精度、梯度累积等训练配置对舍入擦除的交互影响
成功率提升幅度受学习率、动作块长度和重规划频率影响，部分场景增益低于10点阈值
papers.practical_value: 为VLA模型微调提供低成本高回报的工程修正：训练时保留fp32主副本可避免大部分更新被静默擦除，显著提升下游任务成功率；对使用LeRobot SmolVLA或π0.5的团队，改动仅一行或一个配置项，适合在现有训练管线中立即采纳。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了一个广泛存在但易被忽视的训练精度陷阱：bf16全权重微调缺少fp32主副本会静默丢弃小更新，导致模型欠训练和成功率大幅下降。其审计证据覆盖主流开源VLA代码库与模型Hub，实验对照清晰，修复成本极低，对VLA微调实践具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: Bridging cognition, reasoning and action for polymorphic embodied agents towards human-heterogeneous multi-robot collaborative assembly with vision-language model and digital twin
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
papers.summary: 该论文面向人类—异构多机器人协同装配场景，提出融合视觉语言模型与数字孪生的多形态具身智能体框架，试图打通认知、推理与行动三个环节。研究问题在于：装配环境中人类与多种异构机器人共存，任务分配、语义理解与动作执行之间存在鸿沟，传统方法难以兼顾高层认知推理与底层协同控制。技术路线以视觉语言模型承担场景理解与任务推理，以数字孪生提供物理环境的高保真映射与仿真验证，并将认知、推理、行动组织为面向多形态具身智能体的闭环。由于仅有标题与来源、无摘要与实验数据，本文无法确认具体算法细节、数据集与量化结果，仅能判断其属于制造系统领域的具身智能与多机器人协同研究。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该文提出以视觉语言模型加数字孪生驱动多形态具身智能体，实现人机异构多机器人协同装配的认知—推理—行动闭环。
papers.core_method: 以视觉语言模型作为高层认知与推理模块，理解装配场景与人类指令；以数字孪生构建物理装配环境的同步映射，用于状态感知、仿真推演与动作验证；将认知、推理、行动组织为多形态具身智能体的协同框架，支撑人类与异构多机器人之间的任务分配与协作执行。具体模型结构、训练方式与集成细节因缺少摘要无法确认。
innovation_points: 提出面向人类—异构多机器人协同装配的多形态具身智能体框架，将认知、推理与行动统一组织
将视觉语言模型引入装配场景的高层语义理解与任务推理
结合数字孪生实现物理环境映射与动作验证，形成虚实协同的闭环
面向制造系统真实装配场景，强调人机异构协同而非单一机器人作业
experiment_results: 给定材料仅有标题与来源，无摘要与实验数据，无法确认任何量化结果
未提供数据集、基线对比、装配成功率或效率指标等信息
实验验证情况需查阅原文，本文不作推断
limitations: 缺少摘要与实验数据，方法细节与有效性无法从给定材料核实
视觉语言模型在工业装配中的实时性、可靠性与安全性约束未在材料中体现
数字孪生与多机器人系统的集成复杂度及部署成本未在材料中说明
papers.practical_value: 面向制造系统的人机异构多机器人协同装配，该框架为工业场景提供了一条将大模型语义推理与数字孪生虚实验证结合的工程思路，有望用于装配任务理解、多机器人任务分配与协同执行验证，对智能制造中具身智能体落地具有参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文将视觉语言模型与数字孪生结合到多形态具身智能体与人机异构多机器人协同装配中，处于具身智能与制造系统交叉前沿；对关注大模型在工业具身场景中认知—推理—行动闭环的研究者与工程人员具有阅读价值，但需结合原文核实方法与实验。

papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Benchmarking Frontier AI Models on LIBERO-10 Robot Manipulation Tasks
affiliations: The University of Texas at Dallas
papers.abstract: Recent advances in frontier AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, planning, and tool use, raising the possibility of using general-purpose AI models for robot manipulation without task-specific training. However, their manipulation capabilities have not been systematically evaluated on standardized robotics benchmarks. In this report, we present a unified closed-loop manipulation framework for evaluating frontier AI models on the LIBERO-10 benchmark. Our framework enables models to control a robot directly through visual observations, robot proprioception, and structured tool calls, primarily by specifying target end-effector poses and gripper commands, without task-specific fine-tuning or pretrained manipulation skills. We evaluate six frontier AI models, including GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini-4 Argon, across three reasoning effort levels, resulting in 18 configurations and 1,800 evaluation episodes. Our results show that GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest success rate of 44%, followed by Gemini-4 Argon at 43%. Increasing reasoning effort generally improves manipulation performance, but the benefits vary across models and come at additional inference cost. We also observe substantial differences across tasks, with models performing relatively well on object placement tasks but struggling with precise spatial arrangements and complex multi-step interactions. These findings demonstrate both the potential and limitations of frontier AI models for robot manipulation, highlighting the challenges of translating reasoning capabilities into reliable physical actions. We release our evaluation framework and experimental results to support reproducible benchmarking and future research on reasoning-based robot manipulation.
papers.summary: 该报告针对前沿通用AI模型能否在无任务特定训练条件下直接完成机器人操作这一问题，在LIBERO-10标准化基准上构建了统一的闭环操作评测框架。框架让模型仅通过视觉观测、机器人本体感知和结构化工具调用（主要指定末端执行器目标位姿与夹爪指令）直接控制机器人，不依赖预训练操作技能或微调。作者评测了GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5、Claude Opus 5.5和Gemini-4 Argon六个模型，覆盖三档推理强度，共18种配置、1800个评测回合。结果显示GPT-6 Astra成功率最高为44%，Gemini-4 Argon以43%紧随其后；提高推理强度总体改善操作表现，但收益因模型而异且带来额外推理成本；任务间差异显著，物体放置类任务表现较好，精确空间排布和复杂多步交互仍困难。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 前沿通用大模型可零微调直接驱动机器人，但LIBERO-10上最高仅44%成功率，说明推理能力向可靠物理动作的转化仍是主要瓶颈。
papers.core_method: 构建统一闭环操作评测框架：模型接收视觉观测与机器人本体感知，通过结构化工具调用输出末端执行器目标位姿和夹爪命令，直接控制机器人；不进行任务特定微调，也不使用预训练操作技能。在LIBERO-10上对六个前沿模型按三档推理强度共18种配置进行1800回合评测。
innovation_points: 提出面向前沿通用AI模型的统一闭环机器人操作评测框架，以结构化工具调用替代专用策略网络
在零任务特定微调和零预训练操作技能条件下系统评测通用模型的操作能力
引入三档推理强度作为变量，量化推理投入对物理操作成功率的影响与成本权衡
覆盖六个前沿模型、18种配置、1800个回合的标准化可复现评测
experiment_results: GPT-6 Astra成功率最高为44%，Gemini-4 Argon为43%
提高推理强度总体提升操作表现，但收益因模型而异并增加推理成本
任务间差异显著：物体放置类表现相对较好，精确空间排布与复杂多步交互仍困难
limitations: 最高成功率仅44%，距实际部署仍有明显差距
仅在LIBERO-10单一基准上评测，未覆盖更多机器人平台与任务分布
提高推理强度带来额外推理成本，且收益不稳定
papers.practical_value: 为评估通用大模型直接驱动机器人的可行性提供了标准化、可复现的闭环评测框架与基线结果，帮助企业判断在何种任务类型上可尝试以通用模型替代专用策略，并提示推理成本与成功率之间的工程权衡。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把“推理能力能否转化为可靠物理动作”这一关键问题放到标准化机器人基准上量化，给出前沿模型零微调操作的真实上限与任务短板，为基于推理的机器人操作研究提供可复现的评测基础。

papers.title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. On LIBERO, AGQ achieves 92.7% task success at W3, exceeding AWQ and GPTQ by 1.2 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively, and retains 70.5% success at W2.5. An asymmetric configuration, denoted W1.5$^{*}$, uses W4 vision weights and a parameter-weighted average of 1.5 bits for language weights. With lossless coding, it achieves $6.10\times$ complete-model compression relative to BF16 while retaining 25.5% task success. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/Qiuxu00/AGQ
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型权重规模大、难以部署在内存受限的机载平台的问题，提出动作引导量化（AGQ）。AGQ 结合动作敏感性与权重恢复代价的实测代理，在存储预算下为各矩阵分配位宽；采用逐通道校准补偿量化误差，并保持每个矩阵内位宽统一以维持规整布局；通过位宽相关的分组无损编码降低常驻权重存储，并用分块恢复限制临时缓冲区。在 LIBERO 上，AGQ 在 W3 下达到 92.7% 任务成功率，分别超过 AWQ 和 GPTQ 1.2 和 3.7 个百分点，在 W2.5 下仍保持 70.5% 成功率；非对称配置 W1.5*（视觉权重 W4、语言权重参数加权平均 1.5 位）结合无损编码实现相对 BF16 的 6.10 倍整模型压缩，并保留 25.5% 任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AGQ 以动作敏感性加权重恢复代价代理来分配超低位宽，在存储预算下兼顾 VLA 任务性能与部署可行性。
papers.core_method: 动作引导量化：以动作敏感性和权重恢复代价的实测代理为矩阵分配位宽；逐通道校准补偿量化误差；矩阵内统一位置保持规整布局；位宽相关分组无损编码降低常驻存储；分块恢复限制临时缓冲区。
innovation_points: 将动作敏感性与权重恢复代价代理结合，用于 VLA 模型的矩阵级位宽分配。
在超低位宽下通过逐通道校准与矩阵内统一位置平衡精度与规整布局。
引入位宽相关分组无损编码和分块恢复，分别降低常驻权重存储与临时缓冲区开销。
提出非对称配置 W1.5*，对视觉与语言权重采用不同位宽策略。
experiment_results: LIBERO 上 W3 达到 92.7% 任务成功率，分别超过 AWQ 和 GPTQ 1.2 和 3.7 个百分点。
W2.5 下仍保持 70.5% 任务成功率。
W1.5* 结合无损编码实现相对 BF16 的 6.10 倍整模型压缩，保留 25.5% 任务成功率。
limitations: 极低位宽 W1.5* 下任务成功率仅 25.5%，性能下降明显。
摘要未说明动作敏感性代理的具体定义与计算开销。
实验仅在 LIBERO 基准上报告，未涉及真实机器人平台或更多 VLA 架构。
papers.practical_value: 为内存受限的机载机器人平台部署 VLA 模型提供超低位量化路径，在给定存储预算下按动作敏感性分配位宽，并通过无损编码与分块恢复控制常驻存储和临时缓冲，具备工程落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA 模型部署受限于权重规模，超低位量化是关键技术方向；AGQ 将动作敏感性与恢复代价纳入位宽分配，并给出可复现的压缩与成功率权衡数据，对边缘部署研究有直接参考意义。

papers.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
papers.summary: 该论文提出多模态具身智能体（MMEA）的定义，即耦合多模态任务推理与物理动作、并能根据反馈修正决策的目标导向系统，并追问从计算机使用到机器人使用发生了什么变化。作者提出PAPAV能力中心框架，将智能体功能拆为感知状态、预判动作效果、规划可行路径、通过接口或本体执行、验证结果五项，按功能而非架构统一比较MMEA、多模态智能体（MMA）与机器人系统（RS）。论文进一步归纳五项物理约束，指出这些约束使可预先固定的选择更少、纠错空间更小。对64个基准的分析显示，显式评估集中在Act，仅5个评估Anticipate、3个评估Verify，后两者多被任务成功率掩盖。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PAPAV以五项能力统一刻画从计算机使用到机器人使用的转变，并揭示当前基准严重偏重执行、忽视预判与验证。
papers.core_method: 提出PAPAV能力中心框架，将多模态具身智能体分解为Perceive、Anticipate、Plan、Act、Verify五项功能；以功能而非架构为统一比较基础，对比MMEA、MMA与RS，并结合物理约束分析开放挑战。
innovation_points: 提出PAPAV五项能力框架，以功能而非架构统一比较计算机使用智能体、多模态智能体与机器人系统
系统归纳从计算机使用到机器人使用的五项物理约束，说明其如何减少预先固定选择与纠错空间
对64个基准进行能力覆盖分析，量化揭示评估集中于Act、Anticipate与Verify被任务成功率掩盖的问题
experiment_results: 基于64个基准的元分析显示，显式评估集中在Act能力
仅5个基准评估Anticipate能力，仅3个评估Verify能力
论文未报告新的模型训练或在线实验数据，结论来自基准能力覆盖统计与框架分析
limitations: 工作为框架与综述性分析，未提出新模型或新训练方法，缺乏端到端实验验证
64个基准的能力标注依赖作者分类标准，可能受主观判断影响
五项物理约束与能力映射主要基于现有文献归纳，尚未在统一实验环境中验证其因果影响
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体研发提供统一的能力拆解与评估视角，指导团队在感知、预判、规划、执行、验证五环节分配工程资源，并推动基准从单一任务成功率转向分能力度量，对机器人操作与计算机使用智能体的可靠性设计有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文指出当前评估体系对预判与验证能力覆盖严重不足，为理解计算机使用与机器人使用之间的能力鸿沟提供结构化框架，有助于设计更可靠的物理智能体并建立分能力评估标准。

papers.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.abstract: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.
papers.summary: TARSphere 面向物理与社会约束下、环境与人类需求持续变化的长程具身智能体，提出机器人导向的全栈框架。其基础设施 TARSphere-Infra 在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，并引入具身 NPC 与受限对话；事件驱动有限状态机依据已完成动作与已传递信息更新任务状态并评估结果。TARSphere-Harness 让冻结的多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能行动，结合观测、分层记忆与执行反馈修正决策。在此基础上，agent-in-the-loop 策展对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建含 30 个室内场景、360 个 episode 的 TARSphere-Bench，用五组配对条件考察感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人类协作与意图理解。对 8 个 MLLM 的评测显示通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新与人机交互仍困难，频繁碰撞与跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TARSphere 用物理模拟、事件驱动状态机与冻结 MLLM 技能执行构建长程具身评测全栈，揭示任务更新与人机协作仍是瓶颈，且执行安全须与任务成功并重。
papers.core_method: TARSphere-Infra 在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，配备具身 NPC 与受限对话，并以事件驱动有限状态机根据已完成动作和已传递信息更新任务状态、评估结果；TARSphere-Harness 作为具身大脑外壳，让冻结 MLLM 通过多级可执行技能行动，利用观测、分层记忆和执行反馈修正决策；再以 agent-in-the-loop 策展对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建 360 个 episode、30 个室内场景的 TARSphere-Bench，设置五组配对条件。
innovation_points: 提出机器人导向的全栈框架，将物理模拟、具身 NPC、受限对话与事件驱动 FSM 结合，支持在演化环境中评估长程任务。
设计 TARSphere-Harness，使冻结 MLLM 借助多级可执行技能、分层记忆与执行反馈进行决策修正，无需微调模型。
构建 TARSphere-Bench，以 agent-in-the-loop 策展对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，并用五组配对条件系统考察感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人类协作与意图理解。
在评测中同时关注执行安全（碰撞与跌倒）与任务成功，并采用共享动作接口与决策预算控制比较条件。
experiment_results: 对 8 个 MLLM 的评测显示，通用模型可优于具身模型。
任务更新与人机交互仍是困难条件。
频繁碰撞与跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全；材料未给出具体数值指标。
limitations: 评测基于物理模拟器与构建的基准场景，未说明真实机器人部署验证。
摘要未报告具体量化结果，难以判断各条件间的性能差距幅度。
任务更新与人机交互表现困难，框架在这些方面的能力仍有限。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人长程具身智能体提供可复用的全栈评测基础设施与基准，支持在物理与社会约束下比较不同 MLLM 的决策能力，并将执行安全纳入评估，有助于企业构建和选型具身智能体系统。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把环境演化、社会交互与执行安全纳入统一评测，指出通用 MLLM 在具身任务中的潜力与任务更新、人机协作的短板，为长程具身智能体的研究与工程落地提供系统化参照。

papers.title: SPAR: Stepwise Personalized Autoregressive Recommendation with Prefix-Balanced Semantic IDs
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Semantic ID (SID)-based generative recommendation retrieves items through successive token-level decisions, making personalization at each decoding step essential. However, existing methods insufficiently account for prefix-dependent user evidence and imbalanced historical interaction loads among candidate branches. This can cause irreversible branch-selection errors and favor popular paths. We propose SPAR, a generative recommendation framework that jointly improves stepwise personalization and SID construction. Its PATH Decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed long-term user memories and combines it with recent behavior, user profiles, and event context to guide each token decision. Its RQ-PIB module balances historical interaction loads among sibling branches under each parent prefix while preserving semantic structure. Experiments on large-scale Youku production data show an average relative HitRate improvement of 2.66% over the strongest baseline. SPAR also increases target-prefix retention by 5.79 percentage points and reduces the traffic-weighted largest child-branch share by 32.84% across SID levels. In a 7-day online A/B test, SPAR serves 10% of Youku's production traffic and improves average watch time per user by 3.95% and play conversion rate by 3.38%. These results demonstrate more reliable hierarchical decoding, balanced SID branches, and improved user engagement in industrial recommendation.
papers.summary: SPAR针对基于语义ID（SID）的生成式推荐中逐步解码个性化不足与候选分支历史交互负载不均衡的问题，提出联合优化逐步个性化与SID构造的生成式推荐框架。其PATH Decoder从压缩的长期用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据，并结合近期行为、用户画像与事件上下文，引导每个token级决策；RQ-PIB模块在保持语义结构的前提下，平衡同一父前缀下兄弟分支的历史交互负载，缓解流行路径偏好与不可逆分支选择错误。在优酷大规模生产数据上，SPAR相对最强基线平均HitRate相对提升2.66%，目标前缀保留率提升5.79个百分点，流量加权最大子分支占比在SID各层级降低32.84%。7天线上A/B测试中，SPAR承载优酷10%生产流量，人均观看时长提升3.95%，播放转化率提升3.38%，验证了层次解码可靠性、SID分支均衡性与用户参与度的工业价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SPAR通过前缀感知的逐步个性化解码与兄弟分支负载均衡的语义ID构造，在优酷线上显著提升生成式推荐效果与用户参与度。
papers.core_method: SPAR包含两个核心组件：PATH Decoder在每一步token解码时，从压缩的长期用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据，并与近期行为、用户画像和事件上下文融合，实现逐步个性化；RQ-PIB模块在语义ID的每个父前缀下，对兄弟分支的历史交互负载进行平衡，同时保持语义结构，以缓解流行路径偏好和不可逆分支选择错误。
innovation_points: 提出PATH Decoder，在生成式推荐的每个解码步骤中动态检索前缀相关长期记忆，并与近期行为、画像和上下文联合引导token决策，增强逐步个性化。
设计RQ-PIB模块，在保持语义结构的前提下平衡同一父前缀下兄弟分支的历史交互负载，缓解流行路径偏好与分支选择偏差。
将逐步个性化解码与语义ID构造联合优化，形成端到端的生成式推荐框架，并在工业级生产数据与线上A/B测试中验证。
在优酷大规模生产环境中部署，覆盖10%线上流量，验证了方法在真实业务场景下的工程可行性与线上价值。
experiment_results: 在优酷大规模生产数据上，SPAR相对最强基线平均HitRate相对提升2.66%。
目标前缀保留率提升5.79个百分点，流量加权最大子分支占比在SID各层级降低32.84%。
7天线上A/B测试中，SPAR承载优酷10%生产流量，人均观看时长提升3.95%，播放转化率提升3.38%。
limitations: 摘要未披露PATH Decoder中长期用户记忆的压缩方式、检索开销及在线推理延迟等工程约束细节。
RQ-PIB的负载平衡策略可能对语义ID的语义纯度或长尾物品覆盖产生何种影响，摘要未给出消融或敏感性分析。
线上A/B测试仅覆盖优酷单一业务场景与7天周期，跨场景、跨平台的泛化性尚未验证。
papers.practical_value: SPAR面向工业级生成式推荐的真实业务场景，在优酷生产环境承载10%线上流量并取得人均观看时长与播放转化率的双提升，说明其逐步个性化解码与SID分支均衡策略在工程约束下具备可部署性。RQ-PIB缓解流行路径偏好，有助于改善候选分支负载不均与长尾曝光结构，为基于语义ID的生成式推荐系统提供可落地的优化路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式推荐中逐步解码个性化不足与SID分支负载失衡两个关键问题，提出可联合优化的框架，并在大规模生产数据与线上A/B测试中给出明确收益，对关注生成式推荐工业落地与语义ID构造的研究者和工程师具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: EASformer: Environment-Action-State Alignment for Industrial Generative Ranking
papers.abstract: Modern industrial ranking systems increasingly adopt generative recommendation (GR) paradigms, in which user behavior sequences and non-sequential (NS) features are tokenized and jointly modeled by Transformer-style backbones. This unified formulation provides a scalable interface for modeling long histories and heterogeneous features. However, sequence and NS representations often carry asymmetric semantics: historical representations may combine environment context with observed-action semantics, whereas candidate-side NS representations contain no observed action but incorporate richer supplementary context, such as user-item interaction features and recent behavior lists. Direct interaction between such representations can make query-key dot products compare different semantic objects, limiting meaningful cross-token interaction. To fill this gap, we propose EASformer, an Environment-Action-State disentangled architecture for industrial app ranking. EASformer constructs an explicitly aligned context environment space shared by historical and non-sequence tokens, while disentangling user actions from historical token and candidate-specific context form non-sequence tokens. Based on this aligned space, EASformer enables complementary historical action retrieval and state-conditioned action prediction. Furthermore, the disentangled design supports a Cloze-style self-supervised objective by masking historical actions and reusing the candidate prediction pathway. On an offline benchmark from a real-world industrial app marketplace, EASformer achieves an AUC of 0.89411, yielding a 0.88% relative improvement over the deployed baseline. Online A/B tests further support this advantage, with relative eCPM lifts of 1.26% and 3.94% across two real-world ranking scenarios.
papers.summary: EASformer针对工业生成式推荐中用户行为序列与非序列特征联合建模时的语义不对称问题：历史表示混合环境上下文与已观测动作语义，候选侧非序列表示不含观测动作但含更丰富补充上下文，直接做query-key点积会比对不同语义对象，限制跨token交互。作者提出环境-动作-状态解耦架构，构建历史与非序列token共享的显式对齐上下文环境空间，将用户动作从历史token中解耦，并由候选特定上下文构成非序列token；在该对齐空间上实现互补的历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，并支持掩码历史动作、复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标。真实工业应用市场离线基准AUC为0.89411，较线上基线相对提升0.88%；两个真实排序场景在线A/B的eCPM相对提升1.26%和3.94%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: EASformer通过环境-动作-状态显式解耦与共享环境空间对齐，修复了生成式推荐中序列与非序列token的语义错配，并在真实工业场景取得离线与在线双重收益。
papers.core_method: 将历史行为序列与非序列特征token化后，构建历史token与候选侧非序列token共享的显式对齐上下文环境空间；把用户动作语义从历史token中剥离，候选特定上下文形成非序列token；在统一对齐空间上分别执行历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，并以掩码历史动作、复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标训练Transformer骨干。
innovation_points: 提出环境-动作-状态解耦表示，明确区分历史token中的环境上下文与已观测动作语义，缓解query-key点积比对不同语义对象的问题
构建历史与非序列token共享的显式对齐环境空间，使跨token交互在同一语义坐标系下进行
在对齐空间上组合历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，形成互补的生成式排序路径
设计掩码历史动作并复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标，提升训练信号利用率
experiment_results: 真实工业应用市场离线基准AUC为0.89411，较已部署基线相对提升0.88%
两个真实排序场景在线A/B测试eCPM相对提升分别为1.26%和3.94%
摘要未提供消融实验、各模块独立贡献及训练成本数据
limitations: 离线评估仅基于单一真实工业应用市场基准，跨业务泛化性证据有限
在线收益来自两个排序场景的A/B结果，未披露长期生态指标与用户侧影响
摘要未给出解耦各模块的消融数据，难以量化环境对齐与动作解耦的独立贡献
papers.practical_value: 面向工业应用市场排序场景，提供可落地的序列-非序列统一建模接口，在保持Transformer骨干可扩展性的同时修正语义错配；在线eCPM提升表明该解耦对齐设计可直接服务于真实流量排序与生成式推荐系统升级。
papers.why_it_matters: 生成式推荐正从学术走向工业部署，序列与非序列特征语义不对称是统一建模中的共性工程难题；该工作给出显式对齐与解耦的系统性方案，并附真实线上A/B证据，对基座式推荐架构设计与线上价值验证均有参考意义。

papers.title: SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning
papers.abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.
papers.summary: SLoSa 针对机器人任务规划中经典规划器依赖显式符号表示、难以扩展，而大语言模型虽接口灵活但体积大、功耗高且缺乏机器人安全知识的问题，提出神经符号压缩与微调框架，训练小型、低功耗且具备安全意识的基座规划模型。方法上先用经典规划器、教师大模型和形式验证器构建安全感知数据集，再经监督微调与以验证奖励机引导的强化学习微调实现安全对齐。在四个 PDDL 域、两个家庭仿真环境、本地边缘平台和桌面机械臂上评估，验证器引导的后训练将 4B-14B 紧凑规划器成功率提升至 70.5-76.0%，INT4 部署于 Jetson Orin 平均功耗 17.85-26.41 W。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SLoSa 用神经符号数据构建与验证器引导的后训练，把基座模型压缩成可在边缘设备本地运行且安全对齐的小型机器人任务规划器。
papers.core_method: 构建安全感知数据集：由经典规划器生成规划、教师大模型扩充、形式验证器过滤与标注；随后两阶段训练：监督微调，以及由基于验证的奖励机引导的强化学习微调，以强制安全对齐；最终以 INT4 量化部署到资源受限的机器人平台。
innovation_points: 将经典规划器、教师 LLM 与形式验证器结合，自动构建带安全约束标注的机器人任务规划数据集
提出验证器引导的奖励机驱动强化学习后训练，把形式化安全约束转化为可优化的对齐信号
面向边缘部署做小型化与低功耗设计，在 4B-14B 规模上兼顾成功率与能效
experiment_results: 四个 PDDL 域上，验证器引导后训练使 4B-14B 紧凑规划器成功率达到 70.5-76.0%
INT4 部署于 Jetson Orin 平均功耗 17.85-26.41 W
在两个家庭仿真环境和桌面机械臂上验证了跨场景适用性；材料未给出与基线方法的逐项对比数值
limitations: 安全保证依赖形式验证器与编码的安全约束，验证器覆盖范围之外的安全性未讨论
评估集中在 PDDL 域与家庭仿真/桌面机械臂，真实复杂开放环境的泛化性证据有限
材料未报告与经典规划器及教师大模型的详细对比和失败案例分析
papers.practical_value: 为资源受限的机器人系统提供可本地部署的小型安全规划基座，降低对云端大模型的依赖与功耗开销，并以验证器引导的后训练把安全约束工程化地注入模型，适合边缘机器人与家庭服务场景的落地验证。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了如何用神经符号数据流水线和验证器引导的强化学习，把基座模型压缩为低功耗、安全对齐的机器人规划器，为基座模型在具身场景的端侧部署提供了可复用的训练与对齐范式。

papers.title: Large Multimodal Models for Direct Robot Control: GPT-6 as a Beginning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.
papers.summary: 本文系统评估通用多模态大模型GPT-6 Astra在闭环机器人操作中的具身能力。作者采用轻量级智能体执行框架，先探测深度感知、具身上下文学习和触觉理解三项基础能力，发现模型能利用深度信息、从演示中习得简单策略并用触觉反馈纠错。随后在五个操作基准、六个能力维度上评测，RoboDojo成功率26.92%、RoboTwin 2.0为76.0%，但语义推理与物理执行之间存在明显鸿沟，尤其体现在后果感知动作规划、精度和复杂运动协调上。为此作者提出LIBERO-GeoMotion几何约束基准，GPT-6 Astra零样本成功率仅11.1%。真实实验表明简单任务可零样本执行，但运动可行性、精确控制与物理安全仍存持续缺陷，推理延迟也阻碍实际部署。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通用多模态大模型已具备初步具身能力，但语义理解到物理执行的转化仍是直接机器人控制的核心瓶颈。
papers.core_method: 构建轻量级智能体执行框架，将GPT-6 Astra接入闭环机器人操作流程；先通过三项探测任务考察深度感知、具身上下文学习与触觉理解，再在五个操作基准的六个能力维度上系统评测，并引入几何约束基准LIBERO-GeoMotion检验空间理解到可行运动的转化，辅以真实机器人实验验证。
innovation_points: 系统刻画通用多模态大模型在闭环机器人操作中的具身能力图谱，覆盖深度、上下文学习与触觉三类基础能力
提出LIBERO-GeoMotion几何约束基准，专门考察精确位姿对齐、平移旋转协调与物理后果预判
结合仿真基准与真实机器人实验，同时揭示能力边界与推理延迟等部署约束
experiment_results: RoboDojo成功率26.92%，RoboTwin 2.0成功率76.0%
LIBERO-GeoMotion零样本成功率仅11.1%
真实实验中简单任务可零样本执行，但运动可行性、精确控制与物理安全存在持续缺陷，推理延迟明显
limitations: 语义推理与物理执行之间存在显著鸿沟，后果感知动作规划、精度与复杂运动协调不足
几何约束任务零样本成功率低，空间理解难以转化为物理可行运动
推理延迟较大，阻碍实际部署；真实实验覆盖任务范围有限
papers.practical_value: 为通用多模态模型直接驱动机器人提供了能力基线与失败模式清单，LIBERO-GeoMotion可作为几何约束操作的评测工具，帮助企业判断该类模型在操作任务中的可用边界，并针对延迟、精度与安全性做工程取舍。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作以系统评测而非单点演示的方式，厘清通用多模态大模型在机器人直接控制中的真实能力与关键短板，为后续具身模型训练、基准设计与安全部署提供可复用的参照。

papers.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.
papers.summary: 工业仓库机器人车队持续观察作业环境，但将观察结果保存为可复用语义记忆会带来显著的计算、通信与存储开销，例如解释反复出现的通道堵塞需要回看多台机器人跨班次的视频。本文提出 Industrial ReMEmbR，将 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展为面向机器人车队的共享时空记忆系统，核心是按需生成场景描述以降低服务器端计算。每台机器人上的 NVIDIA Jetson 使用 Cosmos-Embed1 编码检索嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge 提取视觉 token、Wan2.2 VAE 生成重建潜变量，且不上传原始相机帧；这些编码模型还被复用于图像块中的人体检测并将其置零，以实现符合 GDPR 的 PII 抽象。系统在视觉-语言边界切分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码器留在机器人端，语言解码器部署于本地服务器；Nemotron 智能体按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并用缓存视觉 token 查询解码器。该设计消除了写入时的描述生成，缓存 token 解码在全部 450 次测试解码中复现了未切分模型的输出。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Industrial ReMEmbR 通过端侧编码、视觉-语言模型切分与按需解码，把单机器人时空记忆扩展为车队共享记忆，在不上传原始视频的前提下降低服务器计算并保持解码一致性。
papers.core_method: 系统在机器人端用 Jetson 运行 Cosmos-Embed1 生成检索嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge 视觉编码器生成视觉 token、Wan2.2 VAE 生成重建潜变量，原始帧不出端；在视觉-语言边界切分 Cosmos3-Edge，语言解码器放在本地服务器；Nemotron 智能体按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并用缓存视觉 token 按需查询解码器生成场景描述；编码模型复用于图像块人体检测与置零，实现 PII 抽象。
innovation_points: 将 ReMEmbR 从单机器人扩展到机器人车队的共享时空记忆系统，支持跨机器人、跨班次的内容/位置/时间检索。
在视觉-语言边界切分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码在端侧、语言解码在服务器，写入时不做描述生成，仅在查询时按需解码。
复用编码模型进行图像块人体检测并置零，实现 PII 抽象以支持 GDPR 合规部署，且不上传原始相机帧。
使用缓存视觉 token 查询解码器，在 450 次测试解码中复现未切分模型输出，保证切分部署的语义一致性。
experiment_results: 缓存 token 解码在全部 450 次测试解码中复现了未切分模型的输出，说明切分部署不损失解码结果一致性。
摘要未给出服务器端计算降低幅度、通信/存储节省量或检索准确率等定量指标，相关数据在给定材料中缺失。
limitations: 缺少服务器端计算、通信与存储开销降低的定量评估，难以判断规模化收益。
仅在 450 次解码上验证切分一致性，未报告检索质量、端到端任务效果或真实车队长期运行数据。
依赖特定 NVIDIA 硬件与模型栈（Jetson、Cosmos-Embed1、Cosmos3-Edge、Wan2.2 VAE、Nemotron），通用性与迁移成本未讨论。
papers.practical_value: 面向仓库机器人车队的真实运维场景，提供可落地的共享时空记忆架构：端侧编码避免原始视频上传，降低带宽与隐私风险；按需解码减少服务器常驻计算；PII 置零支持 GDPR 合规；按内容、位置、时间检索便于解释反复出现的通道堵塞等运营问题。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了如何把生成式视觉-语言模型切分部署到机器人车队边缘-服务器架构中，在隐私与成本约束下构建可复用语义记忆，对工业机器人与边缘推理系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Combining Long-Term Memory and LLMs Comes at a High Cost: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Compromise
affiliations: Universidade do Estado de Santa Catarina
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence in recent years has brought a parallel rise in prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. By embedding malicious instructions, these exploits manipulate language models to bypass intended behavior and operational boundaries. In traditional chatbots, such attacks are confined to a single session because state memory is not preserved across conversations. However, persistent memory features in modern conversational interfaces enable cross-session attack propagation, establishing a threat vector known as memory injection. This work explores this emerging vulnerability in leading LLM-as-a-service platforms, highlighting its real-world severity and the need for countermeasures. While existing literature focuses on violations tailored to specific platform features, we present a general threat model. We demonstrate that all NIST attack goals are collectively achievable across ChatGPT Instant 5.3, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3 Flash under this model. We also show that memory injections can exploit multiple attack vectors, including personal memories, projects, skills, organization instructions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-connected resources. Our findings reveal that all evaluated services can be manipulated to persistently spread disinformation, generate harmful content, or simulate offline unresponsiveness, even in fresh sessions. In the particular case of Claude, shared-memory features allow an attacker to compromise multiple users within an organization and also exfiltrate user prompts. To address these vulnerabilities, we derive defense mechanisms from our proposed threat model and foundational cybersecurity principles. Our analysis indicates that nearly half of these mitigations remain unimplemented across the target services. Datasets and attack artifacts are available at https://github.com/PedroBarcha/Memory-injection.
papers.summary: 该论文研究现代对话式LLM服务中持久化记忆功能引入的跨会话攻击面，即记忆注入。传统提示注入仅限单次会话，而ChatGPT Instant 5.3、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3 Flash等平台的个人记忆、项目、技能、组织指令及MCP连接资源可被恶意指令污染，使攻击跨会话持续传播。作者提出通用威胁模型，证明NIST全部攻击目标可在三类平台上组合达成，并展示可持久传播虚假信息、生成有害内容、模拟离线无响应；Claude的共享记忆还可使攻击者危害组织内多用户并窃取用户提示。作者从威胁模型与基础网络安全原则推导防御机制，分析显示近半数缓解措施尚未在这些服务中实现。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 持久化记忆把LLM提示注入从单会话问题升级为跨会话、跨用户的持续性安全威胁，且现有主流服务防御覆盖不足。
papers.core_method: 提出面向LLM即服务持久记忆功能的通用记忆注入威胁模型，覆盖个人记忆、项目、技能、组织指令和MCP连接资源等多类攻击向量；在ChatGPT Instant 5.3、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3 Flash上开展对抗性评估，将攻击效果映射到NIST攻击目标，并从威胁模型和基础网络安全原则推导防御机制，对照检查各平台缓解措施实现情况。
innovation_points: 将提示注入研究从单会话扩展到持久化记忆场景，系统化定义记忆注入威胁模型
覆盖个人记忆、项目、技能、组织指令、MCP资源等多种真实攻击向量，而非针对单一平台特性
证明NIST全部攻击目标可在三个主流LLM服务上组合达成，并揭示Claude共享记忆导致组织内多用户受害与提示泄露
从威胁模型推导防御机制并量化各平台未实现比例，形成攻防对照分析
experiment_results: 在ChatGPT Instant 5.3、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3 Flash上，NIST全部攻击目标可集体达成
记忆注入可持久传播虚假信息、生成有害内容或模拟离线无响应，即使在新会话中仍生效
Claude共享记忆功能可使攻击者危害组织内多个用户并窃取用户提示；近半数推导出的缓解措施在目标服务中未实现
limitations: 评估基于特定平台版本和功能配置，结论可能随平台更新而变化
未提供防御机制实际部署后的有效性量化数据
攻击成功判定与NIST目标映射依赖作者设定，缺少独立复现与大规模用户研究
papers.practical_value: 为企业选型和部署带持久记忆的LLM服务提供安全风险评估框架，帮助安全团队识别记忆注入攻击面、审计MCP与共享记忆配置，并优先落地尚未实现的缓解措施，降低跨会话数据泄露与有害内容传播风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着LLM产品普遍引入长期记忆与组织级共享能力，提示注入不再是一次性会话问题，而可能演变为持久化、跨用户的系统性妥协。该文给出可操作的威胁模型与防御清单，对LLM平台安全设计、企业AI治理和红队测试具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
papers.abstract: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.
papers.summary: 针对生成式检索（GR）难以高效利用大规模搜索推荐系统中异构特征生态的问题，本文提出Agentic Generative Retrieval（AGR），一种工具增强的生成式检索范式。AGR将语义ID（SID）生成与按需特征获取交错进行：在给定请求与已解码SID前缀的条件下，模型自适应决定是否调用工具、选择哪个特征、以及观测结果应影响后续解码的哪个位置，从而将生成引导至特征一致的SID分支。为监督该行为，作者依据特征适用性与沿SID层级的信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，并采用SID预训练加工具增强微调的两阶段训练。工业数据集、三个公开基准与线上A/B测试一致验证了AGR的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AGR把特征获取从静态注入改为由SID前缀驱动的按需工具调用，使生成式检索能自适应选择特征并定位其影响位置。
papers.core_method: 以自回归SID生成为主干，在解码每一步根据请求与已解码SID前缀决策是否调用工具、选取哪个特征、以及观测注入到后续解码的何处；用特征适用性与信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，先做SID预训练再做工具增强微调。
innovation_points: 提出工具增强的Agentic生成式检索范式，将特征获取与SID生成交错而非静态注入
让模型自适应决定何时需要特征、选哪个特征、以及特征影响哪个层级的SID解码位置
基于特征适用性与信息增益沿SID层级构造监督轨迹，并设计SID预训练+工具增强微调的训练流程
experiment_results: 在工业数据集与三个公开基准上验证了AGR的有效性
线上A/B测试一致表明方法有效
摘要未给出具体指标数值，无法报告定量提升幅度
limitations: 工具调用引入额外决策与获取开销，摘要未讨论其对线上时延与服务成本的影响
监督依赖基于特征适用性与信息增益构造的轨迹，轨迹质量与构造成本可能制约效果
摘要未披露公开基准的具体设置与对比基线细节
papers.practical_value: 面向大规模搜索推荐的真实业务场景，AGR让系统按需调用异构特征而非全量注入，有望降低服务成本并缓解无关或冲突特征对SID生成的干扰，且已通过线上A/B测试验证，具备落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把生成式检索的特征利用问题从静态编码转为解码过程中的自适应工具调用，为语义ID生成与特征生态的结合提供了可监督、可上线的新路线。

papers.title: Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.
papers.summary: 该论文研究动态电商搜索中生成式检索的语义ID（SID）映射更新问题：新商品持续到达迫使周期性重映射SID与模型，但更新会破坏检索器已学习的搜索路径。作者基于67天大规模电商搜索日志开展受控实验，发现三点：SID语义漂移导致检索显著退化，且大beam size会掩盖真实严重性（beam=1时HitRate下降41.78-62.05%，beam=1000时仅8.33-10.85%）；变更SID比例与检索质量严格单调负相关，0%到72.75%重映射时HitRate最多下降42.66%，全量重映射在热启动下仍明显差于保持策略；遵循SID拓扑保持原则——固定旧商品SID、插入新商品、从上一模型热启动——即使最简单策略也有效，旧商品HitRate提升10%、新商品HitRate提升109%，并在两个不重叠更新周期验证。最终形成部署原则：插入新商品、冻结旧商品；能热启动则热启动，否则冻结；绝不更改模型已学SID。天猫APP三周在线A/B测试显示UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 动态电商中应保持已学SID拓扑不变，仅插入新商品并热启动模型，避免重映射导致的检索退化。
papers.core_method: 提出SID拓扑保持原则：固定旧商品SID、为新商品分配新SID、从上一版本模型热启动继续训练；通过67天搜索日志的受控实验系统刻画SID变更比例与检索质量的关系，并对比全量重映射与保持策略。
innovation_points: 系统量化SID语义漂移对生成式检索的影响，揭示大beam size通过冗余候选掩盖退化严重性；
发现变更SID比例与检索质量严格单调负相关，且短预算热启动无法修复全量重映射的拓扑破坏；
提出并验证最简单的拓扑保持策略（冻结旧SID+插入新SID+热启动）在旧/新商品上均显著有效；
给出可操作的部署原则，并在天猫APP在线A/B测试中验证业务价值。
experiment_results: beam=1时映射更新使HitRate下降41.78-62.05%，beam=1000时仅下降8.33-10.85%；
重映射比例从0%增至72.75%时HitRate单调下降，beam=1时最多下降42.66%；
拓扑保持策略使旧商品HitRate提升10%、新商品HitRate提升109%，两个不重叠更新周期验证；天猫APP三周在线A/B：UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。
limitations: 实验基于单一电商平台（天猫）日志，跨平台泛化性未验证；
未系统比较不同SID分配算法或模型架构下的拓扑保持效果；
在线A/B仅报告三周结果，长期影响与多次更新累积效应未充分讨论。
papers.practical_value: 为动态电商生成式检索提供可直接落地的SID更新部署原则：插入新商品、冻结旧商品SID、优先热启动，避免全量重映射；在真实业务中实现GMV与转化率正向收益，降低更新带来的检索退化风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 生成式检索在动态商品流中必须持续更新SID映射，但重映射会破坏已学拓扑。该文用大规模日志实验量化退化机制，并给出简单有效的保持策略与线上验证，对工业界部署具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
papers.abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $π_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.
papers.summary: SPAR 针对机器人端侧算力受限导致视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理成本高的问题展开研究。作者指出，仅靠监督微调难以恢复激进压缩带来的操作性能损失，因此提出结构化剪枝与动作恢复相结合的两阶段方案：先通过剪枝感知训练，同时裁剪 LLM 主干的隐藏维与前馈中间维，再以强化学习恢复策略性能。在 π0.5 上，语言主干由 2.34B 降至 0.09B，全模型由 3.37B 降至 1.12B，分别去除约 96% 与 67% 参数；在此压缩率下，RL 将四个 LIBERO 套件的平均成功率由 84.55% 提升至 93.45%，提升 8.90 个百分点，压缩策略相对未剪枝模型取得 1.98 倍推理加速。结果揭示了中间维度存在显著冗余，并表明剪枝后 RL 可在紧凑策略中恢复操作性能。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SPAR 通过结构化剪枝加剪枝后强化学习，在去除约 96% 语言主干参数的同时把 LIBERO 平均成功率提升 8.90 个百分点，并实现 1.98 倍推理加速。
papers.core_method: 对 VLA 模型 LLM 主干的隐藏维与前馈中间维做结构化剪枝，配合剪枝感知训练保持可训练性；剪枝后使用强化学习对动作策略进行恢复性后训练，以弥补监督微调无法挽回的性能损失。
innovation_points: 同时裁剪 LLM 主干的隐藏维与前馈中间维，而非仅做单一维度压缩
将剪枝感知训练与剪枝后强化学习结合，形成压缩—恢复的完整流程
在 π0.5 上验证极高压缩率下策略性能仍可恢复甚至超过原模型
experiment_results: 语言主干由 2.34B 降至 0.09B（约 96%），全模型由 3.37B 降至 1.12B（约 67%）
四个 LIBERO 套件平均成功率由 84.55% 提升至 93.45%，提升 8.90 个百分点
压缩策略相对未剪枝模型取得 1.98 倍推理加速
limitations: 实验仅在 π0.5 与 LIBERO 基准上验证，未覆盖更多 VLA 架构与真实机器人平台
摘要未报告压缩后策略在非 LIBERO 分布或真实场景中的泛化表现
RL 恢复阶段引入额外训练成本，摘要未给出其开销与稳定性分析
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人端侧算力受限的真实部署场景，SPAR 将 VLA 全模型压缩至约三分之一参数并带来近 2 倍推理加速，同时通过 RL 恢复操作成功率，为在有限 onboard 资源上运行大模型策略提供了可落地的压缩—恢复工程路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 它表明 VLA 的 LLM 主干中间维度存在大量冗余，且激进压缩后的性能损失可通过剪枝后强化学习有效挽回，为端侧 VLA 部署提供了压缩率与策略性能兼得的思路。

papers.title: Robot Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models for Agricultural Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $π_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $π_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.
papers.summary: 该论文面向农业番茄植株的到达与抓取任务，研究如何将预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）通用机器人策略适配到农业操作场景。作者构建了基于MuJoCo的农业仿真环境，包含多样番茄植株结构，通过手柄遥操作配合底层控制器采集专家演示；随后用仿真演示分别微调Octo与π0.5两个预训练通用策略，并在物理Franka Research 3机械臂上用真实机器人演示进一步微调。评估覆盖仿真中的分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件，以及真机实验，并考察本体感知信息对策略性能的影响。结果显示π0.5的任务性能得分高于Octo，且在分布偏移下退化更小，说明预训练通用策略结合任务特定演示学习在农业操作中具有潜力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 预训练VLA策略π0.5经仿真与真机演示微调后，在农业抓取任务上优于Octo且对分布偏移更鲁棒。
papers.core_method: 构建MuJoCo农业仿真环境与遥操作演示采集流程，对Octo和π0.5两个预训练通用机器人策略进行仿真演示微调，再在Franka Research 3真机上用真实演示继续微调，并在多种分布条件下评估，同时分析本体感知信息的作用。
innovation_points: 面向农业番茄植株操作，搭建含多样植株结构的MuJoCo仿真环境，支持演示采集与受控评估
提出仿真到真实的策略适配流程：遥操作采集演示、预训练策略仿真微调、真机演示再微调
系统比较Octo与π0.5在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下的表现，并考察本体感知信息影响
experiment_results: π0.5的任务性能得分高于Octo
π0.5在分布偏移下性能退化小于Octo
摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅报告相对比较结论
limitations: 依赖任务特定的仿真与真机演示，采集成本仍然存在
评估集中于番茄到达与抓取任务，任务范围有限
摘要未报告具体量化指标与统计显著性信息
papers.practical_value: 为农业机器人操作提供了一条可复用的仿真到真实适配路径，表明预训练通用VLA策略可经少量任务演示迁移至农业场景，对降低农业机器人编程与部署门槛具有参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将通用VLA策略适配与农业操作需求结合，验证了预训练策略在分布偏移下的鲁棒性差异，为农业机器人学习中的策略选型与仿真到真实迁移提供了实证参考。

papers.title: Robotic Photography System based on Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.
papers.summary: RoboPhoto-VLA 面向自主机器人摄影任务，要求系统理解拍摄意图、规划相机运动并在复杂环境中生成具有美感的图像。作者提出统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，将感知、推理与相机控制联合建模；其中 PhotoCoT 负责结构化的动作规划，Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization（ADPO）用于将相机行为与人类审美偏好对齐。为支持训练与评测，作者构建了带语言引导示教的机器人摄影数据集 OpenPhotography。真实世界实验表明，该方法生成的摄影作品更符合人类审美偏好，并能泛化到未见过的拍摄对象、视角、姿态和复杂摄影指令。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboPhoto-VLA 用统一 VLA 框架结合结构化规划与审美偏好对齐，让机器人摄影更符合人类审美并具备泛化能力。
papers.core_method: 提出 RoboPhoto-VLA 统一视觉-语言-动作框架，联合建模感知、推理与相机控制；引入 PhotoCoT 进行结构化动作规划，并采用 Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization（ADPO）将相机行为与人类审美偏好对齐；构建带语言引导示教的 OpenPhotography 数据集用于训练与评测。
innovation_points: 将 VLA 框架统一用于机器人摄影的感知、推理与相机控制联合建模
提出 PhotoCoT 实现结构化的摄影动作规划
提出 ADPO 将相机行为与人类审美偏好直接对齐
构建 OpenPhotography 语言引导机器人摄影数据集
experiment_results: 真实世界实验表明生成照片更符合人类审美偏好
在未见过的拍摄对象、视角、姿态和复杂摄影指令上表现出有效泛化
limitations: 摘要未提供定量指标或与基线方法的数值对比
真实世界实验的具体规模与评测协议未在摘要中说明
数据集与方法的通用性仍需更多场景验证
papers.practical_value: 为自主机器人摄影提供可落地的统一框架，结合结构化规划与审美偏好对齐，有望用于服务机器人、内容创作与自动化拍摄等场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将 VLA 模型从通用操作拓展到审美驱动的机器人摄影，并给出规划与偏好对齐的系统方案，对机器人视觉-语言-动作研究与自动化摄影应用均有参考价值。

papers.title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.
papers.summary: BetaMem针对长时程具身智能体在长期记忆中面临的时间混淆、记录不完整或失真、固定记忆规则导致错误复现以及存储与检索成本增长等问题，提出通过工作、空间、实体、情节、经验和程序六层联动结构构建可追溯且可演化的长期记忆。方法上采用双层写入契约约束记忆操作的可执行性与内容来源支撑，先用监督微调学习合规记忆操作，再用强化学习结合重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证来奖励完整准确记录、惩罚遗漏失真与无依据内容；同时以失败驱动的策略递归自我改进，沿记忆操作因果序列诊断并由独立回放门控局部规则修复，原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘建模为预算约束下的成本效用分配。实验使用Qwen3.5-9B生成记忆，在M3-Bench-robot、LoCoMo、OpenEQA EM-EQA和EgoLifeQA上分别取得48.08%、92.08%、72.6%和62.4%的总体得分，为所列记忆方法中最高；训练使契约通过率从50.9%升至86.2%，每存储动作输出token减少47.3%；Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在EMem-Bench上平均成功率38.4%、平均错误复现率24.9%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: BetaMem用六层可追溯记忆、双层写入契约和失败驱动的策略自改进，在受限预算下提升具身智能体长期记忆的准确性与一致性。
papers.core_method: 构建工作、空间、实体、情节、经验和程序六层联动长期记忆；以双层写入契约约束操作可执行性和内容来源支撑；监督微调学习合规记忆操作，强化学习结合重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证奖励完整准确记录；失败驱动策略递归自我改进，沿记忆操作因果序列诊断并由独立回放门控局部规则修复；原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘建模为存储与读取预算下的成本效用分配。
innovation_points: 提出六层联动、可追溯且可演化的长期记忆框架，覆盖从工作记忆到程序记忆的完整层次
设计双层写入契约，同时约束记忆操作的可执行性与内容来源支撑，减少无依据记录
结合监督微调与基于教师验证原始观测的强化学习，奖励完整准确记录并惩罚遗漏、失真和无支撑内容
以失败驱动策略递归自我改进和独立回放门控的局部规则修复，缓解固定记忆规则导致的错误复现
experiment_results: 使用Qwen3.5-9B生成记忆，M3-Bench-robot总体得分48.08%，LoCoMo 92.08%，OpenEQA EM-EQA 72.6%，EgoLifeQA 62.4%，为所列记忆方法中最高
训练记忆生成模型使契约通过率从50.9%提升至86.2%，每存储动作输出token减少47.3%
Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在EMem-Bench上平均成功率38.4%，平均错误复现率24.9%；在同等规模开源模型的方法中表现最佳
limitations: 实验主要基于Qwen3.5-9B和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct等特定开源模型，未展示跨更多基座模型的泛化结果
EMem-Bench上平均成功率38.4%、错误复现率24.9%，说明长时程记忆的准确性与错误抑制仍有提升空间
六层记忆结构与双层写入契约增加系统复杂度，摘要未给出存储与读取预算下的具体成本开销数据
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体在真实长时程任务中提供可追溯、可演化且受预算约束的长期记忆方案，降低固定规则导致的重复错误，并通过契约通过率提升和输出token减少改善记忆写入效率，适合对记忆准确性和来源可追溯性有要求的机器人及交互系统。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将长期记忆从静态存储规则推进为可学习、可验证、可自我修复的策略系统，并给出多基准上的量化结果，对具身智能体长时程记忆的设计与评估具有参考价值。

papers.title: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.
papers.summary: PrismWAM 关注世界动作模型（WAM）中“状态应如何表示”这一被忽视的问题。作者指出，现有 WAM 通常直接使用预训练视频模型的隐嵌入作为世界状态，这种表示把纹理、颜色等语义外观与占据、位姿等物理构型纠缠在一起，不利于动作条件下的演化建模。为此，PrismWAM 将物理与语义解耦，把具身任务分解为语义规划、物理推演、可执行动作三段流水线：仅给定初始 RGB 观测，语义规划预测最终目标图像，物理推演在深度空间预测朝目标的细粒度演化，再由深度推演生成可执行动作。作者称该方法无需具身动作预训练或额外数据增强，在仿真与真实世界操作任务上表现强劲，甚至超过具备大规模具身动作预训练的 OpenWAM-α 等模型。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PrismWAM 主张世界动作模型的状态应分离“世界看起来如何”与“世界在动作下如何演化”，并以语义规划、深度空间物理推演、动作生成的三段式流水线实现这一解耦。
papers.core_method: 将具身任务分解为 Semantic Planning → Physical Rollout → Executable Action 三段流水线：语义规划从初始 RGB 观测预测最终目标图像，提供语义上下文；物理推演在深度空间预测朝目标状态的细粒度演化，承载物理构型信息；最后由深度推演结果生成可执行动作。整体在联合建模状态与动作的同时，把物理因素与语义因素分离。
innovation_points: 提出 WAM 状态表示的再思考：世界状态应区分语义外观与动作驱动的物理演化，而非直接沿用预训练视频模型的纠缠隐嵌入。
以语义规划、深度空间物理推演、动作生成的三段式分解实现物理与语义解耦，并保持状态与动作的联合建模。
仅依赖初始 RGB 观测，无需具身动作预训练或额外数据增强即可完成操作任务。
将 WAM 的建模重心从“世界看起来如何”转向“世界如何响应动作”，指向以占据、流、触觉、本体感知等为中心的动作中心世界模型。
experiment_results: 摘要称在仿真与真实世界操作任务上均取得较强操作性能，但未给出具体数值指标。
摘要称在无具身动作预训练与额外数据增强条件下，性能超过包括 OpenWAM-α 在内的多类具备大规模具身动作预训练的模型；具体对比数据未在给定材料中披露。
limitations: 给定材料仅为标题、摘要与学术元数据，缺少定量实验结果、消融分析与失败案例，方法有效性证据有限。
物理推演依赖深度空间表示，摘要未说明深度信号来源及其在真实场景中的噪声与缺失鲁棒性。
语义规划以预测最终目标图像为中间目标，摘要未讨论目标图像预测偏差对后续物理推演与动作执行的误差累积影响。
papers.practical_value: 对具身智能与机器人操作而言，PrismWAM 提供了一条不依赖大规模具身动作预训练的状态表示路线：以初始 RGB 观测为输入，经语义目标预测与深度空间物理推演生成动作，有望降低对昂贵具身动作数据与预训练算力的依赖，并为以占据、流、触觉等物理信号为中心的世界模型设计提供可复用范式。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把世界动作模型的核心问题从“如何表示世界的外观”推进到“世界状态应包含什么、如何随动作演化”，提出语义与物理解耦的状态分解，对 WAM 的状态设计与动作中心世界模型的研究方向具有概念启发意义。

papers.title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.
papers.summary: PaceVLA针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中因学习遥操作演示的细粒度时序模式而导致执行步骤过多、时序效率低的问题，提出自适应时序动作量化框架。其核心是共享动作专家上的多模式动作解码器，支持多种时间粒度与预测视野，并配合可量化性引导的模式选择机制与上下文条件路由器，在每次推理时决定是否采用粗粒度执行。实验覆盖三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实任务，在多种本体（含长程与灵巧操作）上提升执行效率并保持任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PaceVLA通过可量化性引导的自适应时序动作量化，在保持任务成功率的同时显著提升VLA策略的执行效率。
papers.core_method: 在共享动作专家上构建支持多时间粒度与预测视野的模式特定动作解码器；引入可量化性引导的模式选择方案判断粗粒度执行是否合适，并用上下文条件路由器在每个推理步选择执行模式，形成统一的VLA自适应时序执行框架。
innovation_points: 提出模式特定动作解码器，基于共享动作专家支持多时间粒度与预测视野，避免为每种粒度单独训练策略。
设计可量化性引导的模式选择机制，显式判断当前阶段是否适合粗粒度执行，缓解速度-精度权衡。
引入上下文条件路由器，在每次推理步动态选择执行模式，实现细粒度与粗粒度控制的按需切换。
在多种本体（含长程与灵巧操作）上验证自适应时序量化的通用性。
experiment_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实世界任务上评估，报告执行效率提升且任务成功率保持。
覆盖多种本体，包括长程操作与灵巧操作场景。
摘要未给出具体成功率、加速比或消融数值，需查阅全文获取定量结果。
limitations: 模式选择依赖可量化性判断，其阈值或准则的设定与泛化性未在摘要中说明。
真实任务数量为六个，跨本体与跨任务的规模仍有限，需更多场景验证。
摘要未报告推理开销与路由器引入的额外计算成本。
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人部署中对快速可靠操作的需求，PaceVLA提供按需切换粗细粒度的执行机制，可在精度敏感交互中保留细粒度控制、在冗余阶段减少低层动作步数，对提升VLA策略的线上执行效率具有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面VLA策略时序效率低这一部署瓶颈，将动作量化从固定粒度推进为可量化性引导的自适应决策，为VLA在真实机器人上的高效执行提供了可复用的框架思路。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising.
