Behind that front door, responsibility remains allocable among manufacturers, AI system providers, integrators, maintainers, deployers, platform providers, and users according to actual control, knowledge, contribution, preventive capacity, and assigned duties. Registration, software-version records, maintenance histories, authorization profiles, and insurance information support a distributed, traceable, and reviewable backend. The proposal is presumptive rather than universal. Ordinary ownership remains the default outside the proposed high-risk category, and an ownership-based arrangement remains acceptable where it demonstrably preserves functionally equivalent lifecycle accountability. Governance intensity should remain risk-calibrated. Because leasing may itself enable surveillance, lock-in, remote suspension, repair restrictions, service withdrawal, unequal access, or market concentration, the framework includes reciprocal safeguards: purpose limitation and data minimization, perceptible sensing indicators, portability, qualified repair, service-continuity duties, notice and review, competition oversight, and public supervision. The paper offers a normative institutional model rather than an empirical evaluation. Its central claim is that, for a defined class of high-risk embodied systems, continued use should remain connected to continued responsibility.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI Ethics and Society
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 本文针对高风险具身AI（如护理机器人）在长期运行中因软件更新、自适应行为、硬件退化、用户修改和部署环境变化导致安全与隐私属性漂移的问题，指出现有以一次性销售和形式所有权为核心的法律模型无法识别持续风险监测、证据保存、维修召回协调与救济提供的责任主体。作者提出以租赁作为制度性治理结构而非单纯支付机制：用户获得情境化授权使用权，持牌出租方作为全生命周期责任对应方，负责入网注册、动态数字护照、检查维护、重大变更评估、分级事件报告、证据保全、维修、再授权、召回及保险支持救济。框架将外部问责与内部责任分配分离，前端为受影响人提供可见报告与补救通道，后端依据实际控制、知识、贡献、预防能力与指派义务在制造商、AI提供方、集成商、维护方、部署方、平台与用户间分配责任，并配套目的限制、数据最小化、可感知传感提示、可移植性、合格维修、服务连续性、通知审查、竞争监管与公共监督等互惠保障。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 对高风险具身AI，持续使用应与持续责任绑定，租赁可作为可识别全生命周期责任主体的制度治理结构。
papers.core_method: 规范性制度设计：以租赁界定有限使用权，设持牌出租方为全生命周期责任对应方，整合注册、动态数字护照、检查维护、变更评估、分级事件报告、证据保全、维修再授权、召回与保险救济；外部问责与内部责任按实际控制、知识、贡献、预防能力和指派义务分配。
innovation_points: 将租赁从支付机制重构为高风险具身AI的全生命周期治理结构，明确可识别的责任对应方
提出动态数字护照与软件版本、维护历史、授权配置、保险信息联动的可追溯后端
分离外部问责与内部责任分配，前端提供可见报告与补救通道，后端按控制与知识等要素分摊责任
引入互惠保障以对冲租赁可能带来的监控、锁定、远程停用、维修限制、服务撤出与市场集中风险
experiment_results: 本文为规范性制度模型，未开展实证评估，摘要未报告任何实验数据或量化结果
limitations: 仅为规范性制度模型，缺乏实证评估与真实部署验证
适用范围限于所定义的高风险具身系统类别，普通所有权仍为默认，治理强度需风险校准
租赁本身可能引发监控、锁定、远程停用、维修限制、服务撤出、不平等接入与市场集中等风险，需依赖配套保障落实
papers.practical_value: 为高风险具身AI的部署方、制造商与监管者提供可操作的制度模板：以租赁合同和数字护照明确全生命周期责任主体，建立事件报告、证据保全与救济通道，降低受害者追溯技术供应链的成本，并通过保险与再授权机制支撑召回和持续合规。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文直面具身AI“持续技术控制与持续责任分离”的治理缺口，提出可识别责任对应方与可追溯后端的制度方案，对高风险机器人落地中的问责、证据与救济问题具有直接参考价值，并提示租赁治理自身的权力风险与对冲设计。

papers.title: Red-Teaming of Vision-Language-Action Models via Quality Diversity Environment Generation
papers.abstract: A long-standing goal in robotics is to develop generalist robots that can perform tasks across a wide range of settings, flexibly specified with images and text. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising path toward this goal by training on large collections of robot demonstrations. However, while VLAs perform well in-distribution, they often fail under minor test-time shifts, such as changes in object positions, lighting, textures, and camera poses. To address this, we propose Quality Diversity for Diverse Environment Generation (Q-DEG), a method for improving VLA robustness by generating adversarial environments and fine-tuning the VLA on its own successful rollouts. Q-DEG uses Quality Diversity (QD) optimization to find a set of high-failure environments, while promoting diversity using policy embeddings extracted from the VLA. These environments expose vulnerabilities that can be mitigated through self-imitation fine-tuning, thereby improving the VLA's robustness. In simulation, we conduct experiments across three representative VLA models, and our results indicate that Q-DEG improves robustness to out-of-distribution (OOD) adversarial environments compared to the base VLA and VLAs fine-tuned using data collected from two red-teaming baselines. Furthermore, we demonstrate that improving VLA robustness through Q-DEG facilitates sim-to-real transfer. Our anonymous project website is at: https://qd-env.github.io/qdeg/.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在测试时轻微分布偏移（物体位置、光照、纹理、相机位姿变化）下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出Q-DEG方法。Q-DEG利用质量多样性（QD）优化，以从VLA提取的策略嵌入促进多样性，搜索一组高失败率对抗环境，再让VLA在自身成功轨迹上做自模仿微调，从而暴露并缓解脆弱性。仿真中在三个代表性VLA模型上实验，Q-DEG相比基座VLA及两个红队基线数据微调的VLA，提升了对分布外对抗环境的鲁棒性，并促进仿真到真实迁移。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Q-DEG用质量多样性搜索生成多样化高失败环境，再以自模仿微调提升VLA对分布偏移的鲁棒性并助力sim-to-real迁移。
papers.core_method: 以质量多样性（QD）优化搜索高失败率且多样的对抗环境，多样性由从VLA提取的策略嵌入度量；随后在VLA于这些环境中自身成功完成的rollout上做自模仿微调，迭代提升鲁棒性。
innovation_points: 将质量多样性优化用于VLA红队环境生成，兼顾高失败率与多样性
用VLA策略嵌入作为多样性描述符，使对抗环境覆盖不同失败模式
采用自模仿微调，仅利用VLA自身成功rollout缓解暴露的脆弱性
experiment_results: 仿真中在三个代表性VLA模型上，Q-DEG相比基座VLA及两个红队基线数据微调的VLA，提升了对OOD对抗环境的鲁棒性
展示了通过Q-DEG提升鲁棒性可促进sim-to-real迁移
摘要未给出具体数值指标
limitations: 实验主要在仿真中进行，真实世界验证范围有限
依赖VLA自身成功rollout进行微调，失败环境中可用的成功样本可能受限
摘要未报告计算开销与QD搜索成本
papers.practical_value: 为机器人VLA部署提供可自动发现测试时脆弱环境并自我改进的流程，降低对人工设计对抗场景的依赖，有助于提升真实场景下的鲁棒性与迁移表现。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA在分布内表现好但轻微偏移即失败，Q-DEG把红队测试与自模仿微调闭环结合，为提升机器人基础模型鲁棒性提供了可复用的环境生成与训练思路。

papers.title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.
papers.summary: LAPT-Scale 针对通用机器人策略受限于具身交互数据采集成本高的问题，提出利用大规模第一视角人类视频进行可扩展的潜在动作预训练。其核心是 LAPT-Scale-LAM：在连续潜在空间中学习帧间视觉转移的潜在动作，作为人类视频衍生的隐式监督，避免向量量化带来的运动细节损失，并融合感知、语义与光流对齐信号改进转移级监督。LAPT-Scale-Policy 则通过人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐和任务特定后训练三阶段训练 VLA 策略。在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上训练后，随着标注人类视频从 1K 扩展到 5K 小时，真实机器人成功率从 63.3% 提升至 85.0%，并泛化到未见视觉条件。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用连续潜在动作解释人类视频帧间转移，可为 VLA 策略提供可扩展的隐式动作监督，并随人类视频规模增长带来真实机器人成功率提升。
papers.core_method: 两阶段范式：LAPT-Scale-LAM 在连续潜在空间学习帧间视觉转移的潜在动作，融合感知、语义与光流对齐信号作为转移级监督；LAPT-Scale-Policy 依次进行人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐和任务特定后训练，训练 VLA 策略。
innovation_points: 采用连续潜在动作空间而非向量量化，保留细粒度运动与交互动态
融合感知、语义和光流对齐信号，超越像素重建的转移级监督
将人类视频潜在动作作为隐式动作监督用于 VLA 策略预训练，并配合具身对齐与任务后训练
在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上验证数据规模扩展带来的策略收益
experiment_results: 在 23.3K 小时第一视角视频上训练 LAPT-Scale-LAM，为策略预训练提供隐式动作监督
标注人类视频从 1K 扩展到 5K 小时时，真实机器人成功率从 63.3% 提升至 85.0%
学习到的策略可泛化到未见视觉条件
limitations: 摘要未给出与向量量化 LAM 的定量对比结果
具身对齐与后训练的具体数据需求和工程成本未在摘要中说明
真实机器人评估的任务范围与统计显著性未在摘要中披露
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略提供了一条以低成本人类视频替代昂贵具身交互数据的预训练路径，连续潜在动作与多信号对齐有助于在真实视觉复杂度和多样操作动态下获得更稳定的隐式动作监督，并展示了随视频规模扩展的线上真实机器人收益。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把人类视频从辅助数据提升为可扩展的策略预训练监督源，并给出从 1K 到 5K 小时视频规模下真实机器人成功率提升的扩展证据，对降低具身策略数据瓶颈具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a major bottleneck for reinforcement learning in robotic manipulation. Handcrafted dense rewards can compensate for the limited guidance provided by sparse rewards, but require substantial task-specific reward engineering. Learning rewards from videos provides a scalable, data-driven alternative to manual reward design. However, existing video-based rewards are often computed in entangled visual spaces where task-relevant state changes are confounded with extraneous visual variation. As a result, the learned reward may respond to visual distractors instead of actual task execution. To address this limitation, we propose DiTaR (Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling), a framework for learning dense rewards from heterogeneous videos. DiTaR learns a continuous task-relevant representation from multi-frame video latents through an asymmetric two-stage procedure that suppresses task-irrelevant visual variation. In the task-relevant latent space, we train a history- and language-conditioned rectified-flow model to capture task dynamics and derive a directional dense reward from temporal changes in dynamics compatibility. Together, these components enable reward modeling directly over task-relevant dynamics rather than generic visual variation. DiTaR substantially improves policy learning on MetaWorld-v3 and ManiSkill over video-based reward baselines, and transfers to real-world offline RL through reward relabeling. Reward analyses further show that DiTaR provides more reliable rewards.
papers.summary: 该论文针对机器人操作强化学习中奖励设计瓶颈，提出从异构视频学习稠密奖励的DiTaR框架。现有视频奖励在纠缠视觉空间中计算，任务相关状态变化与无关视觉变化混杂，导致奖励响应视觉干扰而非任务执行。DiTaR通过非对称两阶段过程从多帧视频潜变量学习连续任务相关表示，抑制任务无关视觉变化；在任务相关潜空间中训练历史与语言条件化的整流流模型以捕捉任务动态，并基于动态兼容性的时间变化导出方向性稠密奖励。由此奖励建模直接作用于任务相关动态而非通用视觉变化。在MetaWorld-v3和ManiSkill上，DiTaR显著改进策略学习，优于视频奖励基线，并通过奖励重标注迁移至真实世界离线RL；奖励分析进一步表明其奖励更可靠。
papers.one_line_takeaway: DiTaR通过解耦任务相关潜动态，从异构视频学习更可靠的稠密奖励，显著提升机器人操作策略学习并迁移至真实世界离线RL。
papers.core_method: 非对称两阶段学习任务相关连续表示以抑制视觉干扰；在任务相关潜空间训练历史与语言条件化整流流模型捕捉任务动态；基于动态兼容性的时间变化导出方向性稠密奖励。
innovation_points: 提出非对称两阶段过程，从多帧视频潜变量中解耦任务相关表示，抑制任务无关视觉变化
在任务相关潜空间而非纠缠视觉空间建模奖励，使奖励响应实际任务执行
训练历史与语言条件化整流流模型捕捉任务动态，并导出方向性稠密奖励
支持从异构视频学习奖励，并通过奖励重标注迁移至真实世界离线RL
experiment_results: 在MetaWorld-v3和ManiSkill上，DiTaR显著改进策略学习，优于视频奖励基线
通过奖励重标注迁移至真实世界离线RL
奖励分析表明DiTaR提供更可靠的奖励；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: 摘要未报告具体定量指标与消融细节，难以评估各组件贡献
真实世界迁移仅提及奖励重标注，未说明规模与任务多样性
方法依赖多帧视频潜变量与整流流模型，计算与工程复杂度可能较高
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作提供可扩展的视频奖励学习方案，减少手工奖励工程；解耦任务相关动态可提升奖励可靠性，并支持从异构视频到真实世界离线RL的迁移，对工业机器人策略学习有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 奖励设计是机器人RL的核心瓶颈，该工作从表示解耦角度解决视频奖励受视觉干扰的问题，为可扩展、可靠的稠密奖励建模提供新思路，并展示真实世界迁移潜力。

papers.title: Axiom-0: Hierarchical Self-Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Reliable manipulation requires policies that generalize across tasks, layouts, and object interactions. Vision-language-action (VLA) models combine pretrained multimodal understanding with learned control, but their performance remains limited on unfamiliar task compositions. We present Axiom-0, a VLA policy that addresses both the quality of its representations and their use in action generation through hierarchical self-refinement. Intra-VLM Representation Refinement (IVRR) strengthens selected intermediate features through consistency supervision with learned feature projections during training. VLM-Action Interface Refinement (VAIR) recursively updates the resulting conditioning before action generation. Joint optimization of the supervised VLM layers, VAIR, and the action generator connects the two components. On RoboCasa365, Axiom-0 achieves 62.32% overall success in our evaluation, exceeding the highest published leaderboard score (Paimon-0, 58.1%) by 4.22 percentage points and the Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reference by 4.92 points. Under the evaluated profiling setup, mean action-chunk generation latency increases by 1.7% over Xiaomi-Robotics-1. These results demonstrate improved task completion with modest inference overhead.
papers.summary: Axiom-0针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在陌生任务组合上泛化不足的问题，提出分层自精炼策略，同时改进表征质量与动作生成中的表征利用。方法包含两个组件：IVRR在训练时通过一致性监督与学习到的特征投影，强化VLM选定的中间特征；VAIR在动作生成前递归更新条件表征。二者与动作生成器、受监督VLM层联合优化，形成端到端连接。在RoboCasa365评测中总体成功率达62.32%，高于已公布最高榜分Paimon-0（58.1%）4.22个百分点，高于Xiaomi-Robotics-1参考4.92个百分点；在所述性能分析设置下，平均动作块生成延迟较Xiaomi-Robotics-1仅增加1.7%。结果表明该方法以较小推理开销提升任务完成率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Axiom-0通过VLM内部表征精炼与VLM-动作接口递归精炼的联合优化，在RoboCasa365上以约1.7%的延迟代价取得62.32%成功率，超过现有公开最好结果。
papers.core_method: 分层自精炼VLA策略：IVRR在训练阶段以一致性监督和学习到的特征投影强化VLM选定中间特征；VAIR在动作生成前递归更新条件表征；受监督VLM层、VAIR与动作生成器联合优化，将表征改进传导至动作输出。
innovation_points: 提出分层自精炼框架，将表征质量提升与动作生成中的表征利用分开处理并联合优化
IVRR通过一致性监督与特征投影强化VLM中间特征，而非仅依赖最终层输出
VAIR在动作生成前递归更新条件表征，改善VLM到动作生成器的接口
在RoboCasa365上以较小推理延迟增幅取得领先成功率
experiment_results: RoboCasa365总体成功率62.32%，超过Paimon-0（58.1%）4.22个百分点，超过Xiaomi-Robotics-1参考4.92个百分点
在所述性能分析设置下，平均动作块生成延迟较Xiaomi-Robotics-1增加1.7%
摘要未提供各子任务、消融实验或跨布局泛化的细分数据
limitations: 评测主要基于RoboCasa365单一基准，跨真实机器人平台与更多任务组合的泛化性未在摘要中说明
延迟增加1.7%虽小，但递归精炼带来的推理开销在实时控制场景中的影响仍需更细粒度分析
摘要未给出IVRR与VAIR各自的消融贡献，难以判断两组件相对重要性
papers.practical_value: 为VLA策略在机器人操作中提升陌生任务组合成功率提供了可工程化的训练与推理方案；延迟增幅有限，具备部署在真实操作流水线中的潜力，尤其适合对任务泛化要求高、对推理时延有一定容忍度的场景。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA模型的核心瓶颈之一是如何让预训练多模态表征真正服务于动作生成。Axiom-0将表征精炼与接口精炼分层处理并联合优化，给出了可复现的性能提升路径，对关注VLA架构设计与机器人操作落地研究者具有参考价值。

papers.title: JoyInside-VLM-Agent: Product-Conditioned Multimodal Policy Learning for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Embodied agents must translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback. We present JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal agent developed through product-conditioned trajectory construction and staged policy learning for robotic platforms and smart hardware. A closed-loop sandbox generates multimodal interaction trajectories covering goal revisions and failure recovery, which are checked against execution outcomes and semantic criteria. Supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation precede reinforcement learning with DPER (Dual-Source Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Token-Level Evidence Routing). DPER routes token-level evidence between a frozen privileged teacher and a privileged student sharing the rollout policy's parameters, modulating reward-derived token advantages while preserving their signs. Training rewards combine generative process evaluation, multi-judge rankings, and task-queue consistency. JoyInside-VLM-Agent achieves a BFCL v4 overall score of 77.44, exceeding the evaluated baselines; results on the other public benchmarks are mixed. On JoyInside-Devices and JoyInside-Robotics, the evaluated system, which includes domain-specific skill refinement, leads the baselines on all reported metrics. Two real-world quadruped case studies illustrate visually grounded search, replanning after execution failure, and explicit failure reporting.
papers.summary: 该论文提出JoyInside-VLM-Agent，一个面向机器人与智能硬件的ReAct风格多模态具身智能体，核心在于产品条件化的轨迹构建与分阶段策略学习。研究问题是如何让具身智能体在多模态观测、用户请求、产品约束、目标变更和执行反馈下生成可执行动作。技术路线包括：闭环沙盒生成覆盖目标修订与失败恢复的多模态交互轨迹，并按执行结果与语义标准校验；先进行监督微调与多教师在线策略蒸馏，再采用DPER（双源特权在线策略自蒸馏与token级证据路由）强化学习，在冻结特权教师与共享rollout参数的特权学生之间路由token级证据，调制奖励导出的token优势并保持符号；训练奖励融合生成过程评估、多评委排序与任务队列一致性。结果上，BFCL v4总分77.44超过所评估基线，其他公开基准表现不一；在JoyInside-Devices与JoyInside-Robotics上所有报告指标领先基线，并用两个真实四足机器人案例展示视觉 grounding 搜索、执行失败后重规划与显式失败报告。
papers.one_line_takeaway: JoyInside-VLM-Agent通过产品条件化轨迹与DPER分阶段策略学习，将多模态具身智能体从沙盒训练推向真实设备部署，并在自建设备与机器人基准上全面领先。
papers.core_method: 采用ReAct风格多模态智能体框架，先由闭环沙盒生成覆盖目标修订和失败恢复的多模态交互轨迹，并以执行结果和语义标准校验；随后进行监督微调与多教师在线策略蒸馏；最后使用DPER强化学习，在冻结特权教师与共享rollout参数的特权学生之间进行token级证据路由，调制奖励导出的token优势并保持符号，训练奖励结合生成过程评估、多评委排序和任务队列一致性。
innovation_points: 提出产品条件化的多模态轨迹构建与闭环沙盒校验机制，覆盖目标修订和失败恢复场景
设计DPER方法，在冻结特权教师与特权学生之间进行token级证据路由，调制优势同时保持符号
将生成过程评估、多评委排序与任务队列一致性组合为训练奖励，用于具身策略学习
在真实四足机器人上展示视觉 grounding 搜索、执行失败后重规划与显式失败报告
experiment_results: BFCL v4总体得分77.44，超过所评估基线
在JoyInside-Devices和JoyInside-Robotics上，包含领域特定技能精炼的评估系统在所有报告指标上领先基线
其他公开基准结果表现不一；两个真实四足机器人案例展示视觉 grounding 搜索、失败后重规划与显式失败报告
limitations: 其他公开基准上的结果表现不一，泛化能力有限
真实世界验证仅以两个四足机器人案例研究呈现，规模有限
摘要未提供消融实验或各阶段贡献的定量分析
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人与智能硬件的真实产品约束，提供从沙盒轨迹构建、分阶段策略学习到线上部署的完整工程路径；DPER与多源奖励设计可直接用于提升具身智能体在目标变更和失败恢复场景下的执行可靠性，并已在自建设备与机器人基准上验证领先性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将多模态大模型智能体的训练与真实产品约束、执行反馈和失败恢复紧密结合，提出可落地的分阶段策略学习与DPER强化学习方法，对具身智能体从实验室走向真实硬件部署具有参考价值。

papers.title: OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.
papers.summary: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后训练过度依赖轨迹级监督模仿、导致策略偏向演示动作路径且偏离后缺乏恢复引导的问题，本文提出OGPO离线目标条件策略优化框架。OGPO将离线演示自适应重标注为语义关键状态，并构建目标条件过程奖励，把后训练从轨迹级动作模仿转变为关键状态可达性学习，使策略能从可行的非演示状态恢复至任务进展状态，且无需额外在线交互。在LIBERO和MetaWorld上，OGPO稳定优于标准监督微调；在LIBERO-Plus及作者提出的LIBERO-ReAct执行中扰动基准上，展现出更强的分布偏移鲁棒性与目标导向可恢复性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OGPO把VLA后训练从逐步动作模仿转为关键状态可达性学习，在不增加在线交互的前提下显著提升偏离演示后的恢复能力。
papers.core_method: 将离线演示轨迹自适应重标注为语义关键状态，构建目标条件过程奖励，以离线目标条件策略优化替代轨迹级监督模仿，训练VLA策略从可行非演示状态到达任务进展状态。
innovation_points: 提出离线目标条件策略优化框架，将演示从动作标签转为关键状态可达性监督信号
设计语义关键状态自适应重标注与目标条件过程奖励构建机制
提出LIBERO-ReAct执行中扰动基准，用于评估可恢复性
无需额外在线交互即可获得偏离演示后的目标导向恢复能力
experiment_results: 在LIBERO和MetaWorld上，OGPO持续优于标准监督微调
在LIBERO-Plus上展现出更强的分布偏移鲁棒性
在LIBERO-ReAct执行中扰动基准上展现出更强的目标导向可恢复性
limitations: 方法依赖离线演示中可提取的语义关键状态，关键状态质量可能影响重标注与奖励构建效果
评估集中于LIBERO和MetaWorld仿真基准，未提供真实机器人平台验证
摘要未给出具体量化提升幅度与计算开销数据
papers.practical_value: 为机器人VLA模型后训练提供无需在线交互的恢复性优化方案，降低对演示轨迹逐步复现的依赖，提升执行偏离后的任务完成率，适合部署前离线增强与鲁棒性加固。
papers.why_it_matters: 它重新定义了VLA后训练目标：从模仿专家动作转向学习到达任务关键状态，为离线数据利用和真实执行中的误差恢复提供了可复用的训练范式。

papers.title: Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅以动作块为预测目标、缺乏对未来物理效果显式建模的问题，提出动作—未来耦合效果学习（AFCE）。方法上，先用离线分词器从示范动作、真实机器人响应和稀疏视觉变化中构建按时间排序的Effect token，并通过重建目标保留可执行细节与观测到的物理变化；再由流匹配VLA根据当前图像、指令和机器人状态预测Effect，经状态条件解码器转换为动作块，并以具身特定接口让单臂与双臂任务共享Effect模型。在DexJoCo上总体成功率为50.97%，分别比π0.5和UVT高11.82和15.21个百分点，并在全部五项双臂任务上领先。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AFCE把未来物理效果而非动作块作为VLA主预测目标，在DexJoCo上以50.97%总体成功率显著超越π0.5与UVT。
papers.core_method: 离线分词器将示范动作、真实机器人响应与稀疏视觉变化编码为时间有序的Effect token，并以重建目标约束表示；流匹配VLA从当前图像、语言指令和机器人状态预测Effect，状态条件解码器再将Effect转为动作块；具身特定接口支持单臂与双臂任务共享同一Effect模型。
innovation_points: 将未来物理Effect而非动作块设为VLA策略的主预测目标，显式建模动作后果
用离线分词器融合示范动作、真实响应与稀疏视觉变化构建时间有序Effect token，并以重建目标保留可执行细节与物理变化
以流匹配VLA预测Effect、状态条件解码器生成动作块，解耦效果预测与动作执行
通过具身特定接口让单臂与双臂任务共享Effect模型
experiment_results: DexJoCo总体成功率为50.97%，分别比π0.5和UVT高11.82和15.21个百分点
在全部五项双臂任务上均取得领先
limitations: 实验仅在DexJoCo基准上验证，未提供真实机器人部署或跨具身泛化数据
Effect token依赖离线分词器与稀疏视觉变化构建，其表示质量对示范数据覆盖的敏感性未在材料中说明
摘要未报告推理延迟、训练成本等工程指标
papers.practical_value: 为机器人VLA策略提供以未来物理效果为监督的建模范式，Effect模型可在单臂与双臂具身间共享，有望降低多形态机器人策略开发中的重复建模成本，并为协调双臂灵巧操作提供更可解释的中间表示。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了VLA以动作块为预测核心的惯例，把监督信号前移到动作将产生的物理效果，并在双臂灵巧操作基准上给出显著提升，为后续效果驱动策略学习与跨具身共享提供了可参考的技术路线。

papers.title: Dual-Stream Memory for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Memory-dependent manipulation requires a policy to track execution state and recover visual evidence that is no longer observable. We propose dual-stream memory for vision-language-action policies, assigning these requirements to complementary representations. A task-agnostic Gated DeltaNet compresses history into one temporal token, supervised by progress prediction and action-conditioned feature reconstruction. A task-conditioned retriever retains frames above a fixed relevance threshold; linear multi-scale fusion encodes each frame into sixteen spatial tokens. We then freeze the temporal compressor and jointly optimize retrieval and policy learning. Across sixteen RoboMME tasks, the complete model achieves 49.22% mean success versus 44.51% for the published FrameSamp+Modul reference, improving fourteen tasks and all four suite means. On four real-robot tasks, mean success reaches 62.5% versus 37.5%, with the largest gains on repeated actions requiring execution-stage discrimination. These results support combining execution context with selective visual access, while failures under cup swaps expose persistent identity tracking as an unresolved requirement.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在依赖记忆的操作任务中难以同时跟踪执行状态与恢复不可见视觉证据的问题，提出双流记忆架构：一条流用任务无关的Gated DeltaNet将历史压缩为单个时序token，并以进度预测和动作条件特征重建作为监督；另一条流用任务条件检索器保留相关性超过固定阈值的帧，并通过线性多尺度融合将每帧编码为16个空间token。训练时先冻结时序压缩器，再联合优化检索与策略学习。在16个RoboMME任务上，完整模型平均成功率为49.22%，高于已发表FrameSamp+Modul参考的44.51%，在14个任务及全部4个套件均值上均有提升；在4个真实机器人任务上平均成功率为62.5%，对比37.5%，在需要区分执行阶段的重复动作上增益最大。杯子交换场景下的失败表明持续身份跟踪仍是未解决问题。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 双流记忆将执行状态压缩与选择性视觉检索解耦，在仿真与真实机器人任务上均显著优于参考方法，但持续身份跟踪仍是瓶颈。
papers.core_method: 提出双流记忆：任务无关Gated DeltaNet将历史压缩为单时序token，由进度预测与动作条件特征重建监督；任务条件检索器保留高于固定相关性阈值的帧，线性多尺度融合将每帧编码为16个空间token；冻结时序压缩器后联合优化检索与策略学习。
innovation_points: 将记忆需求解耦为互补表示：时序压缩流负责执行状态跟踪，检索流负责恢复不可见视觉证据
用进度预测和动作条件特征重建监督单token时序压缩器，并以冻结压缩器联合优化检索与策略
线性多尺度融合将检索帧编码为固定数量空间token，控制计算开销并适配策略学习
experiment_results: 16个RoboMME任务上平均成功率49.22%，对比FrameSamp+Modul参考44.51%，提升14个任务及全部4个套件均值
4个真实机器人任务上平均成功率62.5%，对比37.5%，重复动作任务增益最大
杯子交换场景下失败，表明持续身份跟踪仍未解决
limitations: 杯子交换等需要持续身份跟踪的场景仍失败，身份保持是未解决问题
检索依赖固定相关性阈值，阈值选择对性能的影响未在摘要中说明
真实机器人任务仅4个，泛化性证据有限
papers.practical_value: 为依赖记忆的机器人操作提供可工程化的双流记忆设计：单token时序压缩降低历史建模开销，阈值检索与固定空间token编码控制视觉记忆成本，冻结压缩器后联合优化便于分阶段训练与部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将VLA策略的记忆问题拆分为执行状态跟踪与选择性视觉访问两个可独立优化的子问题，并在仿真与真实机器人上给出一致增益，为记忆增强型VLA提供了可复用的架构与训练范式，同时明确指出身份跟踪这一关键未解需求。

papers.title: SADP: Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy for Long-Horizon Manipulation Learned From Foundation Model Generated Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires policies to coordinate multiple intermediate subgoals and determine when to advance between them. However, most imitation learning methods are trained solely on task-level demonstrations, without explicitly modeling the active subgoal or its execution progress. This limitation is further exacerbated by the scarcity of subgoal-level supervision in standard robot learning datasets, which makes explicit subgoal-conditioned control and online transition modeling difficult to learn. To address this issue, this paper proposes Subgoal-Aware Diffusion Policy (SADP), a framework that leverages foundation models to autonomously generate subgoal-annotated demonstrations and trains diffusion policies on these datasets. SADP structures policy execution around explicit natural-language subgoals by conditioning action generation on both task-level and subgoal-level descriptions. A lightweight auxiliary head further predicts a continuation score that drives online subgoal switching and supports stage-level progress monitoring. Experiments in RLBench simulations and real-world evaluations on a UR5e robot demonstrate that SADP maintains competitive task performance while exposing temporally aligned subgoal-level execution signals for progress monitoring. These results show that explicit subgoal progression can be incorporated into a diffusion policy without degrading task-level performance.
papers.summary: 该论文针对长时程机器人操作中多子目标协调与切换问题，指出现有模仿学习仅依赖任务级演示、缺乏子目标级监督，导致难以学习显式子目标条件控制与在线切换。作者提出子目标感知扩散策略SADP：利用基础模型自动生成带子目标标注的演示数据，将动作生成同时以任务级和子目标级自然语言描述为条件，并设计轻量辅助头预测延续分数以驱动在线子目标切换和阶段级进度监控。在RLBench仿真与UR5e真机实验中，SADP保持有竞争力的任务性能，同时提供时间对齐的子目标级执行信号，表明显式子目标推进可嵌入扩散策略而不损害任务级表现。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用基础模型自动生成子目标标注演示，让扩散策略在任务级与子目标级语言条件下生成动作，并以延续分数实现在线子目标切换。
papers.core_method: SADP以基础模型自动生成带自然语言子目标标注的演示数据集；扩散策略的动作生成同时条件于任务级描述和当前子目标描述；附加轻量辅助头预测延续分数，用于在线判断子目标是否完成并切换，同时支持阶段级进度监控。
innovation_points: 利用基础模型自动生成子目标级标注演示，缓解标准机器人数据集中子目标监督稀缺的问题
将任务级与子目标级自然语言描述共同作为扩散策略的动作生成条件，实现显式子目标条件控制
引入轻量辅助头预测延续分数，驱动在线子目标切换并支持阶段级进度监控
experiment_results: RLBench仿真实验表明SADP保持有竞争力的任务性能，并提供时间对齐的子目标级执行信号
UR5e真机评估显示显式子目标推进可融入扩散策略而不降低任务级表现
摘要未给出具体成功率、切换准确率等量化数值
limitations: 子目标标注依赖基础模型自动生成，其质量与覆盖范围可能影响策略学习效果
实验规模与任务多样性在摘要中未充分说明，泛化性证据有限
延续分数仅支持阶段级进度监控，细粒度执行进度建模仍待探索
papers.practical_value: 为长时程机器人操作提供可落地的子目标级监督生成与在线切换机制，降低人工标注子目标成本，并输出阶段级进度信号，便于真实产线中的过程监控与异常干预。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把基础模型生成演示与扩散策略结合，显式建模子目标推进，为长时程操作中的监督稀缺和在线切换难题提供了可复用的技术路线。

papers.title: Colosseum V2: Benchmarking Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate promising generalization in robotic manipulation, driven by advances in large-scale vision and language pre-training. This progress can be misleading. Despite the zero-shot perception and language capabilities of VLAs, their overall task performance often degrades under distribution shifts, revealing gaps in how these systems translate high-level understanding into robust behavior. To systematically study this gap, we introduce Colosseum V2, a large-scale simulation benchmark for evaluating VLA generalization in robot learning across diverse conditions. The benchmark comprises 28 tasks spanning 13 task categories and two robot morphologies, covering a wide range of manipulation primitives and long-horizon behaviors. Built on the ManiSkill simulator, Colosseum V2 enables fast, GPU-parallelized evaluation and supports both in-domain and out-of-domain testing at scale. We evaluate state-of-the-art methods, including Action Chunking Transformers (ACT) and Pi0.5, and reveal limitations in both base performance and generalization. We demonstrate strong correlations between simulation and real-world metrics that support the ecological validity of the benchmark. By standardizing tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols within a unified benchmark, Colosseum V2 enables reproducible and fair comparisons, reduced evaluation overhead, and accelerated progress toward general-purpose robot policies.
papers.summary: Colosseum V2 是一个面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型泛化能力评估的大规模仿真基准。研究问题源于一个反差：VLA 借助大规模视觉与语言预训练获得了零样本感知与语言理解能力，但在分布偏移下整体任务表现常显著退化，说明高层理解向鲁棒行为的转化存在缺口。作者基于 ManiSkill 模拟器构建 28 个任务、覆盖 13 个任务类别与两种机器人形态，涵盖多种操作原语与长程行为，支持 GPU 并行化的大规模域内与域外测试。作者评测了 ACT 与 Pi0.5 等先进方法，揭示基础性能与泛化两方面的局限，并报告仿真与真实世界指标之间的强相关性以支撑基准的生态效度。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Colosseum V2 用统一仿真基准系统暴露了 VLA 模型在分布偏移下“感知强、行为弱”的泛化缺口。
papers.core_method: 构建基于 ManiSkill 的 GPU 并行仿真基准，标准化 28 个任务（13 类、两种机器人形态）的任务定义、指标与评测协议，设置域内与域外测试条件，并对 ACT、Pi0.5 等 VLA 方法进行规模化评测与仿真-真实相关性分析。
innovation_points: 覆盖 13 个任务类别、两种机器人形态与长程行为的统一 VLA 泛化评测体系
同时支持域内与域外测试的 GPU 并行化大规模评测，降低评测开销
以仿真与真实指标强相关性论证基准的生态效度
标准化任务、指标与协议，支持可复现的公平比较
experiment_results: 评测 ACT 与 Pi0.5 等先进方法，发现基础性能与泛化能力均存在局限
报告仿真与真实世界指标之间存在强相关性，支持基准的生态效度
摘要未给出具体数值结果，量化数据需参见原文
limitations: 评测主要基于仿真环境，真实世界覆盖有限
仅评测 ACT、Pi0.5 等有限方法，未覆盖更广泛的 VLA 模型谱系
摘要未披露具体任务成功率与泛化下降幅度等量化细节
papers.practical_value: 为机器人学习研究提供统一、可复现且低开销的 VLA 泛化评测入口，帮助企业在大规模真机部署前以仿真并行方式筛查策略在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，降低评测与迭代成本。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA 的零样本感知能力容易造成泛化良好的错觉，该基准把评测焦点从感知能力转向行为鲁棒性，为社区提供可比较的泛化度量，有助于识别从高层理解到稳健执行的转化瓶颈。

papers.title: Spa-Bench: A Real-Robot Benchmark for Spatial Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) offer a promising route toward general-purpose robotics by transferring semantic knowledge from large-scale vision-language pretraining into language-conditioned control. However, most VLA evaluations emphasize aggregate manipulation success under changes in objects, instructions, or environments, leaving unclear how reliably these policies ground spatial descriptions in the physical scenes where they act. We therefore ask a sharper question: how reliably can current VLAs translate spatial descriptions into appropriate real-robot behavior? To investigate this, we introduce Spa-Bench, a real-robot benchmark that evaluates spatial grounding across six tabletop tasks covering Object State, Relative Size, Referential Description, Relational Placement, Ordinal Position, and Counting. Our primary evaluation compares in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) spatial configurations while retaining training support for the relevant objects, concepts, and actions, reducing object and motor unfamiliarity as alternative explanations for failure. Four diagnostic conditions further probe physical execution, sensitivity to wording, object-task associations, and recognition that no action is required. We release 4,092 episodes collected on the SO-101 robot arm: 1,200 human-teleoperated demonstrations and 2,892 real-robot evaluation rollouts from five state-of-the-art VLA policies. Across the three fully evaluated policies, success falls from 67.5-73.3% on ID spatial configurations to 40.7-52.0% on OOD spatial configurations, while matched direct instructions improve success by 28.3-40.0 percentage points. These results show that the evaluated VLAs can often execute the required manipulations but lack robust spatial grounding. Project materials, including videos, code, and benchmark data, are available at https://justintiensmith.github.io/Spa-Bench/.
papers.summary: Spa-Bench针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在真实机器人上空间 grounding 能力评估不足的问题，构建了一个真实机器人基准，覆盖物体状态、相对大小、指代描述、关系放置、序数位置和计数六类桌面任务。其核心设计是保持训练中出现的物体、概念和动作不变，仅改变空间配置，对比分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）表现，从而排除物体与运动不熟悉作为失败解释；另设四个诊断条件考察物理执行、措辞敏感性、物体-任务关联及无需动作识别。作者在SO-101机械臂上发布4,092条episode，含1,200条人类遥操作演示和2,892条来自五个先进VLA策略的真实机器人评估rollout。三个完整评估策略的ID成功率67.5-73.3%，OOD降至40.7-52.0%，匹配的直接指令可提升28.3-40.0个百分点，表明模型常能执行操作但空间 grounding 不稳健。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 现有VLA能完成操作动作，但在真实机器人上对空间描述的可控 grounding 明显不足，OOD空间配置下成功率大幅下降。
papers.core_method: 构建真实机器人基准Spa-Bench：在SO-101机械臂上设计六类桌面空间任务，控制物体、概念和动作与训练分布一致，仅改变空间配置，对比ID与OOD表现；并设置物理执行、措辞敏感性、物体-任务关联和无需动作识别四个诊断条件，采集人类遥操作演示与多个VLA策略的真实评估rollout。
innovation_points: 以真实机器人而非仿真评估VLA的空间 grounding，覆盖六类细粒度空间语义任务
通过保持物体、概念和动作不变、仅改变空间配置，隔离空间 grounding 失败与物体/运动不熟悉因素
引入四个诊断条件，分别探测物理执行、措辞敏感性、物体-任务关联和无需动作识别能力
发布包含人类遥操作演示与多策略真实rollout的episode数据集，支持可复现评估
experiment_results: 三个完整评估策略的ID空间配置成功率为67.5-73.3%，OOD空间配置降至40.7-52.0%
匹配的直接指令使成功率提升28.3-40.0个百分点
发布4,092条episode，含1,200条人类遥操作演示和2,892条来自五个VLA策略的真实机器人评估rollout
limitations: 评估仅基于SO-101单一机械臂平台，跨 embodiment 泛化性未验证
仅三个策略被完整评估，覆盖的VLA范围有限
任务局限于桌面操作场景，未涉及移动或更复杂环境中的空间 grounding
papers.practical_value: 为VLA在真实机器人部署前的空间理解能力提供可复现的诊断基准，帮助企业识别模型在空间描述上的薄弱环节，指导数据采集与后训练，降低真实场景中因空间 grounding 失败导致的部署风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将VLA评估从聚合操作成功率推进到真实机器人上的空间 grounding 诊断，揭示了模型“能操作但空间理解不稳健”的关键缺口，为后续VLA训练与评测提供了可复现的真实机器人基准和数据集。

papers.title: PMTRM: Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module for Embodied Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often contains repeated motions whose local observations look similar at different phases. When these phases require different actions, a policy that relies mainly on the current observation may repeat completed motions or switch phases at the wrong time. To address this phase ambiguity, we present the Pseudo-Memory Temporal Re-encoding Module (PMTRM), a lightweight plug-in module with only 7.61M parameters that encodes a bounded history of executed states and actions into a latent sequence for existing policies. To help distinguish phases, a temporal heterogeneity objective penalizes positive similarity between distant positions in this sequence, while anchor and reconstruction losses preserve information needed for action prediction. The reconstruction decoder is used only during training, leaving the temporal re-encoder to supply history to the policy at inference. We train the module progressively on synthetic sequences and robot data, then jointly with the policy, using temporal masking to accommodate partial histories. This integration retains the original action head and action space and adds auxiliary losses to the original policy loss. Experiments with multiple policy backbones in simulation and on a real robot show improved task success on tasks with phase ambiguity, with little additional computation.
papers.summary: PMTRM针对具身策略学习中因重复动作导致局部观测相似但阶段动作不同的相位歧义问题，提出一种轻量级即插即用模块。该模块仅含7.61M参数，将有限长度的已执行状态与动作历史编码为潜在序列，供现有策略使用。为区分不同相位，引入时间异质性目标，惩罚序列中远距离位置间的正相似性，同时用锚点损失和重建损失保留动作预测所需信息；重建解码器仅训练时使用，推理时仅保留时间重编码器。训练采用渐进策略：先在合成序列和机器人数据上训练，再与策略联合训练，并用时间掩码处理部分历史。集成时保留原动作头和动作空间，在原策略损失上增加辅助损失。在仿真和真实机器人上使用多种策略骨干的实验表明，在存在相位歧义的任务上成功率提升，且额外计算开销很小。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PMTRM以轻量即插即用方式为具身策略注入有界历史记忆，通过时间异质性目标缓解相位歧义，在仿真与真实机器人上提升任务成功率且计算开销小。
papers.core_method: PMTRM是一个仅7.61M参数的轻量级插件模块，将有限长度的已执行状态和动作历史编码为潜在序列，供现有策略使用。训练时引入时间异质性目标惩罚序列中远距离位置的正相似性以区分相位，并用锚点损失和重建损失保留动作预测所需信息；重建解码器仅训练时使用。训练分阶段进行：先在合成序列和机器人数据上训练，再与策略联合训练，并用时间掩码处理部分历史。集成保留原动作头和动作空间，仅在原策略损失上增加辅助损失。
innovation_points: 提出轻量级即插即用时间重编码模块，仅7.61M参数，为现有策略提供有界历史记忆，不改变原动作头和动作空间。
设计时间异质性目标，惩罚潜在序列中远距离位置的正相似性，以区分局部观测相似但动作不同的相位。
采用渐进式训练策略（合成序列→机器人数据→与策略联合），并用时间掩码支持部分历史输入。
重建解码器仅训练时使用，推理时仅保留时间重编码器，保持低计算开销。
experiment_results: 在仿真和真实机器人上使用多种策略骨干进行实验，在存在相位歧义的任务上任务成功率提升。
额外计算开销很小。
摘要未提供具体成功率数值或对比基线数据。
limitations: 摘要未报告具体量化指标（如成功率提升幅度、对比基线），难以评估提升程度。
仅在摘要层面描述实验，未说明任务多样性、真实机器人实验规模及泛化性验证细节。
时间异质性目标依赖远距离位置惩罚，对历史长度和掩码策略的敏感性未在摘要中讨论。
papers.practical_value: 该模块可直接插入现有具身策略，保留原动作头和动作空间，仅增加少量参数与辅助损失，便于在真实机器人系统中低开销部署，尤其适用于存在重复动作和相位歧义的操纵任务。
papers.why_it_matters: 它提供了一种轻量、通用且不改变策略接口的历史记忆增强方案，针对具身策略中常见的相位歧义问题给出可插拔的工程化解决思路，对实际机器人部署具有参考价值。

papers.title: FearCaut-Qwen: Affective Steering in a Vision-Language Model Shifts the Decision Criterion for Hazard Assessment
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential for damage assessment after a disaster, but a recurring deficiency is that they are reluctant to declare a hazard; that is, recall is low even when overall accuracy appears adequate. This study examines that deficiency by using signal detection theory to decompose the decision behavior into perceptual capability and decision-criterion placement. We then propose a novel method for correcting the over-conservative decision policy, inspired by the finding that fear makes humans risk-averse, and ask whether an affective representation associated with fear can be causally manipulated to similarly alter a VLM's decision tendency. Using mechanistic interpretability, we localize a causally implicated affective circuit in the model and use activation steering to manipulate it while observing the effect on downstream prediction. The method is tested on a two-stage SeisMLLM pipeline built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, which flags only 27.0% of genuinely unsafe buildings on the SeisMLLM-1K test split and never issues a false Red, an SDT criterion of c = +1.354, despite adequate evidence quality (d' = 1.521). An affective direction is localized on emotion-rich natural scenes, causally validated by sparse-neuron knockout and distributed steering on held-out emotion data, and then injected into the building task. Fear-direction injection raises Red recall to 75.7% (p<0.001), and subtracting the same direction suppresses Red predictions entirely, whereas norm-matched random and matched happiness directions show no significant effect. The mechanism is a shift in criterion (c=-1.515) while discrimination is not improved (d'=-0.493). These results show that VLM decisions can be adjusted at inference time without retraining and demonstrate how mechanistic interpretability can be used to diagnose and control VLM decision behaviors in engineering applications.
papers.summary: 该研究针对视觉语言模型在灾后建筑损伤评估中“不愿判定危险”的低召回问题，以信号检测理论将决策行为分解为感知能力（d'）与决策标准（c），发现基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的SeisMLLM两阶段流程在SeisMLLM-1K测试集上仅识别27.0%的真实不安全建筑，决策标准c=+1.354，而证据质量尚可（d'=1.521）。受恐惧使人类风险规避的启发，作者用机制可解释性在情绪丰富自然场景上定位与恐惧相关的因果情感回路，经稀疏神经元敲除与分布式激活引导验证后，将该情感方向注入建筑评估任务。结果显示注入恐惧方向使Red召回升至75.7%（p<0.001），减去该方向则完全抑制Red预测，而范数匹配的随机方向与快乐方向无显著效应；机制为决策标准偏移（c=-1.515）而非判别力提升（d'=-0.493）。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过机制可解释性定位并注入恐惧情感方向，可在推理时无重训练地校正VLM灾害评估的保守决策标准，显著提升危险召回。
papers.core_method: 以信号检测理论分解VLM决策为感知能力与决策标准；在情绪自然场景上利用机制可解释性定位恐惧相关情感回路，经稀疏神经元敲除和分布式激活引导进行因果验证；再将恐惧方向向量注入Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct构建的SeisMLLM两阶段建筑评估流程，观察对Red预测的影响，并设置范数匹配随机方向与快乐方向作为对照。
innovation_points: 将信号检测理论引入VLM灾害评估，区分感知能力不足与决策标准过保守两类失败模式
在情绪场景上定位并因果验证恐惧情感回路，再跨任务注入到建筑危险评估
提出推理时激活引导校正决策标准的方法，无需重训练即可调整VLM决策倾向
通过随机方向与快乐方向对照，证明效应具有情感方向特异性
experiment_results: 基线SeisMLLM-1K测试集Red召回仅27.0%，决策标准c=+1.354，d'=1.521，且从不误报Red
注入恐惧方向后Red召回升至75.7%（p<0.001），决策标准c=-1.515，但d'=-0.493，判别力未提升
减去恐惧方向完全抑制Red预测；范数匹配随机方向与快乐方向无显著效应
limitations: 仅在单一模型Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和单一建筑灾害数据集上验证，泛化性未知
方法提升召回但未改善判别力（d'下降），可能增加误报风险
情感方向的定位依赖情绪丰富自然场景，跨域迁移的稳定性与可解释性仍需检验
papers.practical_value: 为灾后建筑损伤评估等高风险工程场景提供推理时决策校正手段，无需重训练即可缓解VLM过度保守导致的漏报，降低安全隐患；同时展示机制可解释性在工程系统中诊断与控制模型决策行为的可操作路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将VLM决策失败从笼统的“准确率”拆解为感知与标准两个可干预维度，并证明情感表征可作为因果干预杠杆在推理时调整决策倾向，为生成式模型在安全关键工程中的可控部署提供了新思路与可复现的实验范式。

papers.title: Multimodal scene understanding for mobile robot navigation in unstructured outdoor environments
papers.abstract: The application of autonomous field robots in agriculture, mining, transport and logistics, disaster management, and exploration has increased with advances in sensing, perception, and autonomous navigation technologies. Western Australian off-road environments present challenges for autonomous ground robots because they contain unstructured ter rain, variations in appearance and geometry, changing illumination, and visually similar regions with different traversal characteristics. Reliable operation therefore requires scene understanding methods capable of representing the environment according to its navigability for robot traversal. This PhD research investigates multimodal scene understanding for autonomous ground robot navigation in unstructured off-road environments. The research focuses on the development of a photorealistic synthetic multimodal dataset representative of Western Australian off-road environments, the development and evaluation of real-time camera-LiDAR fusion semantic segmentation models for navigability estimation, the development of a navigation-oriented evaluation metric for semantic segmentation, and the proof-of-concept integration of semantic perception with local traversability mapping and robot navigation within NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The review identified limitations in available multimodal off-road datasets and motivated the development of the OUTBACK dataset. A synthetic data generation framework was developed using NVIDIA Isaac Sim and high-fidelity 3D environmental assets to generate monocular and stereo RGB images, LiDAR point clouds, IMU measurements, and semantic annotations. Sim2Real experiments showed that models trained using the synthetic data could provide useful semantic predictions on real-world off-road datasets. Three preliminary camera-LiDAR fusion models, namely the Balanced-Model, Robustness-Model, and Accuracy-Model, were developed to combine RGB appearance in formation with LiDAR-derived geometric information. Their performance varied across training and testing domains, with the Accuracy-Model achieving the highest average performance on the synthetic OUTBACK evaluation and the Robustness-Model showing stronger generalisation in the conducted RELLIS-3D Sim2Real experiments. Based on these observations, a final camera-LiDAR fusion model was developed and evaluated against DFormer-Small, a recent high-performing RGB-D semantic segmentation model, under the same OUTBACK experimental conditions. Across four inde pendent training seeds, the proposed model achieved a mean mIoU of 0.8439 ± 0.0064, compared with 0.6946±0.0071 for DFormer-Small on the three-level navigability task. A controlled ablation replacing LiDAR depth with grayscale RGB while retaining the same dual-stream architecture produced lower performance, providing evidence that LiDAR derived geometry contributes complementary information. A Robotic Navigation Intersection over Union (RN IoU) metric was introduced to complement conventional IoU and mIoU by weighting prediction errors according to their navigational severity. Evaluation using both metrics showed that RN IoU provides additional navigation-oriented information while preserving the relative ranking of the com pared models. Finally, the developed perception model was integrated into a proof-of-concept local navigation framework in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Predicted navigability masks were projected into a bird’s-eye-view cost representation and used for local path and motion planning. The experiments demonstrated successful autonomous local navigation within the evaluated synthetic environment, while identifying limitations including false-positive obstacle predictions and oscillatory navigation command behaviour. Overall, this research demonstrates the potential of photorealistic synthetic multi modal data and camera-LiDAR feature fusion for off-road scene understanding. The OUTBACK dataset, multimodal segmentation models, RN IoU metric, and proof of-concept navigation framework collectively contribute towards perception-driven autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments.
papers.venue: Edith Cowan University Research Online (Edith Cowan University)
papers.summary: 该博士论文研究非结构化越野环境下自主地面机器人的多模态场景理解与导航。针对西澳越野环境地形不规则、光照变化、外观相似但可通行性不同等挑战，作者首先构建了基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim和高保真3D资产的逼真合成多模态数据集OUTBACK，包含单目/双目RGB、LiDAR点云、IMU和语义标注，并通过Sim2Real实验验证合成数据训练的模型可在真实越野数据集上给出有用语义预测。随后开发并评估了三种相机-LiDAR融合语义分割模型（Balanced、Robustness、Accuracy），并最终提出融合模型，在OUTBACK三级可通行性任务上四个随机种子平均mIoU为0.8439±0.0064，显著高于DFormer-Small的0.6946±0.0071；替换LiDAR深度为灰度RGB的消融实验性能下降，表明几何信息具有互补性。作者还提出面向导航的RN IoU评价指标，并在Isaac Sim中将可通行性掩码投影为鸟瞰图代价表示，完成局部路径与运动规划的概念验证集成。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该论文通过合成多模态数据集、相机-LiDAR融合分割与导航导向评价指标，证明了多模态几何信息对非结构化越野场景可通行性理解与局部导航的价值。
papers.core_method: 构建基于Isaac Sim的逼真合成多模态越野数据集OUTBACK（RGB、LiDAR、IMU、语义标注）；开发并比较三种相机-LiDAR双流融合语义分割模型，最终模型融合RGB外观与LiDAR几何信息进行三级可通行性分割；提出按导航严重性加权的RN IoU指标；将预测可通行性掩码投影为鸟瞰图代价图并接入局部路径与运动规划。
innovation_points: 构建面向西澳非结构化越野环境的逼真合成多模态数据集OUTBACK，包含RGB、LiDAR、IMU与语义标注，并开展Sim2Real验证
提出并系统比较多种相机-LiDAR融合语义分割架构，通过替换LiDAR深度为灰度RGB的消融实验证明几何信息的互补贡献
提出导航导向的RN IoU评价指标，按预测错误的导航严重性加权，补充传统IoU/mIoU
在Isaac Sim中完成语义感知到局部可通行性地图与导航规划的概念验证集成
experiment_results: 最终融合模型在OUTBACK三级可通行性任务上四个独立训练种子平均mIoU为0.8439±0.0064，DFormer-Small为0.6946±0.0071
RELLIS-3D Sim2Real实验中Robustness-Model泛化表现更强，Accuracy-Model在合成OUTBACK评估中平均性能最高
Isaac Sim概念验证实现成功自主局部导航，但存在假阳性障碍预测与振荡导航指令等局限
limitations: 导航集成仅为概念验证，且仅在合成环境中评估，未在真实越野场景中验证
存在假阳性障碍预测与振荡导航指令行为，影响导航可靠性
合成数据与真实世界仍存在域差距，Sim2Real仅显示有用预测而非完全弥合
papers.practical_value: 为农业、采矿、运输物流、灾害管理与探索等领域的越野自主地面机器人提供可复用的合成多模态数据生成框架、相机-LiDAR融合可通行性感知模型和导航导向评价指标，降低真实越野数据采集与标注成本，并为感知到局部导航的工程集成提供参考。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面非结构化越野环境中外观相似但可通行性不同这一核心难题，将多模态几何融合、合成数据Sim2Real和导航导向评价结合起来，对感知驱动的越野自主导航研究具有方法与实践参考价值。

papers.title: Recompose and Refine Latent Reasoning Flows for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning enables vision-language-action (VLA) models to transform multimodal observations into task-relevant internal states before generating continuous robot actions. While existing methods learn to generate or refine such states for each policy query, they discard successful reasoning after execution and therefore reconstruct similar computation from scratch. We present Reasoning and Flow Memory (FLOWMEM), a unified VLA model that turns successful latent computation into reusable reasoning experience. Rather than appending a fixed retrieved context, FLOWMEM dynamically retrieves and recomposes compatible latent fragments as the embodied context evolves, forming a reasoning route that follows the temporal structure and progress of successful computation. The route is then refined using current visual and proprioceptive evidence before it conditions action generation. Experiments on RoboMME and LIBERO-Plus show that FLOWMEM attains 48.0% and 77.3% success, outperforming memory-free policies by 1.7 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the value of reusing successful latent computation for closed-loop VLA control.
papers.summary: 该论文关注视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的潜在推理问题：现有方法针对每次策略查询重新生成或精炼潜在状态，执行后即丢弃成功推理，导致重复计算。作者提出FLOWMEM统一VLA模型，将成功的潜在计算转化为可复用推理经验。它不追加固定检索上下文，而是随具身上下文演化动态检索并重组兼容的潜在片段，形成遵循成功计算时间结构与进度的推理路径，再用当前视觉和本体感知证据精炼该路径，最后以其为条件生成动作。在RoboMME和LIBERO-Plus上分别取得48.0%和77.3%成功率，较无记忆策略提升1.7和4.1个百分点，表明复用成功潜在计算对闭环VLA控制有价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FLOWMEM把VLA执行中成功的潜在推理轨迹存为可检索、可重组的记忆，并在当前感知证据下精炼后用于动作生成，从而减少重复计算并提升闭环控制成功率。
papers.core_method: 提出Reasoning and Flow Memory（FLOWMEM）统一VLA模型：将每次策略查询产生的成功潜在推理计算保存为经验；在具身上下文演化时，动态检索并重组兼容的潜在片段，形成符合成功计算时间结构与任务进度的推理路径；随后用当前视觉与本体感知证据对该路径进行精炼，并以精炼后的潜在状态为条件生成连续机器人动作。
innovation_points: 将执行后本应丢弃的成功潜在推理转化为可复用的推理经验，而非每次从零重建。
以动态检索与重组潜在片段替代固定检索上下文追加，使记忆随具身上下文演化而组织成推理路径。
在动作生成前用当前视觉和本体感知证据精炼重组路径，兼顾历史成功经验与当前观测。
在RoboMME与LIBERO-Plus两个闭环VLA控制基准上验证记忆复用机制的有效性。
experiment_results: RoboMME上成功率为48.0%，较无记忆策略提升1.7个百分点。
LIBERO-Plus上成功率为77.3%，较无记忆策略提升4.1个百分点。
摘要未提供消融实验、推理开销或记忆容量等更细粒度数据。
limitations: 摘要未报告记忆存储与检索带来的计算或存储开销，工程可行性尚不明确。
仅在RoboMME和LIBERO-Plus两个基准上验证，真实机器人平台与更多任务分布的泛化性未知。
潜在片段检索与重组的失败模式、记忆污染或错误复用风险未被讨论。
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人闭环控制场景，FLOWMEM提供了一种复用历史成功推理经验的机制，有望减少重复潜在计算、提升策略在相似任务与连续执行中的成功率；其记忆检索与重组思路对具身智能体的在线部署具有工程参考价值，但需进一步评估存储与检索成本。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作指出VLA潜在推理中成功计算被丢弃的浪费问题，并给出可检索、可重组的记忆式推理路线，为闭环VLA控制中的经验复用与推理效率提供了新方向，适合关注具身智能体推理系统与策略学习的研究者阅读。

papers.title: REMM: Revisable Embodied Memory for Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to retain task-relevant history while revising conclusions no longer supported by physical evidence. Retaining observations alone does not specify which completed conditions should be withdrawn after a disturbance or which obligations require repair. We introduce REMM, Revisable Embodied Memory for Manipulation, a supervisory memory layer for a frozen G0.5 vision-language-action executor. REMM separates an append-only evidence history from revisable task state and explicitly links derived relations and completed conditions to their supporting facts. When accepted evidence changes a supporting fact, it withdraws dependent conclusions and schedules targeted recovery at verified skill boundaries without updating the executor. Across 51 physical trials, including operator-assisted runs, REMM improves mean recorded task progress over the strongest baseline from 57% to 91% in intervention recovery and from 43% to 70% in sequence recall. Complementary video diagnostics show improved grounding of retained history into the next instruction, including comparisons with $π_{0.5}$-compatible high-level planner adaptations. These results support revisable memory as a practical interface for continued manipulation without policy retraining. Project: https://revanthsenthil.github.io/remm/.
papers.summary: REMM针对长时程操作中机器人需保留任务相关历史、并在物理证据变化后撤回不再成立的结论这一问题，提出一种可修订的具身记忆监督层，挂接在冻结的G0.5视觉-语言-动作执行器之上。其核心是将只追加的证据历史与可修订的任务状态分离，并把派生关系与已完成条件显式链接到支撑事实；当被接受的新证据改变支撑事实时，系统撤回依赖结论，并在已验证的技能边界安排定向恢复，且无需更新执行器。51次物理试验（含人工辅助运行）显示，干预恢复的平均记录任务进度由最强基线的57%提升至91%，序列回忆由43%提升至70%；视频诊断表明保留历史对下一条指令的落地更好，包括与π0.5兼容高层规划器适配版本的比较。
papers.one_line_takeaway: REMM用可修订记忆层把证据历史与任务状态解耦，在不重训策略的前提下显著提升长时程操作中的干扰恢复与序列回忆。
papers.core_method: 在冻结的G0.5视觉-语言-动作执行器外增加监督记忆层：维护只追加的证据历史与可修订任务状态，将派生关系和已完成条件显式关联到支撑事实；当新接受证据改变支撑事实时，撤回依赖结论，并在已验证技能边界调度定向恢复，执行器参数保持不变。
innovation_points: 将只追加证据历史与可修订任务状态分离，使已完成条件可被物理证据撤回
显式建立派生关系、完成条件与支撑事实之间的依赖链接，支持依赖传播式撤回
在已验证技能边界安排定向恢复，避免任意时刻重规划带来的执行风险
以冻结执行器加外部记忆层实现持续操作，无需策略重训练
experiment_results: 51次物理试验（含人工辅助运行）：干预恢复的平均记录任务进度从最强基线57%提升至91%
序列回忆平均记录任务进度从43%提升至70%
视频诊断显示保留历史对下一条指令的落地改善，并与π0.5兼容高层规划器适配版本进行比较
limitations: 实验规模为51次物理试验且包含人工辅助运行，自动化条件下的泛化性仍需验证
方法依赖冻结的G0.5执行器与已验证技能边界，迁移到其他执行器或技能体系的效果未给出
摘要未报告撤回与恢复调度的计算开销及实时性数据
papers.practical_value: 为长时程机器人操作提供一种无需重训策略的外部记忆接口，可在干扰发生后撤回失效结论并定向修复，降低对执行器微调的依赖，适合作为现有VLA系统之上的监督层进行工程集成。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把长时程操作中的记忆问题从单纯保留观测推进到可修订的任务状态管理，并给出不更新执行器的实用路径，对具身智能中记忆与规划接口设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: SpatialHarness: Test-Time Spatial Scaffolding for Fine Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-6 Astra) have recently shown strong potential for direct robotic control, yet their performance on fine manipulation remains limited. We argue that an important source of failure is not necessarily insufficient policy capability, but insufficient spatial observability, where task-critical spatial relationships may be poorly revealed by the existing physical camera setup. We introduce SpatialHarness, a test-time embodied harness that provides test-time spatial scaffolding for fine robotic manipulation without policy fine-tuning or changes to the physical sensing setup. SpatialHarness maintains an online simulated scene synchronized with real-world execution, identifies task-critical spatial relationships, and renders complementary virtual views that expose them to a frozen multimodal policy. To keep the simulated scene aligned during interaction, we develop interaction-aware scene synchronization that distinguishes static, held, and transition modes. We evaluate SpatialHarness on four real-robot manipulation tasks spanning precise geometric alignment, object-relative placement, and articulated-object interaction. Using the same frozen GPT-6 Astra policy, SpatialHarness substantially improves task success, including from 26.7% to 66.7% on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on Tower of Hanoi. These results indicate that improving spatial observability at test time can unlock fine-manipulation capabilities already present in strong multimodal foundation models. Project website: https://emilia113.github.io/SpatialHarness/.
papers.summary: 论文关注前沿多模态基础模型（如GPT-6 Astra）直接用于机器人精细操作时性能受限的问题，指出失败的重要来源并非策略能力不足，而是空间可观测性不足：现有物理相机布置难以充分暴露任务关键的空间关系。为此提出SpatialHarness，一种测试时具身脚手架，在不微调策略、不改变物理传感配置的前提下，维护与真实执行同步的在线仿真场景，识别任务关键空间关系，并渲染互补虚拟视角输入冻结的多模态策略。为保持仿真场景对齐，作者设计交互感知场景同步，区分静态、持握与过渡三种模式。在四类真实机器人任务上，使用同一冻结GPT-6 Astra策略，插头插入成功率由26.7%提升至66.7%，汉诺塔由0%提升至100%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 在测试时通过仿真渲染互补视角提升空间可观测性，可在不微调策略的情况下释放冻结多模态基础模型的精细操作能力。
papers.core_method: SpatialHarness在测试时维护与真实执行同步的在线仿真场景，识别任务关键空间关系并渲染互补虚拟视角，作为额外观测输入冻结的多模态策略；同时用交互感知场景同步区分静态、持握和过渡模式以保持虚实对齐。
innovation_points: 将精细操作失败归因于空间可观测性不足而非策略能力不足，提出测试时空间脚手架思路
在不微调策略、不改变物理相机布置的前提下，通过仿真渲染互补虚拟视角增强观测
设计交互感知场景同步，按静态、持握、过渡三种模式维持仿真与真实执行对齐
experiment_results: 在四类真实机器人操作任务上评估，覆盖精确几何对齐、物体相对放置和铰接物体交互
使用同一冻结GPT-6 Astra策略，插头插入成功率从26.7%提升至66.7%
汉诺塔任务成功率从0%提升至100%
limitations: 依赖在线仿真场景与真实执行的同步，交互感知同步在复杂接触下可能引入对齐误差
实验规模有限，仅在四类真实机器人任务上验证，未给出更大范围任务与模型的系统性结果
方法面向测试时观测增强，未涉及策略本身能力提升或训练阶段改进
papers.practical_value: 为已部署的强多模态基础模型提供无需微调、无需改动物理传感配置的测试时增强方案，可低成本提升精细操作成功率，适合快速在真实机器人产线上验证和迭代。
papers.why_it_matters: 它提示精细操作瓶颈可能来自观测而非策略，并给出可落地的测试时脚手架，为冻结基础模型在机器人控制中的实际部署提供了新思路。

papers.title: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.
papers.summary: RoboAware 面向具身编码智能体组合模块化机器人技能与冻结端到端策略时的核心难题：如何预判在当前物理状态下哪一类策略族会成功。作者不训练新的底层策略，而是仅学习一个以状态为条件的责任协调器。受 REPL 启发提出 P5 模式，将技能统一组织为五个语义阶段，并据此构建分层 MDP，使不同策略族之间的责任可比较。针对已有工作缺乏反事实分支结果的问题，提出状态锁定反事实分支（SCB），在同一训练状态下从每个可采纳策略族生成并执行代码块，暴露被选中分支经验所遗漏的结果；进而用执行感知学习（EAL）结合蒙特卡洛树搜索与 Q 学习，将这些结果蒸馏为按策略族条件化的价值。部署时协调器依据可观测上下文选择策略族，冻结的编码智能体生成下一段局部代码。在 100 个任务的单回合评测中总体成功率达 77.0%，RoboSuite 平均 90.0%、LIBERO-Pro 任务簇 73.8%、RoboTwin 双臂任务 90.0%，优于现有 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboAware 用状态锁定的反事实分支与执行感知学习，只训练一个轻量协调器，就能在部署时按物理状态选择最可能成功的机器人策略族。
papers.core_method: 提出 P5 五阶段技能语义模式并构建分层 MDP；用状态锁定反事实分支（SCB）在同一状态下对每个可采纳策略族生成并执行代码块以采集反事实结果；再用执行感知学习（EAL）结合蒙特卡洛树搜索与 Q 学习，将结果蒸馏为策略族条件化的价值函数；部署时由协调器按可观测上下文选择策略族，冻结编码智能体生成局部代码。
innovation_points: 提出 P5 五阶段技能组织模式，为不同策略族的责任比较提供统一语义结构
提出状态锁定反事实分支 SCB，在相同训练状态下采集各策略族的反事实执行结果，弥补仅凭被选分支经验造成的结果缺失
提出执行感知学习 EAL，将 MCTS 与 Q 学习结合，把反事实结果蒸馏为策略族条件化价值
将学习范围限制在状态条件协调器，底层策略与编码智能体保持冻结，降低训练与集成成本
experiment_results: 100 个任务的单回合评测总体成功率为 77.0%
RoboSuite 平均成功率 90.0%，LIBERO-Pro 多样任务簇 73.8%，RoboTwin 双臂任务 90.0%
在上述评测中优于现有 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线
limitations: 评测限于单回合设定与 100 个任务，长期多回合场景下的协调稳定性尚未验证
方法依赖 P5 五阶段语义划分与可采纳策略族集合的预先定义，跨任务泛化性受此约束
反事实分支需在同一状态重复执行多个代码块，采集成本随策略族数量增长
papers.practical_value: 为企业构建具身智能体系统提供一种低成本集成路径：无需重训底层 VLA 或端到端策略，只需在技能编排层增加状态条件协调器，即可在真实物理状态下动态选择更可能成功的策略族，提升模块化技能组合的线上成功率与可维护性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把具身技能组合的关键从生成更好的代码转向预判哪类策略会成功，并用反事实分支把不可观测的替代结果变成可学习信号，为编码智能体与冻结策略的协同提供了可复用的训练范式。

papers.title: QSLA Application to Agentic AI-Mediated Robots and Robotic Design
papers.abstract: Robots directed by agentic artificial intelligence can translate natural-language objectives into sequences of perception, planning, tool use and physical action. Their engineering challenge extends beyond generating a feasible plan: a particular action must have valid authority, adequate evidence, an acceptable transition envelope and enforceable execution conditions. This paper proposes a robotics application of Quantum-Safe Ledger Architecture (QSLA), integrating those obligations through a non-compensatory admission rule. The architecture separates an agent that proposes tasks, an independent governance plane that admits bounded skills, a local controller that maintains immediate physical safety, and an evidence service that records decisions and observed consequences. Heuristic Admissibility and Lineage Logic (HALL) evaluates material claims; the Stochastic Control Barrier Function (SCBF) evaluates uncertain transitions; a theta intervention mechanism selects operational responses; capability security binds permissions to specific robot configurations; and resource reservations coordinate concurrent robots. A hybrid model connects discrete task admission to continuous plant dynamics, with explicit inter-sample obligations and a conditional finite-horizon risk bound. Four worked cases cover warehouse navigation, collaborative manipulation, hospital logistics and AI-assisted robotic design. Proposed information models, failure responses, standards-support mappings and an independent evaluation programme make the architecture inspectable. No robot
papers.summary: 本文提出将量子安全账本架构（QSLA）应用于由智能体AI驱动的机器人系统，解决自然语言目标转化为感知、规划、工具使用与物理动作序列时的工程治理难题。核心在于非补偿性准入规则：动作需同时满足有效授权、充分证据、可接受过渡包络与可执行条件。架构分离任务提议智能体、独立治理平面、本地安全控制器与证据服务；采用HALL评估实质性声明、SCBF评估不确定过渡、theta干预机制选择响应、能力安全绑定权限、资源预留协调并发机器人。混合模型连接离散任务准入与连续对象动力学，给出样本间义务与条件有限时域风险界。四个案例覆盖仓库导航、协作操作、医院物流与AI辅助机器人设计，并提供信息模型、故障响应与标准映射。摘要未报告定量实验结果。
papers.one_line_takeaway: QSLA通过非补偿性准入与独立治理平面，为智能体机器人提供可审计、可执行的安全治理架构。
papers.core_method: 提出QSLA机器人应用架构，将任务提议智能体、独立治理平面、本地安全控制器和证据服务分离；使用HALL评估实质性声明，SCBF评估不确定过渡，theta干预机制选择操作响应，能力安全绑定权限到具体机器人配置，资源预留协调并发机器人；混合模型连接离散任务准入与连续对象动力学，并给出样本间义务与条件有限时域风险界。
innovation_points: 非补偿性准入规则：动作必须同时满足授权、证据、过渡包络与执行条件，不可用其他优势补偿缺失项。
四层分离架构：任务提议智能体、独立治理平面、本地安全控制器与证据服务解耦，提升可审计性与安全性。
混合离散-连续模型：将离散任务准入与连续物理动力学连接，并给出条件有限时域风险界。
能力安全与资源预留结合：权限绑定具体机器人配置，并协调并发机器人资源。
experiment_results: 摘要仅提及四个工作案例（仓库导航、协作操作、医院物流、AI辅助机器人设计），未报告定量实验结果或性能数据。
提出独立评估方案与标准支持映射，但未给出评估结果。
limitations: 摘要未提供定量实验数据或性能评估结果，架构有效性缺乏实证验证。
条件有限时域风险界依赖模型假设，实际部署中的保守性与计算开销未讨论。
四个案例为描述性工作案例，未说明是否在真实机器人系统上实现或测试。
papers.practical_value: 为智能体AI驱动机器人提供可审计的治理架构，适用于仓库导航、协作操作、医院物流等需要安全授权与证据追溯的场景；能力安全与资源预留机制有助于多机器人并发部署时的权限管理与协调。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着智能体AI进入物理机器人领域，仅生成可行计划不足以保证安全与合规。本文提出非补偿性准入与独立治理平面，为机器人动作的授权、证据与执行条件提供系统化框架，对安全关键场景的机器人部署具有参考价值。

papers.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
papers.abstract: Large-scale egocentric human interaction data is becoming an important source of physical supervision for embodied learning, yet video alone leaves the contact and pressure that characterize physical interaction unrecorded. Recent visual-tactile datasets provide this missing supervision, but their synchronized tactile data remain far smaller in volume than human video. Moreover, the largest resources often merge recordings from different sensors or annotation procedures, which makes the effect of data scale difficult to isolate. We therefore introduce TouchScale, a 500-hour dataset of contact-rich human interaction recorded with a single unified wearable setup. Its approximately 2K predefined task descriptions span everyday activities and structured manipulation, and each recording temporally aligns egocentric RGB-D video with wrist RGB video and dense full-hand bimanual tactile measurements. Compared with prior tactile data, training on the full TouchScale raises zero-shot contact IoU on data from an unseen tactile sensor from 0.134 to 0.383. Pretraining a visual encoder on TouchScale also yields the highest action recognition accuracy on three benchmarks among the compared visual-tactile datasets. Used for visual-tactile mid-training of a robot policy, TouchScale improves the average real-world success rate across four contact-rich manipulation tasks from 22.5% to 57.5%. With the sensor and collection protocol held fixed, both zero-shot tactile prediction and robot success show an overall upward trend as more TouchScale data is used. These results suggest that human visual-tactile data collected at scale with consistent sensing benefits both perception and robot manipulation. We will publicly release TouchScale, including all synchronized visual-tactile recordings and reconstructed object models, to support future research on scalable visual-tactile learning.
papers.summary: TouchScale 针对视觉-触觉学习中触觉数据规模远小于人类视频、且多源采集导致规模效应难以隔离的问题，构建了 500 小时接触丰富的人类交互数据集。数据由单一统一可穿戴设备采集，约 2K 预定义任务描述覆盖日常活动与结构化操作，每条记录在时间上对齐第一人称 RGB-D 视频、腕部 RGB 视频与双手全手密集触觉测量。实验显示，全量训练将未见触觉传感器上的零样本接触 IoU 从 0.134 提升至 0.383；视觉编码器预训练在三个基准上取得对比数据集中最高的动作识别准确率；用于机器人策略视觉-触觉中期训练时，四类接触丰富操作任务真实成功率从 22.5% 提升至 57.5%，且随数据量增加呈整体上升趋势。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 统一采集协议下的大规模人类视觉-触觉数据可同时提升触觉感知零样本泛化与真实机器人接触操作成功率。
papers.core_method: 采用单一统一可穿戴采集装置，同步记录第一人称 RGB-D 视频、腕部 RGB 视频和双手全手密集触觉信号，并配以约 2K 预定义任务描述；数据用于触觉预测、视觉编码器预训练和机器人策略的视觉-触觉中期训练。
innovation_points: 以单一统一传感与采集协议构建 500 小时视觉-触觉数据集，避免多传感器/多标注流程混合带来的规模效应混淆
每条记录时间对齐第一人称 RGB-D、腕部 RGB 与双手全手密集触觉，提供接触与压力监督
同时覆盖日常活动与结构化操作，并公开同步记录与重建物体模型
experiment_results: 全量 TouchScale 训练使未见触觉传感器上的零样本接触 IoU 从 0.134 提升到 0.383
视觉编码器在 TouchScale 上预训练后，在三个基准上取得对比视觉-触觉数据集中的最高动作识别准确率
用于机器人策略视觉-触觉中期训练，四类接触丰富操作任务真实平均成功率从 22.5% 提升到 57.5%；随数据量增加，零样本触觉预测与机器人成功率整体上升
limitations: 摘要未给出动作识别准确率的具体数值与各基准细节
数据规模效应结论基于固定传感器与采集协议，跨传感器/跨协议泛化仍需进一步验证
摘要未报告数据采集成本、标注质量及任务描述覆盖长尾程度等细节
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能提供可公开获取的大规模同步视觉-触觉预训练与中期训练资源，降低触觉感知和接触丰富操作策略对真实机器人数据采集的依赖，并支持零样本触觉传感器迁移。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作以统一采集协议隔离数据规模变量，实证人类视觉-触觉数据规模化对感知泛化和真实机器人操作的双重收益，为可扩展视觉-触觉学习提供数据与方法基线。

papers.title: COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Asynchronous RL accelerates large language model post-training by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but trains on stale trajectories. Existing methods primarily correct token-level policy mismatch through importance-ratio control in the actor objective. We show that this \emph{policy-side correction} alone is insufficient: advantage estimates also inherit mismatch from behavior-policy continuations, which we term \emph{advantage staleness}. We derive exact bias and variance decompositions for a general two-channel actor update, revealing nonseparable coupling between policy-weight and advantage-estimation errors: their interaction induces multiplicative bias terms, while squared policy weights amplify advantage uncertainty in gradient variance. This motivates the hypothesis that policy- and advantage-side correction should be coordinated. We introduce Coupled Off-Policy Correction (COPC), an actor--critic method combining token-level ratio masking with two-sided clipped-ratio weighting of TD residuals for return and advantage estimation. Joint parameter sweeps across staleness levels support this hypothesis: the effect of one correction parameter depends on, and can reverse with, the other. COPC achieves the highest reported performance on tool-integrated mathematical reasoning and search, outperforming the strongest reported asynchronous baseline in each setting. It also offers a broad high-performing parameter region and improved training stability. In search, COPC remains stable throughout training, while most evaluated asynchronous baselines collapse late in training. These gains persist at 64-step policy staleness. COPC adds minimal step-time overhead over asynchronous PPO and retains a $1.7\times$ step-time speedup over synchronous PPO.
papers.summary: 该论文研究异步强化学习用于大语言模型后训练时，陈旧轨迹带来的策略失配问题。作者指出，仅靠actor目标中的token级重要性比率控制（策略侧校正）不足以消除偏差，因为优势估计也会继承行为策略延续带来的失配，即“优势陈旧”。论文推导了双通道actor更新的精确偏差与方差分解，揭示策略权重误差与优势估计误差不可分离地耦合：二者交互产生乘性偏差项，而策略权重的平方会放大梯度方差中的优势不确定性。基于此提出COPC（耦合离策略校正），一种actor-critic方法，将token级比率掩码与对TD残差的双侧裁剪比率加权结合，用于回报与优势估计。参数扫描表明两个校正参数的效果相互依赖甚至可反转。COPC在工具集成数学推理与搜索任务上取得所报告的最高性能，优于最强异步基线，并在64步策略陈旧度下保持增益，训练更稳定，步时开销仅略高于异步PPO，相对同步PPO仍有1.7倍加速。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 异步LLM强化学习需同时校正策略与优势两侧的离策略偏差，COPC通过耦合校正实现更稳定且更强的后训练性能。
papers.core_method: 提出COPC，一种actor-critic离策略校正方法：在actor目标中采用token级重要性比率掩码控制策略失配，同时对TD残差进行双侧裁剪比率加权以校正回报与优势估计，使策略侧与优势侧校正协同工作。
innovation_points: 识别并形式化“优势陈旧”问题，指出仅做策略侧校正不足
推导双通道actor更新的精确偏差与方差分解，揭示策略权重与优势估计误差的乘性耦合
提出耦合校正机制，将token级比率掩码与TD残差的双侧裁剪比率加权结合
通过联合参数扫描验证两个校正参数效果相互依赖且可反转
experiment_results: 在工具集成数学推理与搜索任务上取得所报告的最高性能，优于最强异步基线
在搜索任务中训练全程稳定，多数异步基线后期崩溃；增益在64步策略陈旧度下仍保持
步时开销仅略高于异步PPO，相对同步PPO保持1.7倍加速
limitations: 摘要未提供具体数值指标与消融细节
实验集中于工具集成数学推理与搜索，其他任务泛化性未验证
理论分解基于一般双通道actor更新，实际实现中的近似误差未量化
papers.practical_value: 为异步LLM强化学习后训练提供可落地的耦合校正方案，在保持异步加速优势的同时提升训练稳定性与最终性能，适合对训练吞吐和稳定性有要求的大模型后训练工程场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了异步RL中优势估计陈旧这一被忽视的偏差来源，并给出理论分解与耦合校正方法，对理解与改进LLM异步后训练系统具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.
papers.summary: YUBI-STAG针对VLA模型语言指令与物理交互对齐粗糙的问题，提出自动化时空标注与接地框架：结合接触物体分割与视觉语言模型，为操作演示自动标注物体身份、属性与状态、各夹爪动作、双臂协调及空间接地交互，弥补原始演示仅含粗粒度任务描述的缺陷。为降低对局部序列与多阶段VLM推理的依赖，作者将其蒸馏为YUBI-VLM，可从原始未分割视频、仅凭腕部视角在少量推理调用内直接恢复动作结构与标注。在YUBI-STAG-Bench的时间、语义与空间接地任务上，YUBI-VLM以更少调用和更短运行时间保留大部分标注精度，并泛化到未见操作。用这些标注后训练VLA策略可提升双臂任务性能与细粒度指令跟随，包括对物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置与空间关系的控制。
papers.one_line_takeaway: YUBI-STAG用自动化接触与语义标注把粗粒度机器人演示升级为细粒度语言接地数据，并通过蒸馏模型YUBI-VLM实现高效视频标注，进而提升VLA的指令跟随与双臂操作表现。
papers.core_method: 以接触物体分割与视觉语言模型联合标注操作演示中的物体身份、属性状态、逐夹爪动作、双臂协调和空间交互；再将多阶段、依赖局部序列的标注流程蒸馏为YUBI-VLM，使其从原始未分割视频、仅腕部视角在少量推理调用内直接输出动作结构与标注。
innovation_points: 自动生成接触感知、语义丰富且空间接地的操作标注，覆盖执行夹爪、接触物体、抓取与移动方式等原始标签缺失的信息
将多阶段VLM标注流水线蒸馏为单模型YUBI-VLM，减少推理调用与运行时间，并支持仅腕部视角输入
构建YUBI-STAG-Bench，从时间、语义、空间三类接地任务评估标注质量
用自动标注后训练VLA策略，实现对物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置和空间关系的细粒度语言控制
experiment_results: 在YUBI-STAG-Bench上，YUBI-VLM以更少推理调用和更短运行时间保留YUBI-STAG的大部分标注精度，并能泛化到未见操作
双臂实验显示，基于这些标注后训练的VLA策略在性能和指令跟随上均有提升，可控制原始标签中不存在的物体身份、执行夹爪、目标位置与空间关系
摘要未给出具体数值指标，需查阅全文获取定量结果
limitations: 摘要未报告标注精度、推理调用次数与运行时间的具体数值，难以量化蒸馏损失
评估集中于双臂操作场景与YUBI-STAG-Bench，跨 embodiment 与更广泛任务的泛化性未充分说明
依赖视觉语言模型与接触物体分割，标注质量可能受分割与VLM识别误差影响
papers.practical_value: 为机器人学习提供可扩展的自动化数据标注管线，降低人工细粒度标注成本；蒸馏后的YUBI-VLM支持仅腕部视角、少调用推理，便于部署到真实数据采集流程；生成的接触与语义标注可直接用于VLA后训练，提升语言可控性与双臂协调操作能力。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把VLA对齐的关键瓶颈从模型结构转向数据语义粒度，展示了自动生成接触感知、空间接地标注的可行路径，并用蒸馏模型解决标注成本问题，对构建可扩展的机器人指令跟随数据闭环具有参考价值。

papers.title: Optimizing Large Language Models with Chained LMOs
papers.abstract: Muon has motivated a growing family of optimizers that compose multiple matrix normalizations, but these methods remain fragmented and lack a unified perspective. We introduce chained linear minimization oracles (chained LMOs), which cast these methods as compositions of LMOs. Despite their empirical success, many chains fall outside the standard LMO framework and can diverge on smooth convex objectives. To explain why composition can nevertheless help, we turn to linear associative memory and show that chaining can improve over Muon under anisotropic embeddings. Empirically, we propose TensorChain, a novel optimizer within the framework that stacks compatible weight matrices across different layers and normalizes the 3d tensor across its axes. In Qwen3 0.6B and 1.7B pretraining, TensorChain outperforms all chained baselines in average token efficiency, with average token savings of 9.6% over Muon at matched validation loss.
papers.summary: 该论文针对Muon启发的链式矩阵归一化优化器缺乏统一理论框架的问题，提出链式线性最小化预言机（chained LMOs）框架，将现有方法统一为LMO的组合。作者指出许多链式方法超出标准LMO框架，在光滑凸目标上可能发散，但通过线性联想记忆理论证明各向异性嵌入下链式组合可优于Muon。基于此提出TensorChain优化器，跨层堆叠兼容权重矩阵并对三维张量沿各轴归一化。在Qwen3 0.6B和1.7B预训练中，TensorChain在平均token效率上超越所有链式基线，匹配验证损失时相比Muon平均节省9.6% token。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出链式LMO统一框架并设计TensorChain优化器，在LLM预训练中实现比Muon平均9.6%的token效率提升。
papers.core_method: 将Muon等链式矩阵归一化优化器统一为链式线性最小化预言机（chained LMOs）的组合框架，并基于线性联想记忆理论分析链式组合的有效性。进一步提出TensorChain优化器，通过跨层堆叠兼容权重矩阵并对三维张量沿各轴归一化来实现优化。
innovation_points: 提出链式LMOs统一框架，将分散的Muon类优化器形式化为LMO的组合，提供统一视角。
揭示许多链式方法超出标准LMO框架，在光滑凸目标上可能发散，但通过线性联想记忆理论解释各向异性嵌入下链式组合仍能带来增益。
设计TensorChain优化器，创新性地跨层堆叠权重矩阵并对三维张量进行多轴归一化。
experiment_results: 在Qwen3 0.6B和1.7B预训练中，TensorChain在平均token效率上超越所有链式基线。
匹配验证损失时，TensorChain相比Muon平均节省9.6%的token。
limitations: 论文未提供TensorChain在更大规模模型（如数十亿参数以上）上的实验验证。
理论分析基于线性联想记忆和各向异性嵌入假设，实际LLM训练中的适用性需进一步验证。
未与其他非链式优化器（如AdamW）进行全面的效率对比。
papers.practical_value: 为LLM预训练提供了一种更高效的优化器TensorChain，能在相同验证损失下减少约9.6%的token消耗，降低训练成本；同时链式LMOs框架为理解和设计新型优化器提供了理论工具。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作统一了新兴的Muon类优化器，揭示了其理论局限与有效性条件，并提出了实用的TensorChain优化器，在LLM预训练中显著提升token效率，对降低大模型训练成本具有直接价值。

papers.title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch- level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: 本文面向可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛（XPlainVerse数据集），要求同时判定图像真伪并生成基于可见取证线索的复杂与简单解释。作者提出模块化检测与解释框架：检测端融合多个DINOv3骨干与Mesorch篡改定位特征，结合预训练视觉表示、DCT感知线索与多尺度取证信息；解释端用Grounding-DINO伪掩码流水线将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督，构建伪影证据图，并引入局部块级对比目标，在无需配对图像或像素级掩码的情况下分离伪影与真实性证据；语言输出用类别条件Qwen3-VL生成复杂解释，再经GRPO优化的文本简化模型生成简单解释。在完整测试集上取得0.9349检测准确率、0.5571解释分数与0.7456最终挑战分数。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用多骨干检测器加伪掩码弱监督证据图与对比学习，把取证证据注入检测特征空间，再用类别条件VLM与GRPO简化生成分层解释，在XPlainVerse上取得0.9349检测准确率与0.7456综合分。
papers.core_method: 模块化检测-解释设计：检测端为多骨干集成，融合多个DINOv3模型与Mesorch篡改定位特征，汇聚预训练视觉表示、DCT感知线索和多尺度取证信息；解释端通过Grounding-DINO伪掩码生成流水线，将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督以构建伪影证据图，并加入局部块级对比目标分离伪影与真实性证据；语言端用类别条件Qwen3-VL分别为假/真预测生成复杂解释，再用GRPO优化的文本简化模型产出简单解释。
innovation_points: 多骨干检测器融合DINOv3预训练表示、Mesorch定位特征与DCT感知线索，兼顾语义与取证多尺度信息
以Grounding-DINO伪掩码将自然语言局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督，构建伪影证据图，避免像素级标注依赖
提出局部块级对比目标，在检测器特征空间分离伪影证据与真实性证据，无需配对图像或像素级篡改掩码
语言端采用类别条件Qwen3-VL加GRPO文本简化，实现复杂与简单两级解释输出
experiment_results: 完整测试集检测准确率0.9349
解释分数0.5571
最终挑战分数0.7456
limitations: 解释分数0.5571明显低于检测准确率，解释质量与检测精度之间存在差距
伪掩码来自Grounding-DINO对训练解释的转换，属弱监督，证据图精度受伪掩码质量制约
仅在挑战子集XPlainVerse上训练与评估，未报告跨数据集泛化结果
papers.practical_value: 为内容审核与取证场景提供可落地的检测加解释流水线：检测端可直接复用预训练视觉骨干与现成定位特征，解释端以弱监督方式把文本伪影描述转为证据图，降低像素级标注成本；两级解释输出便于面向不同受众（审核员与普通用户）呈现判定依据，提升自动化伪造检测的可审计性与可信度。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了如何在不依赖像素级篡改掩码的条件下，将取证证据显式注入检测器特征空间，并把检测与自然语言解释统一到同一模块化框架中；其多骨干融合、伪掩码弱监督与块级对比的组合思路，对可解释伪造检测与视觉取证系统的工程实现具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Juno: Taming Predictive Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict masked or future observations in representation space, offering a natural source of predictive latents for vision-language-action (VLA) models. Yet making these latents useful across pretraining, policy learning, and deployment requires addressing three failures: mismatch with embodiment-specific control, interference with action learning, and teacher miscalibration under distribution shifts. We introduce Juno, a unified framework built around one action-conditioned JEPA that serves as a control-aligned representation backbone, a predictive teacher, and an adaptable dynamics model. During pretraining, we train it on embodiment-matched trajectories and use a dynamic CLS loss to transfer motion-weighted patch dynamics to a compact global state. During policy learning, we fuse current-frame JEPA patches into VLA perception and use a decoupled reasoning branch with separate transformation parameters to distill future latent states for action generation. During deployment, we adapt the world model on all observed transitions, including failed rollouts, freeze the adapted teacher, and re-align the policy on verified executions using LoRA adapters and a trainable action head, without expert corrections or task rewards. On SimplerEnv, Juno raises average success from $60.9\%$ to $68.5\%$ over Qwen3GR00T, the strongest baseline, and test-time adaptation further reaches $72.7\%$; on a real robot, it retains $70\%$--$75\%$ success under background, height, and object shifts where the base policy collapses to $0\%$.
papers.summary: Juno 针对将 JEPA 预测潜变量用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型时的三类失败——与具身控制不匹配、干扰动作学习、分布偏移下教师失准——提出统一框架。其核心是一个动作条件 JEPA，同时充当控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师与可适应动力学模型。预训练阶段在具身匹配轨迹上训练，并用动态 CLS 损失将运动加权 patch 动力学迁移到紧凑全局状态；策略学习阶段将当前帧 JEPA patch 融合进 VLA 感知，并用解耦推理分支（独立变换参数）蒸馏未来潜状态以生成动作；部署阶段在所有观测转移（含失败 rollout）上适应世界模型，冻结适应后教师，再用 LoRA 适配器与可训练动作头在验证执行上重对齐策略，无需专家纠正或任务奖励。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Juno 用一个动作条件 JEPA 贯穿预训练、策略学习与部署适应，把预测潜变量变成 VLA 可用的控制对齐表征与可校准教师。
papers.core_method: 以动作条件 JEPA 为统一骨干：预训练用动态 CLS 损失把运动加权 patch 动力学压缩到全局状态；策略学习融合当前帧 JEPA patch 并用解耦推理分支蒸馏未来潜状态；部署时在全部观测转移上适应世界模型、冻结教师，再用 LoRA 与可训练动作头重对齐策略。
innovation_points: 单一动作条件 JEPA 同时承担控制对齐表征骨干、预测教师和可适应动力学模型三重角色
动态 CLS 损失将运动加权 patch 动力学迁移到紧凑全局状态，缓解与控制不匹配
解耦推理分支以独立变换参数蒸馏未来潜状态，降低对动作学习的干扰
部署阶段利用含失败 rollout 的全部转移适应世界模型并冻结教师，无需专家纠正或任务奖励即可重对齐策略
experiment_results: SimplerEnv 上平均成功率从最强基线 Qwen3GR00T 的 60.9% 提升到 68.5%，测试时适应进一步达到 72.7%
真实机器人上在背景、高度和物体偏移下保持 70%–75% 成功率，而基础策略在这些偏移下崩溃到 0%
limitations: 摘要未报告预训练数据规模、训练成本或推理延迟等工程指标
真实机器人评估仅覆盖背景、高度与物体偏移三类分布变化，未说明更广泛任务与具身形态的泛化
部署适应依赖对观测转移（含失败 rollout）的在线收集与适应流程，其收敛速度与稳定性未在摘要中量化
papers.practical_value: 为 VLA 系统提供可落地的预测潜变量使用范式：预训练阶段对齐具身控制，策略阶段避免干扰动作学习，部署阶段无需专家纠正或任务奖励即可利用失败数据在线适应，对真实机器人分布偏移场景有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它系统性地回答了 JEPA 预测潜变量在 VLA 中“为何不好用、如何用好”的问题，给出贯穿预训练到部署的统一方案，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证了分布偏移下的鲁棒性提升。

papers.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.
papers.summary: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中的状态幻觉问题，即模型持续表现得仿佛某个未实现的机器人-物体状态已经达成。作者通过注意力分析发现，状态幻觉与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱同时出现，并利用稀疏自编码器给出机制解释：幻觉相关稀疏特征在失败发生时被激活。基于此提出SOUL（稀疏特征策略遗忘），将幻觉失败中识别出的稀疏特征作为显式遗忘目标，将成功行为对应的稀疏特征作为保留目标，从而选择性遗忘与状态幻觉相关的策略知识。在多种VLA架构的仿真与真实环境实验中，该方法显著减少幻觉失败并提升任务成功率，同时基本不损害已有操作能力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 利用稀疏自编码器定位状态幻觉对应的稀疏特征，并以选择性遗忘方式定向移除该策略知识，可在不显著损伤原有操作能力的前提下减少VLA的状态幻觉失败。
papers.core_method: 先分析VLA状态幻觉与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱的关系，再用稀疏自编码器提取幻觉失败与成功行为对应的稀疏特征；将幻觉相关特征设为遗忘目标、成功相关特征设为保留目标，对策略知识进行选择性遗忘（SOUL）。
innovation_points: 识别并系统研究VLA中的状态幻觉这一反复出现的失败模式，并将其与任务相关视觉区域注意力减弱联系起来
借助稀疏自编码器给出幻觉的机制性解释，发现幻觉相关稀疏特征在失败时被激活
提出以稀疏特征为显式遗忘/保留目标的选择性策略遗忘方法SOUL，实现定向知识修改
experiment_results: 在多种VLA架构的仿真与真实环境实验中，SOUL显著减少幻觉失败并提升任务成功率
方法基本不损害现有操作能力；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: 材料未给出定量指标、消融规模与统计显著性，难以评估增益幅度
方法依赖稀疏自编码器识别幻觉与成功特征，特征选取的稳定性与跨架构可迁移性未在材料中说明
真实环境实验规模与任务多样性未在材料中披露
papers.practical_value: 为机器人VLA策略提供一种无需整体重训练、可定向修正特定失败模式的工程路径，有助于降低真实部署中的反复幻觉失败并提升任务可靠性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把可解释特征分析与策略知识编辑结合，针对VLA真实部署中的状态幻觉失败给出可操作的修正手段，对提升机器人策略可靠性具有参考价值。

papers.title: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
papers.abstract: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration.
