自适应推理切换的触发判据与延迟开销未在摘要中说明
合成具身推理数据的规模、质量与对真实机器人迁移的影响未量化
papers.practical_value: 面向需要长程规划与灵巧操作的真实机器人场景，单模型统一推理与动作可降低双系统集成复杂度与响应延迟，并通过合成数据降低具身推理数据采集成本，对通用机器人系统落地有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它提出用单一VLA模型替代推理-动作分离的双系统范式，并给出自适应推理与合成数据联合训练路线，为通用机器人兼顾推理深度与实时性提供了可讨论的新架构方向。

papers.title: π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
papers.abstract: In order for robots to be useful, they must perform practically relevant tasks in the real world, outside of the lab. While vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive results for end-to-end robot control, it remains an open question how far such models can generalize in the wild. We describe $\pi_{0.5}$, a new model based on $\pi_{0}$ that uses co-training on heterogeneous tasks to enable broad generalization. $\pi_{0.5}$\ uses data from multiple robots, high-level semantic prediction, web data, and other sources to enable broadly generalizable real-world robotic manipulation. Our system uses a combination of co-training and hybrid multi-modal examples that combine image observations, language commands, object detections, semantic subtask prediction, and low-level actions. Our experiments show that this kind of knowledge transfer is essential for effective generalization, and we demonstrate for the first time that an end-to-end learning-enabled robotic system can perform long-horizon and dexterous manipulation skills, such as cleaning a kitchen or bedroom, in entirely new homes.
papers.summary: π0.5 在 π0 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基础上，提出以异构任务协同训练实现开放世界泛化。研究问题是端到端 VLA 能否在实验室外的新环境中完成长时程、灵巧操作。技术路线是联合多机器人数据、高层语义子任务预测、目标检测与网页数据，构造同时包含图像观测、语言指令、检测框、语义子任务和低层动作的混合多模态训练样本，使语义知识与动作控制相互迁移。实验表明这种知识迁移对泛化至关重要，并首次展示端到端学习系统在全新住宅中完成清理厨房、卧室等长时程灵巧操作。
papers.one_line_takeaway: π0.5 通过异构数据与混合多模态协同训练，首次让端到端 VLA 系统在全新家庭环境中完成长时程灵巧操作。
papers.core_method: 以 π0 为基座，采用协同训练策略融合多机器人操作数据、网页数据、目标检测与高层语义子任务预测，构建同时含图像、语言、检测、语义子任务和低层动作的混合多模态样本，实现语义知识与低层控制的联合学习。
innovation_points: 提出异构任务协同训练框架，将多机器人数据、网页数据与语义子任务预测统一到 VLA 训练中
设计混合多模态训练样本，同时监督图像观测、语言指令、目标检测、语义子任务和低层动作
首次展示端到端学习机器人系统在完全陌生住宅中执行长时程灵巧操作（如清理厨房、卧室）
experiment_results: 摘要称协同训练带来的知识迁移对有效泛化是必要的，但未给出具体量化指标
首次展示端到端学习系统在全新家庭中完成长时程灵巧操作，摘要未提供成功率等数值
limitations: 摘要未报告定量评测指标与统计显著性，泛化能力缺乏可比较的数值证据
方法依赖多机器人、网页等多源异构数据，数据采集与协同训练成本较高
仅在摘要层面描述新家庭场景，未说明任务覆盖范围与失败模式
papers.practical_value: 为家庭服务机器人提供可落地的技术路径：利用多源异构数据协同训练，使单一端到端 VLA 模型具备跨环境泛化能力，减少对目标场景专用数据的依赖，支撑厨房、卧室清理等长时程家务任务。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面 VLA 模型能否走出实验室的核心问题，给出以异构协同训练提升开放世界泛化的可行方案，并首次在真实新住宅中验证长时程灵巧操作，对具身智能与机器人基础模型研究具有方向性参考价值。

papers.title: CoT-VLA: Visual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have shown potential in leveraging pretrained vision-language models and diverse robot demonstrations for learning generalizable sensorimotor control. While this paradigm effectively utilizes large-scale data from both robotic and non-robotic sources, current VLAs primarily focus on direct input–output mappings, lacking the intermediate reasoning steps crucial for complex manipulation tasks. As a result, existing VLAs lack temporal planning or reasoning capabilities. In this paper, we introduce a method that incorporates explicit visual chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning into vision-language-action models (VLAs) by predicting future image frames autoregressively as visual goals before generating a short action sequence to achieve these goals. We introduce CoT-VLA, a state-of-the-art 7B VLA that can understand and generate visual and action tokens. Our experimental results demonstrate that CoT-VLA achieves strong performance, outperforming the state-of-the-art VLA model by 17% in real-world manipulation tasks and 6% in simulation benchmarks. Videos are available at: https://cot-vla.github.io/.
papers.summary: CoT-VLA针对现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）仅做直接输入-输出映射、缺乏复杂操作所需中间推理与时间规划的问题，提出将显式视觉思维链（visual CoT）引入VLA：先自回归预测未来图像帧作为视觉目标，再生成一段短动作序列去实现该目标。作者构建了可理解并生成视觉token与动作token的7B规模VLA模型。实验表明，该方法在真实世界操作任务上比当前最优VLA模型高17%，在仿真基准上高6%。该工作属于机器人多模态基础模型方向，核心贡献在于推理结构而非应用层案例。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用自回归预测未来图像帧作为视觉目标，为VLA补上显式视觉思维链与时间规划能力，真实任务较SOTA提升17%。
papers.core_method: 在VLA中引入显式视觉思维链：模型先自回归生成未来图像帧作为视觉子目标，再基于该目标生成短动作序列执行；模型为7B规模，统一理解与生成视觉token和动作token。
innovation_points: 将视觉思维链显式引入VLA，把未来帧预测作为中间推理步骤，而非直接输入到动作映射
采用先预测视觉目标、再生成短动作序列的两阶段自回归结构，赋予模型时间规划能力
构建可同时理解并生成视觉token与动作token的7B统一VLA模型
experiment_results: 真实世界操作任务上比当前最优VLA模型高17%
仿真基准上比当前最优VLA模型高6%
摘要未给出具体任务数量、成功率绝对值或消融数据
limitations: 摘要未报告推理延迟、计算开销与模型规模对部署的影响
未提供视觉CoT各组件贡献的消融分析
真实世界评估的任务覆盖范围与泛化边界未在摘要中说明
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作提供可解释的中间视觉目标，使长时序复杂任务可分解为可验证的子目标，便于工程上做分步监控与失败诊断；但摘要未涉及企业真实业务场景与线上部署约束。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出现有VLA缺乏中间推理与时间规划这一结构性缺陷，并给出视觉CoT这一可扩展的建模范式，对多模态基础模型与机器人控制研究均有参考价值。

papers.title: MoLe-VLA: Dynamic Layer-skipping Vision Language Action Model via Mixture-of-Layers for Efficient Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robotic systems to perform embodied tasks but face deployment challenges due to the high computational demands of the dense Large Language Models (LLMs), with existing early-exit-based sparsification methods often overlooking the critical semantic role of final layers in downstream tasks. Aligning with the recent breakthrough of the Shallow Brain Hypothesis (SBH) in neuroscience and the mixture of experts in model sparsification, we conceptualize each LLM layer as an expert and propose a Mixture-of-LayEr Vision Language Action model (MoLe-VLA or simply MoLe) architecture for dynamic LLM layer activation. Specifically, we introduce a Spatial-Temporal Aware Router (STAR) for MoLe to selectively activate only parts of the layers based on the robot’s current state, mimicking the brain's distinct signal pathways specialized for cognition and causal reasoning. Additionally, to compensate for the cognition ability of LLM lost during the layer-skipping, we devise a Cognitive self-Knowledge Distillation (CogKD) to enhance the understanding of task demands and generate task-relevant action sequences by leveraging cognition features. Extensive experiments in RLBench simulations and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of MoLe-VLA in both efficiency and performance, improving the mean success rate by 9.7% across ten simulation tasks while accelerating inference by 36.8% over OpenVLA.
papers.summary: MoLe-VLA针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因稠密LLM计算量大而难以部署的问题，指出现有基于早退的稀疏化方法忽视了最后几层在下游任务中的关键语义作用。受神经科学浅脑假说与混合专家思想启发，作者将每个LLM层视为一个专家，提出Mixture-of-LayEr架构，并设计时空感知路由器STAR，根据机器人当前状态选择性激活部分层，模拟大脑中认知与因果推理的专门信号通路；同时提出认知自知识蒸馏CogKD，利用认知特征补偿跳层造成的理解能力损失，以生成任务相关动作序列。在RLBench仿真和真实环境中，该方法在十个仿真任务上平均成功率提升9.7%，相比OpenVLA推理加速36.8%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MoLe-VLA把LLM层当作专家动态跳层，在保持机器人操作成功率的同时显著加速VLA推理。
papers.core_method: 将LLM每一层视为一个专家，构建Mixture-of-LayEr动态层激活架构；引入时空感知路由器STAR，依据机器人当前状态选择激活部分层；设计认知自知识蒸馏CogKD，用认知特征补偿跳层导致的理解能力损失。
innovation_points: 将LLM层建模为专家，提出动态层激活的MoLe架构，区别于传统早退稀疏化
设计时空感知路由器STAR，按机器人状态选择性激活层，模拟大脑专门信号通路
提出认知自知识蒸馏CogKD，补偿跳层造成的认知能力损失
experiment_results: 在RLBench十个仿真任务上平均成功率提升9.7%
相比OpenVLA推理加速36.8%
在真实世界环境中验证了效率与性能优势
limitations: 摘要未给出真实环境的具体量化指标
路由与蒸馏引入额外训练开销，摘要未讨论
仅在RLBench与有限真实场景验证，泛化性证据有限
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作部署，通过动态跳层降低VLA模型推理计算量，在保持甚至提升任务成功率的同时加速推理，对算力受限的具身智能线上部署有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把模型稀疏化与神经科学假说结合，为VLA模型在真实机器人上的高效部署提供了可落地的层跳过方案，并给出仿真与真机效率-性能权衡证据。

papers.title: SafeVLA: Towards Safety Alignment of Vision-Language-Action Model via Constrained Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) show potential as generalist robot policies. However, these models pose extreme safety challenges during real-world deployment, including the risk of harm to the environment, the robot itself, and humans. How can safety constraints be explicitly integrated into VLAs? We address this by exploring an integrated safety approach (ISA), systematically modeling safety requirements, then actively eliciting diverse unsafe behaviors, effectively constraining VLA policies via safe reinforcement learning, and rigorously assuring their safety through targeted evaluations. Leveraging the constrained Markov decision process (CMDP) paradigm, ISA optimizes VLAs from a min-max perspective against elicited safety risks. Thus, policies aligned through this comprehensive approach achieve the following key features: (I) effective safety-performance trade-offs, reducing the cumulative cost of safety violations by 83.58% compared to the state-of-the-art method, while also maintaining task success rate (+3.85%). (II) strong safety assurance, with the ability to mitigate long-tail risks and handle extreme failure scenarios. (III) robust generalization of learned safety behaviors to various out-of-distribution perturbations. The effectiveness is evaluated on long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks. Our data, models and newly proposed benchmark environment are available at https://pku-safevla.github.io.
papers.summary: SafeVLA针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在真实机器人部署中可能危害环境、机器人自身与人的安全问题，提出集成安全方法ISA，将安全约束显式融入VLA策略。ISA基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），先系统建模安全需求，再主动诱导多样化的不安全行为，随后通过安全强化学习从min-max视角约束VLA策略，并用针对性评测严格验证安全性。在长时程移动操作任务上，该方法相比最先进方法将安全违规累计代价降低83.58%，同时任务成功率提升3.85%，并能缓解长尾风险、处理极端失败场景，且学到的安全行为对多种分布外扰动具有鲁棒泛化能力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SafeVLA用CMDP约束学习把安全约束显式嵌入VLA策略，在长时程移动操作上以更低安全代价取得更高任务成功率。
papers.core_method: 提出集成安全方法ISA：基于约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）系统建模安全需求；主动诱导多样化不安全行为以暴露风险；用安全强化学习从min-max视角优化VLA策略，在最大化任务收益的同时约束安全违规代价；最后通过针对性安全评测验证策略。
innovation_points: 将VLA安全对齐形式化为CMDP约束优化问题，从min-max视角同时优化任务性能与安全代价
设计主动诱导不安全行为的流程，系统暴露VLA在真实部署中的安全风险，而非仅依赖被动采集数据
在长时程移动操作任务上验证安全约束对长尾风险和极端失败场景的缓解能力，并考察对分布外扰动的泛化
experiment_results: 相比最先进方法，安全违规累计代价降低83.58%，任务成功率提升3.85%
具备缓解长尾风险和处理极端失败场景的能力
学到的安全行为对多种分布外扰动具有鲁棒泛化性；评测在长时程移动操作任务上进行
limitations: 摘要未说明安全约束建模与不安全行为诱导所依赖的具体数据规模与人工标注成本
评测集中于长时程移动操作任务，尚未覆盖更多机器人形态与开放场景
安全保证依赖约束强化学习的优化质量，极端分布外情形下的形式化保证程度未在摘要中说明
papers.practical_value: 为真实机器人部署中的VLA策略提供可操作的安全对齐流程：先建模安全需求、再主动暴露风险、后用约束强化学习优化，并以针对性评测验收。83.58%的安全违规代价下降与任务成功率不降反升，说明安全约束可与任务性能兼得，对需要在人类环境中长期运行的移动操作机器人具有直接工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA作为通用机器人策略正走向真实部署，安全是落地的前置条件。该工作把安全约束显式纳入VLA训练目标，并给出可复现的数据、模型与基准环境，为VLA安全对齐提供了系统化范式与可比较的评测基础。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) build upon pretrained vision-language models and leverage diverse robot datasets to demonstrate strong task execution, language following ability, and semantic generalization. Despite these successes, VLAs struggle with novel robot setups and require fine-tuning to achieve good performance, yet how to most effectively fine-tune them is unclear given many possible strategies. In this work, we study key VLA adaptation design choices such as different action decoding schemes, action representations, and learning objectives for fine-tuning, using OpenVLA as our representative base model. Our empirical analysis informs an Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT) recipe that integrates parallel decoding, action chunking, a continuous action representation, and a simple L1 regression-based learning objective to altogether improve inference efficiency, policy performance, and flexibility in the model's input-output specifications. We propose OpenVLA-OFT, an instantiation of this recipe, which sets a new state of the art on the LIBERO simulation benchmark, significantly boosting OpenVLA's average success rate across four task suites from 76.5% to 97.1% while increasing action generation throughput by 26$\times$. In real-world evaluations, our fine-tuning recipe enables OpenVLA to successfully execute dexterous, high-frequency control tasks on a bimanual ALOHA robot and outperform other VLAs ($\pi_0$ and RDT-1B) fine-tuned using their default recipes, as well as strong imitation learning policies trained from scratch (Diffusion Policy and ACT) by up to 15% (absolute) in average success rate. We release code for OFT and pretrained model checkpoints at https://openvla-oft.github.io/.
papers.summary: 该研究聚焦视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在下游机器人任务中的微调策略设计问题。作者以OpenVLA为代表性基座模型，系统考察动作解码方式、动作表示和学习目标三类关键微调设计选择，提出优化微调配方OFT，整合并行解码、动作分块、连续动作表示与简单L1回归目标，以同时提升推理效率、策略性能和输入输出规格灵活性。基于该配方构建的OpenVLA-OFT在LIBERO仿真基准上取得新的最优结果，四个任务套件平均成功率由76.5%提升至97.1%，动作生成吞吐提升26倍；在真实双臂ALOHA机器人上完成高频灵巧控制任务，平均成功率较π0、RDT-1B及从头训练的Diffusion Policy、ACT最高领先15个百分点。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 系统化的VLA微调设计可将OpenVLA在LIBERO上的平均成功率从76.5%提升至97.1%，同时将动作生成吞吐提升26倍。
papers.core_method: 以OpenVLA为代表性基座模型，对动作解码方案、动作表示和学习目标等VLA适配设计选择进行实证分析，据此提出优化微调配方OFT：并行解码、动作分块、连续动作表示与简单L1回归学习目标相结合，并实例化为OpenVLA-OFT。
innovation_points: 系统考察VLA微调中的动作解码、动作表示与学习目标等关键设计选择，并给出实证依据
提出OFT优化微调配方，将并行解码、动作分块、连续动作表示与L1回归目标整合为统一方案
同时改善推理效率、策略性能和模型输入输出规格的灵活性，而非仅追求单一指标
experiment_results: LIBERO仿真基准四个任务套件平均成功率由OpenVLA的76.5%提升至97.1%，取得新的最优结果
动作生成吞吐提升26倍
真实双臂ALOHA机器人上完成高频灵巧控制任务，平均成功率较π0、RDT-1B及从头训练的Diffusion Policy、ACT最高领先15个百分点（绝对值）
limitations: 研究以OpenVLA为单一代表性基座模型，结论向其他VLA架构的迁移性未在摘要中说明
真实世界评估集中于双臂ALOHA平台，其他机器人形态与任务场景的覆盖有限
摘要未报告微调所需数据规模、训练成本及失败案例的细粒度分析
papers.practical_value: 为机器人在新硬件平台和任务上部署VLA提供了可复用的微调配方，在提升任务成功率的同时大幅提高动作生成吞吐，降低高频控制场景的推理时延压力，并开源代码与预训练检查点，便于工程落地与复现。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA在新机器人设置上通常依赖微调才能达到可用性能，但微调策略长期缺乏系统比较。该工作以实证方式厘清关键设计选择的影响，并给出兼顾速度与成功率的配方，对VLA的实际部署具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: ChatVLA: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Robot Control with Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Humans possess a unified cognitive ability to perceive, comprehend, and interact with the physical world. Why can't large language models replicate this holistic understanding? Through a systematic analysis of existing training paradigms in vision-language-action models (VLA), we identify two key challenges: spurious forgetting, where robot training overwrites crucial visual-text alignments, and task interference, where competing control and understanding tasks degrade performance when trained jointly. To overcome these limitations, we propose ChatVLA, a novel framework featuring Phased Alignment Training, which incrementally integrates multimodal data after initial control mastery, and a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to minimize task interference. ChatVLA demonstrates competitive performance on visual question-answering datasets and significantly surpasses state-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) methods on multimodal understanding benchmarks. Notably, it achieves a six times higher performance on MMMU and scores 47.2% on MMStar with a more parameter-efficient design than ECoT. Furthermore, ChatVLA demonstrates superior performance on 25 real-world robot manipulation tasks compared to existing VLA methods like OpenVLA. Our findings highlight the potential of our unified framework for achieving both robust multimodal understanding and effective robot control.
papers.venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
papers.summary: ChatVLA针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在联合训练多模态理解与机器人控制时出现的两个核心问题——虚假遗忘（机器人训练覆盖关键视觉-文本对齐）和任务干扰（控制与理解任务相互竞争导致性能下降）——提出统一框架。其技术路线包含分阶段对齐训练（先掌握控制能力，再增量融入多模态数据）与混合专家（MoE）架构以降低任务干扰。实验表明，ChatVLA在视觉问答数据集上具备竞争力，在多模态理解基准上显著超越现有VLA方法，MMMU上性能提升六倍，MMStar达47.2%，且参数效率优于ECoT；在25个真实机器人操作任务上优于OpenVLA等VLA方法。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ChatVLA通过分阶段对齐训练与MoE架构，在统一框架内同时实现较强的多模态理解与机器人控制，缓解了VLA联合训练中的虚假遗忘与任务干扰。
papers.core_method: 提出ChatVLA统一视觉-语言-动作框架：采用分阶段对齐训练，先在控制任务上掌握基础能力，再增量引入多模态理解数据以保护视觉-文本对齐；并引入混合专家（MoE）架构，将控制与理解任务解耦，降低联合训练中的任务干扰。
innovation_points: 系统分析VLA训练中的虚假遗忘与任务干扰两类问题，并据此设计训练范式
分阶段对齐训练：先控制后多模态增量融合，保护视觉-文本对齐
MoE架构用于缓解控制与理解任务间的干扰
在参数效率优于ECoT的设计下取得更强的多模态理解表现
experiment_results: 在MMMU上性能为对比方法的六倍，MMStar得分为47.2%
在视觉问答数据集上具备竞争力，并在多模态理解基准上显著超越现有VLA方法
在25个真实机器人操作任务上优于OpenVLA等现有VLA方法
limitations: 摘要未提供分阶段对齐训练与MoE各组件贡献的消融数据
真实机器人任务仅给出相对比较结论，未披露具体任务成功率等量化细节
未说明虚假遗忘与任务干扰的定量度量方式
papers.practical_value: 为机器人企业提供一种可同时部署多模态理解与操作控制的统一VLA方案，分阶段训练降低多模态数据对控制能力的侵蚀，MoE在参数效率上的优势有利于在真实机器人平台上控制推理成本；25个真实操作任务的验证增强了工程落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面VLA落地中理解与控制难以兼得的关键矛盾，给出可操作的训练与架构方案，并在真实机器人任务上验证，对构建通用机器人基座模型具有参考意义。

papers.title: VLAS: Vision-Language-Action Model With Speech Instructions For Customized Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have become increasingly popular in robot manipulation for their end-to-end design and remarkable performance. However, existing VLAs rely heavily on vision-language models (VLMs) that only support text-based instructions, neglecting the more natural speech modality for human-robot interaction. Traditional speech integration methods usually involves a separate speech recognition system, which complicates the model and introduces error propagation. Moreover, the transcription procedure would lose non-semantic information in the raw speech, such as voiceprint, which may be crucial for robots to successfully complete customized tasks. To overcome above challenges, we propose VLAS, a novel end-to-end VLA that integrates speech recognition directly into the robot policy model. VLAS allows the robot to understand spoken commands through inner speech-text alignment and produces corresponding actions to fulfill the task. We also present two new datasets, SQA and CSI, to support a three-stage tuning process for speech instructions, which empowers VLAS with the ability of multimodal interaction across text, image, speech, and robot actions. Taking a step further, a voice retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) paradigm is designed to enable our model to effectively handle tasks that require individual-specific knowledge. Our extensive experiments show that VLAS can effectively accomplish robot manipulation tasks with diverse speech commands, offering a seamless and customized interaction experience.
papers.summary: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）仅支持文本指令，忽略了更自然的语音交互模态。传统语音集成方法依赖独立语音识别系统，导致模型复杂且误差传播，同时转录过程丢失声纹等非语义信息，影响定制化任务。为此，论文提出VLAS，一种端到端VLA模型，将语音识别直接集成到机器人策略模型中，通过内部语音-文本对齐理解口头指令并生成动作。为支持三阶段语音指令调优，构建了SQA和CSI两个新数据集，使模型具备文本、图像、语音和机器人动作的多模态交互能力。进一步设计语音检索增强生成（RAG）范式，以处理需要个体特定知识的任务。实验表明，VLAS能有效完成多样语音指令的机器人操作任务，提供无缝定制化交互体验。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLAS将语音识别直接集成到VLA策略中，实现端到端语音指令机器人操作，避免误差传播并保留声纹信息。
papers.core_method: 提出端到端VLA模型VLAS，将语音识别直接集成到机器人策略模型，通过内部语音-文本对齐理解口头指令并生成动作；设计三阶段调优过程，并引入语音RAG范式处理个体特定知识任务。
innovation_points: 端到端语音集成：将语音识别直接嵌入VLA策略模型，避免独立ASR系统的误差传播和模型复杂性。
保留非语义信息：通过内部对齐保留声纹等原始语音特征，支持定制化任务。
新数据集与三阶段调优：构建SQA和CSI数据集，支持文本、图像、语音和动作的多模态交互训练。
语音RAG范式：利用检索增强生成处理需要个体特定知识的任务。
experiment_results: 实验表明VLAS能有效完成多样语音指令的机器人操作任务，提供无缝定制化交互体验（摘要未提供具体量化数据）。
limitations: 摘要未明确说明模型在噪声环境或跨说话人场景下的鲁棒性。
未提供与基线方法在成功率、延迟等指标上的量化对比。
语音RAG范式的具体实现细节和检索效率未在摘要中展开。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作提供更自然、定制化的语音交互方式，端到端设计降低系统复杂度，保留声纹信息有助于个性化服务，语音RAG可扩展至需要个体知识的实际场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作探索了VLA模型的多模态指令扩展，将语音直接融入策略学习，为更自然的人机交互和定制化机器人应用提供了新思路，并提出了配套数据集和训练范式。

papers.title: FAST: Efficient Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Autoregressive sequence models, such as Transformer-based vision-language action (VLA) policies, can be tremendously effective for capturing complex and generalizable robotic behaviors. However, such models require us to choose a tokenization of our continuous action signals, which determines how the discrete symbols predicted by the model map to continuous robot actions. We find that current approaches for robot action tokenization, based on simple per-dimension, per-timestep binning schemes, typically perform poorly when learning dexterous skills from high-frequency robot data. To address this challenge, we propose a new compression-based tokenization scheme for robot actions, based on the discrete cosine transform. Our tokenization approach, Frequency-space Action Sequence Tokenization (FAST), enables us to train autoregressive VLAs for highly dexterous and high-frequency tasks where standard discretization methods fail completely. Based on FAST, we release FAST+, a universal robot action tokenizer, trained on 1M real robot action trajectories. It can be used as a black-box tokenizer for a wide range of robot action sequences, with diverse action spaces and control frequencies. Finally, we show that, when combined with the pi0 VLA, our method can scale to training on 10k hours of robot data and match the performance of diffusion VLAs, while reducing training time by up to 5x.
papers.summary: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中连续动作信号的离散化问题。作者发现，现有按维度、按时间步的简单分箱方案在学习高频灵巧技能时表现不佳。为此提出FAST（频域动作序列分词），基于离散余弦变换对动作序列进行压缩式分词，使自回归VLA能够处理标准离散化完全失败的高频灵巧任务。作者进一步发布FAST+通用动作分词器，在100万条真实机器人动作轨迹上训练，可作为黑盒分词器适配不同动作空间与控制频率。与pi0 VLA结合后，方法可扩展至1万小时机器人数据训练，性能匹配扩散VLA，同时将训练时间最多缩短5倍。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FAST用离散余弦变换做动作序列压缩分词，让自回归VLA在高频灵巧任务上追平扩散VLA并大幅缩短训练时间。
papers.core_method: 提出基于离散余弦变换（DCT）的压缩式动作分词方案FAST：将连续动作序列变换到频域后进行量化与压缩编码，替代逐维逐时间步的简单分箱；并基于100万条真实机器人轨迹训练通用分词器FAST+，作为黑盒组件适配不同动作空间与控制频率，与pi0自回归VLA联合训练。
innovation_points: 指出逐维逐时间步分箱在高频灵巧机器人数据上系统性失效，明确问题根源在动作分词而非策略架构
提出基于离散余弦变换的频域压缩分词FAST，利用动作序列的时频冗余提升离散符号的信息密度
发布FAST+通用动作分词器，在100万条真实轨迹上训练，可跨动作空间与控制频率黑盒复用
与pi0 VLA结合验证可扩展至1万小时机器人数据，并显著降低训练时间
experiment_results: 标准离散化方法在高频灵巧任务上完全失败，FAST可支撑自回归VLA训练此类任务
结合pi0 VLA可扩展至1万小时机器人数据训练，性能匹配扩散VLA
训练时间最多缩短5倍；具体任务成功率与对比数值未在给定材料中给出
limitations: 摘要未报告具体任务成功率、基线对比数值与消融结果，性能证据以定性描述为主
FAST+依赖100万条真实机器人轨迹，数据覆盖范围之外的动作空间泛化性未在材料中说明
方法聚焦动作分词环节，未讨论其对VLA推理延迟与部署成本的线上影响
papers.practical_value: FAST+可作为黑盒动作分词器直接接入现有自回归VLA训练管线，降低高频灵巧机器人数据的建模门槛；训练时间最多缩短5倍，对大规模机器人数据训练的成本控制有直接工程价值，并为统一跨本体、跨控制频率的动作表示提供可复用组件。
papers.why_it_matters: 动作分词是自回归VLA能否处理高频灵巧操作的关键瓶颈，该工作把信号压缩思想引入机器人动作表示，并给出可复用通用分词器与万小时级训练验证，对VLA训练效率与规模化路线有参考意义。

papers.title: NaVILA: Legged Robot Vision-Language-Action Model for Navigation
papers.abstract: This paper proposes to solve the problem of Vision-and-Language Navigation with legged robots, which not only provides a flexible way for humans to command but also allows the robot to navigate through more challenging and cluttered scenes. However, it is non-trivial to translate human language instructions all the way to low-level leg joint actions. We propose NaVILA, a 2-level framework that unifies a Vision-Language-Action model (VLA) with locomotion skills. Instead of directly predicting low-level actions from VLA, NaVILA first generates mid-level actions with spatial information in the form of language, (e.g.,"moving forward 75cm"), which serves as an input for a visual locomotion RL policy for execution. NaVILA substantially improves previous approaches on existing benchmarks. The same advantages are demonstrated in our newly developed benchmarks with IsaacLab, featuring more realistic scenes, low-level controls, and real-world robot experiments. We show more results at https://navila-bot.github.io/
papers.summary: 本文研究足式机器人视觉—语言—动作导航（VLN）问题：人类用自然语言下达指令，机器人需在更复杂、杂乱的场景中完成导航，而把语言直接映射到低层腿部关节动作十分困难。作者提出 NaVILA 两级框架，将视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA）与运动技能解耦：VLA 不直接输出低层动作，而是先生成带空间信息的中层语言动作（如“前进75cm”），再交由视觉运动强化学习策略执行。该方法在现有基准上显著优于先前方法，并在基于 IsaacLab 新建的基准（更真实场景、低层控制）及真实机器人实验中体现同样优势。
papers.one_line_takeaway: NaVILA 用“VLA 输出中层语言动作 + 运动RL策略执行”的两级解耦，把语言指令可靠地落到足式机器人低层关节控制上。
papers.core_method: 两级框架：上层为视觉—语言—动作模型（VLA），根据语言指令与视觉观测生成带空间信息的中层语言动作（如“前进75cm”）；下层为视觉运动强化学习策略，将该中层动作作为输入并输出低层腿部关节控制，从而完成导航执行。
innovation_points: 将VLA与运动技能解耦，避免VLA直接预测低层关节动作，降低语言到低层控制的映射难度
以带空间信息的中层语言动作作为两级接口，兼具可解释性与可执行性
在IsaacLab中构建更真实场景、含低层控制的新基准，并辅以真实机器人实验验证
experiment_results: 在现有VLN基准上较先前方法有显著提升（摘要未给出具体数值）
在基于IsaacLab新建基准（更真实场景、低层控制）上体现同样优势（摘要未给出具体数值）
真实世界机器人实验展示相同优势（摘要未给出具体数值）
limitations: 摘要与元数据未提供定量指标、消融与失败案例分析，难以评估各组件贡献
中层语言动作的粒度与表达范围可能限制复杂场景下的精细导航
真实机器人实验规模与场景多样性在给定材料中未说明
papers.practical_value: 为足式机器人提供可落地的语言导航方案：人类可用自然语言灵活指挥，机器人在杂乱场景中导航；两级接口便于将上层VLA与下层运动策略分别迭代与复用，利于工程集成。
papers.why_it_matters: 它给出一种务实路线：不强行让VLA端到端输出低层关节动作，而以中层语言动作衔接运动RL策略，为足式机器人语言导航的可执行性与可扩展性提供参考。

papers.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
papers.abstract: Robot learning holds tremendous promise to unlock the full potential of flexible, general, and dexterous robot systems, as well as to address some of the deepest questions in artificial intelligence. However, bringing robot learning to the level of generality required for effective real-world systems faces major obstacles in terms of data, generalization, and robustness. In this paper, we discuss how generalist robot policies (i.e., robot foundation models) can address these challenges, and how we can design effective generalist robot policies for complex and highly dexterous tasks. We propose a novel flow matching architecture built on top of a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) to inherit Internet-scale semantic knowledge. We then discuss how this model can be trained on a large and diverse dataset from multiple dexterous robot platforms, including single-arm robots, dual-arm robots, and mobile manipulators. We evaluate our model in terms of its ability to perform tasks in zero shot after pre-training, follow language instructions from people and from a high-level VLM policy, and its ability to acquire new skills via fine-tuning. Our results cover a wide variety of tasks, such as laundry folding, table cleaning, and assembling boxes.
papers.summary: 该论文提出π0，一种面向通用机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）流匹配模型。研究问题在于如何将机器人学习提升到真实世界系统所需的通用性、泛化性与鲁棒性水平。技术路线是：在预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）之上构建流匹配架构，以继承互联网规模的语义知识，并在来自多种灵巧机器人平台（单臂、双臂、移动操作器）的大规模多样化数据集上训练。评估涵盖预训练后的零样本任务执行、跟随人类与高层VLM策略的语言指令，以及通过微调获取新技能，任务包括叠衣服、清理桌子和组装盒子。
papers.one_line_takeaway: π0在预训练VLM之上用流匹配架构构建通用机器人策略，并在多平台灵巧任务上验证了零样本、指令跟随与微调能力。
papers.core_method: 以预训练视觉-语言模型为骨干，在其上叠加流匹配（flow matching）动作生成架构，形成视觉-语言-动作模型；在涵盖单臂、双臂和移动操作器的多平台大规模多样化机器人数据上训练，并支持语言指令条件与下游微调。
innovation_points: 在预训练VLM之上引入流匹配架构生成机器人动作，继承互联网规模语义知识
面向多种灵巧机器人平台（单臂、双臂、移动操作器）的大规模多样化数据训练通用策略
同时评估零样本执行、人类与高层VLM语言指令跟随、以及微调获取新技能三种使用模式
experiment_results: 摘要仅定性说明结果覆盖叠衣服、清理桌子、组装盒子等多种任务，未给出具体量化指标
limitations: 摘要未报告定量性能数据与基线对比，难以判断相对优势幅度
摘要未说明数据规模、训练成本与失败案例的细节
papers.practical_value: 为通用机器人基础模型提供可复用的架构范式：复用预训练VLM语义知识并以流匹配生成灵巧动作，支持零样本、语言指令与微调多种部署路径，覆盖家务与装配等真实任务场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将视觉-语言模型与流匹配动作生成结合，探索通用机器人策略在数据、泛化与鲁棒性上的可行路径，对机器人基础模型与VLA方向具有架构参考价值。

papers.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Large policies pretrained on a combination of Internet-scale vision-language data and diverse robot demonstrations have the potential to change how we teach robots new skills: rather than training new behaviors from scratch, we can fine-tune such vision-language-action (VLA) models to obtain robust, generalizable policies for visuomotor control. Yet, widespread adoption of VLAs for robotics has been challenging as 1) existing VLAs are largely closed and inaccessible to the public, and 2) prior work fails to explore methods for efficiently fine-tuning VLAs for new tasks, a key component for adoption. Addressing these challenges, we introduce OpenVLA, a 7B-parameter open-source VLA trained on a diverse collection of 970k real-world robot demonstrations. OpenVLA builds on a Llama 2 language model combined with a visual encoder that fuses pretrained features from DINOv2 and SigLIP. As a product of the added data diversity and new model components, OpenVLA demonstrates strong results for generalist manipulation, outperforming closed models such as RT-2-X (55B) by 16.5% in absolute task success rate across 29 tasks and multiple robot embodiments, with 7x fewer parameters. We further show that we can effectively fine-tune OpenVLA for new settings, with especially strong generalization results in multi-task environments involving multiple objects and strong language grounding abilities, and outperform expressive from-scratch imitation learning methods such as Diffusion Policy by 20.4%. We also explore compute efficiency; as a separate contribution, we show that OpenVLA can be fine-tuned on consumer GPUs via modern low-rank adaptation methods and served efficiently via quantization without a hit to downstream success rate. Finally, we release model checkpoints, fine-tuning notebooks, and our PyTorch codebase with built-in support for training VLAs at scale on Open X-Embodiment datasets.
papers.summary: OpenVLA 是一个 7B 参数的开源视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，旨在解决现有 VLA 模型封闭且缺乏高效微调方法的问题。它基于 Llama 2 语言模型，结合融合 DINOv2 和 SigLIP 预训练特征的视觉编码器，在 97 万条真实机器人演示数据上训练。在 29 项任务和多种机器人本体上，OpenVLA 的绝对任务成功率比闭源模型 RT-2-X（55B）高 16.5%，参数量少 7 倍。微调后，在多任务环境中泛化能力强，语言 grounding 表现好，比 Diffusion Policy 高 20.4%。此外，通过低秩适应和量化，可在消费级 GPU 上高效微调和部署，且不影响成功率。模型检查点、微调 notebook 和 PyTorch 代码库均已开源。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OpenVLA 是一个 7B 参数的开源视觉-语言-动作模型，以更少参数超越闭源大模型，并支持高效微调与部署。
papers.core_method: 基于 Llama 2 语言模型和融合 DINOv2 与 SigLIP 特征的视觉编码器，在 97 万条真实机器人演示数据上预训练，采用低秩适应（LoRA）进行高效微调，并支持量化推理。
innovation_points: 开源 7B 参数 VLA 模型，参数比 RT-2-X 少 7 倍但成功率更高
融合 DINOv2 和 SigLIP 预训练特征的视觉编码器
探索低秩适应和量化以实现消费级 GPU 上的高效微调与部署
发布模型检查点、微调 notebook 和 PyTorch 代码库，支持 Open X-Embodiment 数据集的大规模训练
experiment_results: 在 29 项任务和多种机器人本体上，绝对任务成功率比 RT-2-X（55B）高 16.5%
微调后比 Diffusion Policy 高 20.4%
通过低秩适应可在消费级 GPU 上微调，量化后下游成功率不下降
limitations: 未提及模型在未见过的机器人本体或极端环境下的泛化能力
未讨论训练数据的具体构成和潜在偏差
未提供推理延迟或实时性等工程指标
papers.practical_value: 为机器人学习社区提供了可访问的开源 VLA 模型，降低了研究和应用门槛；高效微调和量化方法使在消费级硬件上部署成为可能，推动了 VLA 在真实机器人任务中的落地。
papers.why_it_matters: OpenVLA 以开源方式实现了超越闭源大模型的性能，并解决了高效微调的关键问题，为机器人领域的研究者和开发者提供了强大的基础模型和工具链，有望加速视觉-语言-动作模型的研究与应用。

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
papers.abstract: We study how vision-language models trained on Internet-scale data can be incorporated directly into end-to-end robotic control to boost generalization and enable emergent semantic reasoning. Our goal is to enable a single end-to-end trained model to both learn to map robot observations to actions and enjoy the benefits of large-scale pretraining on language and vision-language data from the web. To this end, we propose to co-fine-tune state-of-the-art vision-language models on both robotic trajectory data and Internet-scale vision-language tasks, such as visual question answering. In contrast to other approaches, we propose a simple, general recipe to achieve this goal: in order to fit both natural language responses and robotic actions into the same format, we express the actions as text tokens and incorporate them directly into the training set of the model in the same way as natural language tokens. We refer to such category of models as vision-language-action models (VLA) and instantiate an example of such a model, which we call RT-2. Our extensive evaluation (6k evaluation trials) shows that our approach leads to performant robotic policies and enables RT-2 to obtain a range of emergent capabilities from Internet-scale training. This includes significantly improved generalization to novel objects, the ability to interpret commands not present in the robot training data (such as placing an object onto a particular number or icon), and the ability to perform rudimentary reasoning in response to user commands (such as picking up the smallest or largest object, or the one closest to another object). We further show that incorporating chain of thought reasoning allows RT-2 to perform multi-stage semantic reasoning, for example figuring out which object to pick up for use as an improvised hammer (a rock), or which type of drink is best suited for someone who is tired (an energy drink).
papers.summary: RT-2研究如何将互联网规模数据训练的视觉-语言模型直接融入端到端机器人控制，以提升泛化能力并实现涌现语义推理。作者提出视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）类别，核心是将机器人动作表示为文本token，与自然语言token同格式纳入训练集，从而对先进VLM在机器人轨迹数据和互联网视觉-语言任务（如VQA）上联合微调。实例化模型RT-2经6000次评估试验，展现出对新颖物体的显著泛化、理解机器人训练数据中未出现的命令（如把物体放到特定数字或图标上），以及执行基础推理（如拿起最小/最大或离某物最近的物体）。引入思维链后，RT-2还能完成多阶段语义推理，例如选择石头作为临时锤子，或为疲惫者选择能量饮料。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 将机器人动作编码为文本token并与互联网视觉-语言任务联合微调，可使单一端到端VLA模型获得显著泛化与涌现语义推理能力。
papers.core_method: 提出视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）：把机器人动作表示为文本token，与自然语言token同格式并入训练集，对先进视觉-语言模型在机器人轨迹数据和互联网规模视觉-语言任务（如VQA）上联合微调，实现单一端到端模型同时学习观测到动作的映射并利用网络知识。
innovation_points: 将机器人动作统一表示为文本token，使动作与自然语言共享同一序列格式，简化多模态联合训练。
提出VLA模型类别，并在互联网视觉-语言数据与机器人轨迹数据上联合微调，直接复用VLM的 web 知识。
在6000次评估试验中展示涌现能力：对新物体泛化、理解训练数据外命令、基础语义推理。
引入思维链推理，使VLA支持多阶段语义推理（如选择临时锤子或合适饮料）。
experiment_results: 6000次评估试验表明，联合微调得到高性能机器人策略，并带来对新颖物体的显著泛化提升。
RT-2能解释机器人训练数据中未出现的命令，例如将物体放到特定数字或图标上。
RT-2可执行基础推理（如拿起最小/最大或离某物最近的物体），结合思维链可完成多阶段语义推理。
limitations: 材料未提供具体量化指标、基线对比和失败率数据，难以评估各能力提升幅度。
摘要未讨论模型规模、推理延迟、部署成本等工程约束。
未说明在真实机器人平台上的长期运行稳定性和安全性评估。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人控制提供一种简洁的端到端VLA训练范式：复用互联网预训练的视觉-语言模型，以文本token统一动作与语言，降低多模态联合训练复杂度，并赋予机器人对新颖物体和未见命令的泛化及语义推理能力，对通用机器人策略开发有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作提出并验证了VLA这一模型类别，证明互联网规模视觉-语言预训练知识可迁移至端到端机器人控制，并催生涌现语义推理能力，为后续通用机器人基础模型研究提供了关键范式与实证依据。
